Title: Ace High
Alternative_Titles: Revenge at El Paso; Four Gunmen of Ave Maria; I Quattro dell'Ave Maria
Co_Stars: Terence Hill, Bud Spencer, Brock Peters, Kevin McCarthy, Tiffany Hoyveld, Rick Boyd, Livio Lorenzon
Synopsis_and_Notes: Fundamentally, Eli Wallach replays the same character he popularized in Sergio Leone's The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly, with a different name: Cacopulos from Greece. When a banker buys his freedom from jail to track down con-men Cat Stevens (Terence Hill) and Hutch (Bud Spencer), Cacopulos kills the banker and steals their loot instead. After losing the cash in a crooked casino run by Drake (Kevin McCarthy), the three form an uneasy alliance with a former-slave acrobat (Brock Peters) to pull off a revenge heist.

Title: Adios Cjamango
Alternative_Titles: Twenty Thousand Dollars for Every Corpse; 20.000 Dolares por un Cadaver
Co_Stars: Dianik Zurakowska, José Truchado, Luis Induñi, Franco Fantasia, Miguel de la Riva
Synopsis_and_Notes: An obscure, loosely related sequel to Edward Muller's 1967 film Cjamango, this time starring Mike Rivers in the title role. Cjamango is a bounty hunter who decides to assist a young widow in her bitter range war against an evil land baron. The tyrannical villain is secretly assembling an underground army of outlaws and banditos to seize the territory.

Title: Adios Gringo
Alternative_Titles: Adios Gringo
Co_Stars: Evelyn Stewart, Ted Carter, Peter Cross, Max Dean, Roberto Camardiel, Frank Braña, Jesus Puente, Jean Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Brent Landers (Giuliano Gemma) is framed for cattle rustling and murder, forcing him to go on the run to hunt down the true swindler. Along the trail, he rescues Lucy (Evelyn Stewart), a traumatized woman attacked by three outlaws, including the son of a powerful local cattle baron. Gemma must fight off both corrupt lawmen and hired killers to clear his name. The film was a runaway smash hit in Italy, ranking as the fourth highest-grossing film of 1965.

Title: Adios Hombre
Alternative_Titles: Seven Pistols for a Massacre; Adios Hombre
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Piero Lulli, Giulia Rubini, Nello Pazzafini, Eleanora Vargas, Spartaco Conversi, Roberto Camardiel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Master villain Eduardo Fajardo stars as the psychotic head of an outlaw gang that takes over a sleepy border-town saloon as a fortified hideout while waiting for a massive gold shipment. The gang terrorizes and slaughters the terrified townspeople. An escaped convict seeking redemption, Will Flarity (Craig Hill), decides to take a stand and wipes out the gang one by one.

Title: Adios, Sabata
Alternative_Titles: Indio Black; Sabata 2; Bounty Hunters; Indio Black, Sai Che Ti Dico...
Co_Stars: Dean Reed, Pedro Sanchez, Susan Scott, Franco Fantasia, Joseph Persuad, Andrea Scotti, Sal Borgese, Gerard Herter
Synopsis_and_Notes: Originally written as Indio Black, this film was retitled during dubbing to capitalize on the massive success of Sabata. Dressed in all-black and sporting fringe bell-bottoms, Yul Brynner plays the stoic gunfighter leading an expedition to steal a fortune in gold from a sadistic Austrian commandant stationed in Mexico. Pop star Dean Reed co-stars as his flamboyant ball-tossing sidekick Ballantine.

Title: Alive or Preferably Dead
Alternative_Titles: Sundance and the Kid; Vivi... o Preferibilmente Morti
Co_Stars: Nino Benvenuti, Sydne Rome, Julio Peña, Antonio Casas, Cris Huerta, Georges Rigaud
Synopsis_and_Notes: A breezy, lighthearted Western comedy starring Giuliano Gemma alongside real-life boxing champion Nino Benvenuti as two estranged brothers. City-slicker Monty and rustic bumpkin Ted are forced to live together peacefully for six straight months in order to inherit their late uncle's fortune. Chaos ensues when both fall hopelessly in love with the same feisty frontier girl (Sydne Rome).

Title: All Out
Alternative_Titles: Go for Broke; Tutto per Tutto; One for All
Co_Stars: Mark Damon, Raf Baldassarre, Fernando Sancho, Monica Randall, Spartaco Conversi, Armando Calvo, Eduardo Fajardo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rough-and-tumble caper Western directed by Italian cult horror icon Umberto Lenzi. John Ireland stars as a seasoned bounty hunter teaming up with a misunderstood outlaw (Mark Damon) to locate an elusive stash of stolen gold ingots. The duo must navigate a treacherous landscape populated by oddball killers like 'The Owl' and 'Copper Face', where double-crosses are an everyday currency.

Title: Among Vultures
Alternative_Titles: Frontier Hellcat; La Dove Scende il Sole; Unter Geiern
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Elke Sommer, Renato Baldini, Walter Barnes, Götz George, Mario Girotti (Terence Hill), Sieghardt Rupp
Synopsis_and_Notes: Part of the classic German Karl May film series, featuring Stewart Granger as legendary frontier scout Old Surehand alongside Pierre Brice as Apache chief Winnetou. When a gang of ruthless outlaws disguised as Native Americans slaughters settlers and kidnaps a young woman (Elke Sommer), the heroic blood brothers track down the true culprits across the Rockies. Notably features an early genre appearance by Terence Hill.

Title: And God Said to Cain
Alternative_Titles: E Dio Disse a Caino...
Co_Stars: Peter Carsten, Marcella Michelangeli, Lee Burton, Antonio Cantafora, Giuliana Raffaelli, Luciano Pignozzi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gothic, horror-infused revenge Western starring Klaus Kinski in a commanding lead role as Gary Hamilton. Framed for a robbery and sent to hard labor in a military prison for a decade, Hamilton is pardoned and returns on the night of a raging tornado to systematically eliminate the corrupt land baron who ruined his life. The dark, brooding atmosphere turns the standard revenge motif into an eerie ghost story.

Title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
Alternative_Titles: I Corvi Ti Scaveranno la Fossa
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Dominique Boschero, Maria Pia Conte, Frank Braña, Indio Gonzales, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: Wells Fargo hires cold-eyed bounty hunter Jess Sullivan (Craig Hill) to wipe out a ferocious gang of train robbers terrorizing their payroll lines. Sullivan springs a former gang member from a territorial prison to act as his tracker, initiating a violent, tense cat-and-mouse game across desolate Mexican landscapes. The film features classic genre heavies Fernando Sancho and snowy-haired Frank Braña.

Title: And They Smelled the Strange, Exciting, Dangerous Scent of Dollars
Alternative_Titles: Sentivano... Uno Strano Eccitante Pericoloso Puzzo di Dollari
Co_Stars: Piero Vida, Rosalba Neri, Luigi Meccia, Salvatore Puntillo, Peter Landers, Spartaco Conversi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Boasting one of the most surreal and elaborate titles in Eurowestern history, this offbeat film follows charming outlaw Bronco Kid (Robert Malcolm) as he joins forces with eccentric bounty hunter Charity Jenkins. Together, they attempt to intercept and hijack a million-dollar payroll shipment orchestrated by a corrupt frontier financier. Features a brief appearance by fan-favorite genre queen Rosalba Neri.

Title: Animal Called Man
Alternative_Titles: Animale Chiamato Uomo
Co_Stars: Lillian Bray, Craig Hill, Gilberto Galimbi, Amero Capanna, Carla Mancini, Paolo Magalotti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A tongue-in-cheek comedy clearly riding the coattails of the smash-hit Trinity films. Charming rogue Bill Masson (Vassili Karis) wins a local sharpshooting derby, earning five hundred dollars and a night with the saloon songstress (Lillian Bray), only to discover she is actually an undercover physician from Paris. When the disgruntled local boss attempts to assassinate him, full-scale comic warfare breaks out.

Title: Another Man, Another Woman
Alternative_Titles: Another Man, Another Chance; Un Autre Homme, une Autre Chance
Co_Stars: Geneviève Bujold, Francis Huster, Jennifer Warren, Susan Tyrrell, Walter Barnes
Synopsis_and_Notes: Acclaimed French director Claude Lelouch crafts an arthouse Western romance starring James Caan as a widowed frontier veterinarian and Geneviève Bujold as an immigrant French widow trying to run a photography studio in New Mexico. Rather than focusing purely on gunfights, the film emphasizes breathtaking visual panoramas, delicate emotional storytelling, and the sheer harshness of frontier survival.

Title: Anything for a Friend
Alternative_Titles: Amico Mio, Frega Tu... Che Frego Io!
Co_Stars: Red Carter (Lionel Stander), Simone Blondell, Dennys Colt, Bud Randall, Carla Mancini, Sleepy Warren
Synopsis_and_Notes: A wonderfully outrageous slapstick effort from cult hack director Demofilo Fidani. Two small-time hustlers discover a rich gold seam in Dead Man's Gulch outside Denver, only to run afoul of the self-appointed town mayor and crooked saloon owner (Gordon Mitchell). Packed with Fidani's signature oddball humor, sight gags, and eccentric frontier characters.

Title: Apache Woman
Alternative_Titles: Una Donna Chiamata Apache
Co_Stars: Yara Kewa, Corrado Olmi, Fran Marie Boyer, Rick Boyd, Roque Oppedisano
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gritty, late-cycle Eurowestern mixing severe exploitation violence with 1970s softcore sensuality. A naive cavalry soldier named Tommy rescues a young Apache woman from an abusive gun-trafficker named Honest Jeremy. As the couple attempts to live in peace, the vindictive trader and his sadistic partners relentlessly stalk them through the wilderness, culminating in a brutal, uncompromising climax.

Title: Apache's Last Battle
Alternative_Titles: Old Shatterhand; Battaglia di Fort Apache
Co_Stars: Guy Madison, Pierre Brice, Daliah Lavi, Rick Battaglia, Ralf Wolter, Kitty Mattern, Bill Ramsey
Synopsis_and_Notes: Filmed in 70mm Superpanorama across the majestic Yugoslavian mountain ranges, this lavish European production stars Lex Barker as Old Shatterhand and Pierre Brice as Winnetou. The blood brothers strive to broker peace on the frontier while a renegade, glory-seeking cavalry officer (Guy Madison) schemes to trigger a total Indian war to seize sacred tribal lands.

Title: Apocalypse Joe
Alternative_Titles: Man Called Apocalypse Joe; L'Uomo Chiamato Apocalisse Joe
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Mary Paz Pondal, Stelio Candelli, Fernando Cerulli, Fernando Bilbao
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen stars as Joe Clifford, a wandering, Shakespeare-quoting actor who is secretly one of the deadliest vigilantes in the territory. Upon arriving in the town of Landberry to claim a gold mine left to him by his late uncle, he discovers that a corrupt syndicate led by town boss Berg (Eduardo Fajardo) has seized the operation and terrorized the citizens. Joe straps on his guns to reclaim his inheritance.

Title: Arizona
Alternative_Titles: Arizona Colt Returns; If You Gotta Shoot Someone... Bang! Bang!
Co_Stars: Rosalba Neri, Aldo Sambrell, Roberto Camardiel, José Manuel Martin, Raf Baldassare, Luis Barboo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dark and stylish revenge Western directed by Italian thriller maestro Sergio Martino. Retired bounty hunter Arizona Colt is framed for horse thievery by his old nemesis Keene (Aldo Sambrell). After faking his execution to live quietly, Keene raids his ranch, murdering Arizona's companions. Enraged, Arizona sets out on a merciless hunt, wiping out the entire outlaw outfit.

Title: Arizona Colt
Alternative_Titles: Man from Nowhere; Il Pistolero di Arizona
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Corinne Marchand, Nello Pazzafini, Andrea Bosić, Roberto Camardiel, Mirko Ellis, Rosalba Neri
Synopsis_and_Notes: Giuliano Gemma portrays legendary drifter Arizona Colt, who is forcibly freed from prison by Mexican bandit Gordon Watch (Fernando Sancho) to recruit him into his gang. Refusing to become an outlaw, Colt travels to Blackstone City to protect the settlement from the gang's impending raid. Filled with high-flying stunts, quick-draw action, and memorable performances by Sancho and Rosalba Neri.

Title: Arizona Kid
Alternative_Titles: I Fratelli di Arizona
Co_Stars: Gordon Mitchell, Chaquito, Mariela Branger, Bernard Bonnin, Pilar Velazquez
Synopsis_and_Notes: A singular historical oddity as the only Italian-Filipino co-produced Western ever made. Philippine comedy icon Chaquito stars as a bumbling wanderer who is mistaken for a mythical gunfighter named the Arizona Kid and hired to defend the village of Sierra Vista from a brutal gang led by Gordon Mitchell. 1950s Hollywood bombshell Mamie Van Doren co-stars.

Title: Armed and Dangerous: Time and Heroes of Bret Harte
Alternative_Titles: Wooruzhyon i Ochen Opasen
Co_Stars: Ludmilla Senchina, Leonid Bronevoy, Vsevolod Abdulov, Sergei Martinson
Synopsis_and_Notes: An ambitious Soviet-produced Western based loosely on the classic frontier tales of American writer Bret Harte. The narrative follows a gold prospector, a spirited dancehall singer, and the fictionalized author himself as they join forces to protect struggling homesteaders from a tyrannical oil tycoon seeking to monopolize the valley's mineral rights.

Title: Awkward Hands
Alternative_Titles: When Satan Grips the Colt; Clumsy Hands; Manos Torpes
Co_Stars: Alberto de Mendoza, Pilar Velazquez, Aldo Sambrell, Vidal Molina, Luis Induñi, Frank Braña, Antonio Casas
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peter Lee Lawrence plays Kitt, a peace-loving ranch hand beaten and left to die in the arid plains for daring to love the daughter of a wealthy cattle baron. Nursed back to health and schooled in the fatal art of gunfighting by a mysterious Chinese mentor, Kitt transforms into an ice-cold avenger, culminating in a savage confrontation with a lethal whip-wielding bounty hunter.

Title: Man Called Noon
Alternative_Titles: Lo Chiamavano Mezzogiorno
Co_Stars: Rosanna Schiaffino, Stephen Boyd, Farley Granger, Patty Shepard, Aldo Sambrell, Charlie Bravo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Based on a Louis L'Amour novel. Richard Crenna stars as Noon, an amnesiac gunslinger recovering from a gunshot wound to the head. Aided by an outlaw companion (Stephen Boyd) and a fiery senorita (Rosanna Schiaffino), Noon pieces together his forgotten past and tracks down the murderous gang responsible for the deaths of his wife and child.

Title: Man Called Sledge
Alternative_Titles: Sledge
Co_Stars: Laura Antonelli, Dennis Weaver, Claude Akins, John Marley, Wayde Preston, Ken Clark
Synopsis_and_Notes: James Garner delivers a gritty, atypical performance as Luther Sledge, an outlaw who infiltrates an impenetrable territorial prison to steal a $300,000 gold cache. After the daring robbery succeeds, mutual greed and paranoia cause the gang members to violently turn against each other until almost none survive.

Title: Man from Canyon City
Alternative_Titles: Viva Carrancha!; L'Uomo Che Viene da Canyon City
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Luis Dávila, Renato Baldini, Loredana Nusciak, Gérard Tichy, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: A direct sequel to Five Thousand Dollars on One Ace. Gambler Jeff Clayton (Robert Woods) and colorful Mexican bandido Carrancio (Fernando Sancho) escape together from a prison chain gang. The two form an unlikely criminal alliance, getting involved in a town feud that showcases Sancho's charismatic persona.

Title: Man from Oklahoma
Alternative_Titles: Ranch of the Ruthless; Il Ranch degli Spietati
Director: Jaime J. Balcazar / Roberto Montero (as Robert M. White)
Co_Stars: José Calvo, Sabine Bethman, John MacDouglas, Tom Felleghy, Leontine May, Karl Otto Alberty
Synopsis_and_Notes: The newly appointed sheriff of Wagon Wheel (Rick Horn) is determined to dismantle a marauding gang of outlaws. Convinced that an influential local land baron is secretly financing the raids to force settlers off their claims, the sheriff engages in a protracted cat-and-mouse game to prove the tycoon's guilt.

Title: Man of the Cursed Valley
Alternative_Titles: L'Uomo della Valle Maledetta
Co_Stars: Iran Eory, Peter Larry, Joe Kamel, José Nieto, John Bartha, José Marco
Synopsis_and_Notes: A frontier drama following a white woman (Iran Eory) who marries a Native American warrior and is disowned by her family. When she is captured by a hostile rival tribe, a roaming gunslinger (Ty Hardin) steps in to secure her rescue and mediate a reconciliation with her stubborn rancher father.

Title: Man of the East
Alternative_Titles: Eastman; E Poi lo Chiamarono il Magnifico
Co_Stars: Gregory Walcott, Yanti Sommer, Dominic Barto, Harry Carey, Jr., Dan Sturkie, Riccardo Pizzuti
Synopsis_and_Notes: Directed by Trinity creator Enzo Barboni, this comedy stars Terence Hill as Sir Thomas More, an aristocratic English dandy sent west to become a 'real man.' Guided by three aging outlaw friends of his late father, the cultured newcomer bewilders local frontier bullies by overcoming gunfights and brawls with refined British etiquette.

Title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
Alternative_Titles: Il Suo Nome Gridava Vendetta
Co_Stars: William Berger, Evelyn Stewart (Ida Galli), Raf Baldassare, Eleanora Vargas, Robert Hundar
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen plays Drake, a brooding, vengeful gunman returning to his hometown to execute the three men who raped and murdered his wife. Finding the killers entrenched in positions of wealth and power under the protection of a regional boss, Drake methodically eliminates them one by one.

Title: Man Who Killed Billy the Kid
Alternative_Titles: For a Few Bullets More; I'll Kill Him and Return Alone; Hombre Que Mató Billy el Niño
Co_Stars: Fausto Tozzi, Dianik Zurakowska, Gloria Milland, Antonio Pica, Luis Prendes, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Spanish-Italian revisionist take on the Lincoln County War. Peter Lee Lawrence portrays Billy the Kid as a misunderstood youth forced into violence by circumstances and local corruption. Fausto Tozzi co-stars as Sheriff Pat Garrett, who is torn between his personal affection for Billy and his sworn duty to uphold the law.

Title: Man with the Golden Pistol
Alternative_Titles: A Man Came to Kill; Doc, Hands of Steel; L'Uomo dalla Pistola d'Oro
Co_Stars: Luis Dávila, Gloria Milland, Fernando Sancho, Umberto Raho, Oscar Pelliceri, Irene Mir
Synopsis_and_Notes: Finding the corpse of a notorious gunman, an outlaw on the run (Carl Möhner) assumes the dead man's identity and is hired as town sheriff by a regional marshal. Hoping to leave his criminal past behind, the new lawman successfully defends the community from a Mexican gang led by Fernando Sancho.

Title: Manhunt
Alternative_Titles: Mad Dog
Co_Stars: Henry Silva, Bo Svenson, Ernest Borgnine, Raimund Harmstorf
Synopsis_and_Notes: A modern-day neo-western produced in Italy. John Ethan Wayne (son of John Wayne) plays an innocent stranger who stops to water his horses on land owned by a corrupt rancher (Ernest Borgnine). After being framed by a crooked sheriff (Bo Svenson) and brutalized by a sadistic prison warden (Henry Silva), he escapes to wage a personal war of retribution.

Title: Massacre at Fort Grant
Alternative_Titles: Renegades of Fort Grant; Doomed Fort; Fuerte Perdido
Co_Stars: Mariano Vidal Molina, Marta May, Aldo Sambrell, Luis Villar, Cris Huerta, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: When their stagecoach is attacked by warring Apaches, newlyweds take refuge inside Fort Grant alongside other desperate survivors. Paranoia breaks out inside the besieged garrison when the officer in charge is falsely accused of being a traitor working with the hostiles.

Title: Massacre at Fort Holman
Alternative_Titles: Reason to Live, a Reason to Die; Una Ragione per Vivere... una Ragione per Morire
Co_Stars: Telly Savalas, Bud Spencer, José Suarez, Ralph Goodwin, Paco Sanz, Robert Burton
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Civil War adventure heavily influenced by The Dirty Dozen. Disgraced Union Colonel Pembroke (James Coburn) recruits seven condemned military prisoners, including a brawling looter (Bud Spencer), to mount a near-suicidal raid to recapture a strategic fort held by a fanatical Confederate major (Telly Savalas).

Title: Massacre at Grand Canyon
Alternative_Titles: Red Pastures; I Pascoli Rossi; Massacro al Grande Canyon
Director: Albert Band / Sergio Corbucci (as Stanley Corbett)
Co_Stars: Jill Powers, George Ardisson, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Andrea Giordana, Burt Nelson, Nando Poggi
Synopsis_and_Notes: An important historical curiosity codirected by Sergio Corbucci and Albert Band a year before Fistful of Dollars. James Mitchum (son of Robert Mitchum) stars as a young man seeking vengeance for his father's murder, finding himself caught in a violent range war over ownership of lush pastureland.

Title: Massacre at Marble City
Alternative_Titles: Conquerors of Arkansas; Alla Conquista dell'Arkansas
Co_Stars: Brad Harris, Horst Frank, Dorothee Parker, Ralf Wolter, Thomas Alder, Serge Marquand
Synopsis_and_Notes: Based on a classic novel by Friedrich Gerstäcker, this German-Italian co-production depicts the lawless chaos that engulfs Marble City following a major gold strike. A courageous rancher (Brad Harris) and a native chief team up to restore order when greedy claim-jumpers disguise themselves as Indians to massacre settlers.

Title: Massacre Time
Alternative_Titles: The Brute and the Beast; Tempo di Massacro
Co_Stars: George Hilton, John MacDouglas, Nino Castelnuovo, Tom Felleghy, Lynn Shayne
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lucio Fulci's first Eurowestern is a masterpiece of dynamic violence. Gold prospector Tom (Franco Nero) returns to his home valley after receiving an urgent summons, only to find his family estate taken over by a sadistic tyrant named Jason (Nino Castelnuovo). Allied with his alcoholic half-brother (George Hilton), Tom wages an explosive, bullet-riddled assault on the hacienda.

Title: Matalo!
Alternative_Titles: ¡Mátalo!
Co_Stars: Corrado Pani, Antonio Salinas, Luis Dávila, Claudia Gravy, Miguel Del Castillo, Annamaria Noe
Synopsis_and_Notes: An avant-garde, psychedelic western renowned for its minimal dialogue, distorted angles, and heavy fuzz-guitar soundtrack. A gang of ruthless outlaws takes refuge in a dusty ghost town where an enigmatic wanderer named Ray (Lou Castel), who uses Australian boomerangs alongside six-shooters, eliminates the invaders.

Title: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
Alternative_Titles: Chiedi Perdono a Dio... Non a Me
Co_Stars: Anthony Ghidra, Peter Martell, Cristina Iosani, Pedro Sanchez, Jean Louis, Lilli Lembo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A grim, uncompromising revenge drama starring George Ardisson as Cjamango. Returning home to find his father, brother, and sister ruthlessly murdered by an outlaw syndicate during a land dispute, Cjamango embarks on a merciless, blood-drenched campaign across the territory until every killer is dead.

Title: Mercenary
Alternative_Titles: A Professional Gun; El Mercenario; Revenge of a Gunfighter
Co_Stars: Jack Palance, Tony Musante, Giovanna Ralli, Eduardo Fajardo, Julio Peña, Bruno Corazzari
Synopsis_and_Notes: A classic revolutionary adventure from Sergio Corbucci. Franco Nero plays Sergei Kowalski, a polished European mercenary hired by a charismatic peasant insurgent named Paco (Tony Musante) to lead a rebellion against the corrupt Mexican regime, all while pursued by a curly-haired, sadistic bounty hunter named Ricciolo (Jack Palance).

Title: Minnesota Clay
Alternative_Titles: Minnesota Clay
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Alberto Cevenini, Georges Rivière, Antonio Casas, Joe Kamel, Diana Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sergio Corbucci's first solo western. Cameron Mitchell stars as Minnesota Clay, an aging gunfighter serving a prison sentence on false charges. Escaping custody, he returns to his hometown to prove his innocence and protect his estranged daughter, battling through shootouts while gradually losing his eyesight.

Title: Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
Alternative_Titles: Escondido; Dead or Alive; Minuto per Pregare, un Istante per Morire
Co_Stars: Robert Ryan, Arthur Kennedy, Mario Brega, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Spean Convery, Renato Romano
Synopsis_and_Notes: Alex Cord plays Clay McCord, a notorious outlaw afflicted with severe paralytic seizures. Seeking an amnesty offered by the territorial governor (Robert Ryan) so he can retire in peace, McCord finds his path blocked by a vindictive sheriff (Arthur Kennedy) obsessed with gunning him down.

Title: Miss Dynamite
Alternative_Titles: Where the Bullets Fly; Tutti Fratelli nel West... per Parte di Padre
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Lionel Stander, Marisa Mell, Peter Carsten, Franco Pesce
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively, comedic frontier caper where Antonio Sabàto and an eccentric group of wandering rogues get caught up in a chaotic scramble to locate a hidden cache of gold coins, constantly staying one step ahead of rival outlaws and an overbearing Mexican bandit chief (Fernando Sancho).

Title: The Moment to Kill
Alternative_Titles: Il Momento di Uccidere
Co_Stars: Walter Barnes, Horst Frank, Giorgio Sanmartino, Loni von Friedl, Renato Romano, Carlo Alighiero
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two rival bounty hunters, Lord and Bull (George Hilton and Walter Barnes), arrive in a frontier town searching for half a million dollars in hidden Confederate gold. The key to the treasure rests with a paralyzed young woman, drawing the pair into a violent confrontation with a ruthless town boss (Horst Frank).

Title: Montana Trap
Alternative_Titles: Potato Fritz
Co_Stars: Stephen Boyd, Anton Diffring, Friedrich Von Ledebur, David Hess, Arthur Brauss, Luis Barboo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rare German-produced comedy-western starring Hardy Krüger as Potato Fritz, an eccentric settler determined to cultivate potatoes on the frontier. Taking shelter inside Fort Benton with his companion (Stephen Boyd) during an Indian raid, he butts heads with a rigid Prussian officer (Anton Diffring).

Title: More Dollars for the MacGregors
Alternative_Titles: Few More Dollars for the MacGregors; Ancora Dollari per i MacGregor
Co_Stars: George Forsyte, Stan Cooper, Malisa Longo, José Jaspe, Charles Quiney, Luis Marin
Synopsis_and_Notes: When an outlaw gang slaughters a bounty hunter's girlfriend, the tracker allies with an enigmatic blond stranger named Blondie (Peter Lee Lawrence) to eliminate the killers. After the climactic gun battle, Blondie reveals that the murdered woman was his sister, leading to a personal confrontation over negligence.

Title: Murieta
Alternative_Titles: Vendetta; Joaquin Murieta
Co_Stars: Arthur Kennedy, Diana Lorys, Sara Lezana, Roberto Camardiel, Frank Braña, Pedro Osinaga
Synopsis_and_Notes: Jeffrey Hunter stars as the legendary historical figure Joaquin Murieta, a peaceful Mexican immigrant arriving in California during the 1849 Gold Rush. When his wife is assaulted and murdered by racist miners, Murieta loses his mind to rage, launching a wave of guerrilla raids across the mining camps.

Title: Mutiny at Fort Sharp
Alternative_Titles: Per un Dollaro di Gloria
Co_Stars: Elisa Montes, Mario Valdemarin, Umberto Ceriani, Hugo Arden, Julio Peña
Synopsis_and_Notes: During the American Civil War, a detachment of French soldiers accidentally enters Confederate territory in Texas and is integrated into Fort Sharp. The soldiers gradually realize that the paranoid fortress commander, Colonel Lennox (Broderick Crawford), is hallucinating an impending native siege.

Title: My Colt, Not Yours
Alternative_Titles: Four Candles for Garringo; La Mia Colt Ti Cerca... Quattro Ceri Ti Attendono
Co_Stars: Olga Omar, Vidal Molina, Cris Huerta, Maria Martin, Antonio Molino Rojo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Robert Woods delivers a frenetic, eccentric performance as Sheriff Garingo, a borderline-deranged lawman who takes on a corrupt saloon proprietor and town boss (Cris Huerta) running a frontier municipality with syndicate-like extortion tactics.

Title: My Horse, My Gun, Your Widow
Alternative_Titles: Domani, Passo a Salutare la Tua Vedova... Parola di Epidemia
Co_Stars: Claudie Lange, Chris Huerta, Luis Induñi, Pedro Sanchez, Carlo Gaddi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Craig Hill plays Dr. Janos Saxon, who robs a frontier security bank alongside partners only to be betrayed and stripped of the cash by a greedy bandit chief (Cris Huerta). Accompanied by a female companion, Saxon spends the remainder of the narrative pulling off elaborate ruses to reclaim the stolen funds.

Title: My Name Is Nobody
Alternative_Titles: Il Mio Nome È Nessuno
Co_Stars: Henry Fonda, Leo Gordon, Geoffrey Lewis, R. G. Armstrong, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A brilliant, elegiac masterpiece produced and conceived by Sergio Leone. Terence Hill plays Nobody, an agile, easygoing drifter who hero-worships aging legendary gunfighter Jack Beauregard (Henry Fonda). Hoping to give his idol a magnificent, historic sendoff into retirement, Nobody tricks Beauregard into single-handedly facing the 150-strong Wild Bunch.

Title: My Name Is Pecos
Alternative_Titles: Il Mio Nome È Pecos; Due Once di Piombo
Co_Stars: Lucia Modugno, Peter Carsten, Christiana Josani, Peter Kapp, Max Dean, Louis Cassel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Robert Woods stars as Pecos Martinez, a Mexican gunfighter who rides into a dusty settlement to settle an old score with Joe Kline (Peter Carsten), the ruthless syndicate boss who murdered his family years earlier. A grim, atmospheric revenge western featuring an uncredited appearance by George Eastman.

Title: Navajo Joe
Alternative_Titles: A Dollar a Head; Un Dollaro a Testa
Co_Stars: Aldo Sambrell, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Simon Arraga, Fernando Rey, Tanya Lopert, Cris Huerta
Synopsis_and_Notes: Burt Reynolds stars as Navajo Joe, the sole survivor of a massacre of his tribe by a gang of scalp-hunting bandits led by Marvin Duncan (Aldo Sambrell). Joe tracks the gang to the town of Esperanza, offering to exterminate the outlaws for a bounty of one dollar per head. Features an iconic, operatic vocal score by Ennio Morricone.

Title: Ned Kelly
Alternative_Titles: Ned Kelly: Outlaw
Co_Stars: Allen Bickford, Geoff Gilmour, Serge Lazareff, Clarissa Kaye
Synopsis_and_Notes: Rock icon Mick Jagger takes on the role of Australia's most famous bushranger, Ned Kelly, charting his transformation from an impoverished horse thief into a heavily armored folk hero waging an armed rebellion against colonial police oppression across Victoria.

Title: Nephews of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: I Nipoti di Zorro
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Dean Reed, Agata Flori, Pedro Sanchez, Ivano Staccioli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Italian comedy team Franco and Ciccio travel to Gold Rush-era California and falsely boast of being the legendary masked vigilante Zorro to impress local women. The ruse backfires when the tyrannical garrison commander sentences them to hang, requiring the genuine Zorro (Dean Reed) to ride to their rescue.

Title: Night of the Serpent
Alternative_Titles: Notte del Serpente
Co_Stars: Luigi Pistilli, Magda Konopka, Chelo Alonso, William Bogart, Franco Balducci, Giancarlo Badessi
Synopsis_and_Notes: An intense, claustrophobic drama directed by Giulio Petroni. A vicious bandit known as The Serpent (Luigi Pistilli) and his gang become trapped inside a frontier saloon following an attempted bank robbery, holding the patrons hostage while a lone gunfighter (Luke Askew) waits for the right moment to strike.

Title: No Graves on Boot Hill
Alternative_Titles: Three Crosses of Death; Tre Croci per non Morire
Co_Stars: Ken Wood (Giovanni Cianfriglia), Evelyn Stewart (Ida Galli), Peter White, Jean Louis
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Dirty Dozen-inspired western where a frontier priest (Peter White) recruits three convicted criminals—a womanizer (Craig Hill), a petty thief, and a mercenary—to help him clear an innocent boy sentenced to the gallows by uncovering the true murderer.

Title: No Room to Die
Alternative_Titles: A Hanging for Django; Noose for Django; Una Lunga Fila di Croci
Co_Stars: William Berger, Mario Brega, Riccardo Garrone, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Maria Angela Giordano
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen plays the stoic bounty hunter Brandon (Django in international prints) who forms an uneasy partnership with a Bible-quoting preacher (William Berger) to dismantle an illegal human-trafficking ring smuggling Mexican laborers into slave labor on local ranches.

Title: None of the Three Were Called Trinity
Alternative_Titles: Ninguno de los Tres se Llamaba Trinidad
Co_Stars: Fanny Grey, Margit Kocsis, Cris Huerta, Ricardo Palacios, Tito Garcia, Gustavo Re
Synopsis_and_Notes: A satirical comedy poking fun at the endless Trinity imitators. A young traveler named Jim (Danny Martin) is mistakenly arrested as a bank robber and must convince a dimwitted sheriff (Cris Huerta) of his innocence so he can pursue his dishonest cousins who stole his inheritance.

Title: Nude Django
Alternative_Titles: Django Nudo und die lusternen Mädchen von Porno Hill
Co_Stars: Donna West, Steve Allen, Edgar Wertz, Lynn Hall
Synopsis_and_Notes: An obscure German-produced softcore sex-western curiosity. Peter Graf plays an eccentric wanderer calling himself Django who lures a frontier dance-hall entertainer to his isolated cabin with promises of sharing a rich gold mine claim.

Title: On the Third Day Arrived the Crow
Alternative_Titles: Arrival Il Crow
Co_Stars: William Berger, Dean Stratford, Fiorella Mannoia, Lorenzo Fineschi, Richard Melvill, Lars Block
Synopsis_and_Notes: A family of frontier troubleshooters—Sally and her brothers Link and Tornado—investigate the mysterious disappearance of a gold shipment from a local mining company. They discover the robbery was staged by the mine owner himself, who hires a lethal assassin known as The Crow (William Berger) to silence them. When Tornado is slain, Link mounts a retaliatory strike, leading to an unexpected showdown with The Crow's vengeful brother.

Title: Once Upon a Time in the West
Alternative_Titles: C'era una Volta il West; Play Me the Song of Death
Co_Stars: Henry Fonda, Claudia Cardinale, Jason Robards, Frank Wolff, Gabriele Ferzetti, Woody Strode, Jack Elam
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sergio Leone's operatic masterpiece chronicling the inevitable decline of the Old West with the advance of the transcontinental railroad. A mysterious, harmonica-playing avenger (Charles Bronson) and a charismatic outlaw named Cheyenne (Jason Robards) protect a resilient widow (Claudia Cardinale) whose family was slaughtered by Frank (Henry Fonda in a chilling against-type villainous turn), a cold-blooded assassin executing land grabs for a crippled railroad tycoon.

Title: Once Upon a Time in the Wild, Wild West
Alternative_Titles: C'era una Volta questo Pazzo Pazzo West
Co_Stars: Vincent Scott, Dennis Colt, Malisa Longo, Lucky McMurray, Fiorella Magaloti, Dada Gallotti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A slapstick farce following two squabbling brothers who leave their impoverished farm to seek their fortunes in Carson City with their cousin Bill (Gordon Mitchell). Upon arrival, they discover the settlement embroiled in a violent feud between Bill and a local bully named Blackie, with the brothers stumbling through juvenile brawls and frontier scrapes.

Title: One After Another
Alternative_Titles: Uno dopo l'Altro; Day After Tomorrow
Co_Stars: Pamela Tudor, Paul Stevens, José Bodalo, Jolanda Modio, José Jaspe, José Manuel Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a frontier bank is plundered and its employees massacred, an unassuming stranger named Sam (Richard Harrison) arrives in town to avenge his murdered companion. Tricked by the crooked bank president into targeting a notorious Mexican bandit leader (José Bodalo), Sam eventually uncovers the deception and teams up with the outlaw to bring down the true conspirators.

Title: One Against One... No Mercy
Alternative_Titles: One by One; Ad Uno ad Uno... Spietatamente
Co_Stars: William Bogart, Dianik Zurakowska, Eduardo Fajardo, Alfonso Rojas, Aurora Battista, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peter Lee Lawrence plays Chico, a quick-draw marksman betrayed by his conniving partner Grayson (William Bogart) during a high-stakes scheme. When Grayson attempts to frame a regional town boss by extorting a confession under duress, Chico unravels the layers of treachery and tracks down his former associate for an icy final duel.

Title: One Damned Day at Dawn... Django Meets Sartana
Alternative_Titles: Quel Maledetto Giorno d'Inverno Django e Sartana... all'Ultimo Sangue
Co_Stars: Fabio Testi, Dean Stratford, Dennis Colt, Lucky McMurray, Simone Blondell
Synopsis_and_Notes: In the lawless outpost of Black City, a tyrannical town boss and his Mexican bandit allies operate a lucrative gun-running syndicate. Newly appointed sheriff Jack Ronson (Fabio Testi) arrives to establish order and finds an unexpected ally in a mysterious, watching bounty hunter named Django (Hunt Powers), culminating in an early morning street showdown.

Title: One Hundred Thousand Dollars for Ringo
Alternative_Titles: 100.000 Dollari per Ringo
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Luis Induñi, Gerard Tichy, Eleonora Bianchi, Lee Burton, Monica Randall
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Texas Ranger named Ringo (Richard Harrison) arrives incognito in a turbulent border settlement divided by two warring factions fighting over buried Confederate treasure. Maintaining order through precision shooting, Ringo plays both sides against each other to break the syndicate's stranglehold on the community.

Title: Outlaw of Red River
Alternative_Titles: Django the Honorable Killer; Django the Condemned; El Proscrito del Río Colorado
Co_Stars: Elisa Montes, José Nieto, Miguel Del Castillo, Jesus Tordesillas, Raf Baldassare, Anna Custodio
Synopsis_and_Notes: A former frontier lawman (George Montgomery) falsely accused of murder flees across the border into Mexico, becoming the chief lieutenant for a powerful regional general. Complications quickly escalate as he navigates the general's manipulative lover, an ambitious rival, and raiding bandits seeking to destabilize the territory.

Title: Paid in Blood
Alternative_Titles: Quelle Sporche Anime Dannate
Co_Stars: Donald O'Brien, Alfredo Rizzo, Krista Nell, Edilio Kim, William Mayor
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunter Tom Carter (Jeff Cameron) rides into Rio Canyon seeking retribution for the robbery and murder of his brother. Suspecting a saloon entertainer, he soon realizes she is innocent and joins forces with her to expose a ruthless gang of cattle thieves and land swindlers commanded by a vicious town boss (Donald O'Brien).

Title: Pancho Villa
Alternative_Titles: Challenge of Pancho Villa; El Desafio de Pancho Villa
Co_Stars: Clint Walker, Chuck Connors, Anne Francis, Angel Del Pozo, José Maria Prada, Luis Dávila
Synopsis_and_Notes: Telly Savalas stars as the larger-than-life Mexican revolutionary general Pancho Villa. After being betrayed in a fraudulent weapons transaction with American arms suppliers, Villa rallies his insurgent army, crosses the border, and launches a daring assault on a U.S. military outpost, culminating in a spectacular collision between two locomotives.

Title: Paths of War
Alternative_Titles: Sul Sentiero di Guerra
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Bruno Scipioni, Dick Palmer, Spartaco Conversi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A broad Civil War slapstick parody loosely spoofing The Red Badge of Courage. Lowbrow comedians Franco and Ciccio play two hopelessly cowardly Confederate army cooks who become separated from their unit and bumble their way through enemy lines, hostile outlaws, and native war parties.

Title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
Alternative_Titles: La Pazienza Ha un Limite... Noi No
Co_Stars: Sal Borgese, Rita Di Lernia, Pepe Ruiz, Ray Nolan, Peter Jacob, Carla Mancini
Synopsis_and_Notes: Cult horror filmmaker Armando De Ossorio directs this frontier comedy about a veteran cavalry lieutenant who has been denied promotion for twenty years due to a missing $20,000 gold payroll. The plot descends into farce when the original bandit's two illiterate sons locate the treasure map and wander aimlessly across the frontier.

Title: Payment in Blood
Alternative_Titles: Winchester for Hire; Blake's Marauders; Sette Winchester per un Massacro
Director: Enzo G. Castellari (as E. G. Rowland)
Co_Stars: Guy Madison, Enio Girolami, Louise Barrett, Rick Boyd, Rosella Bergamonti, Pedro Sanchez
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rogue Confederate colonel (Guy Madison) refuses to surrender after the Civil War, leading a ruthless gang of marauders pillaging the countryside while searching for a hidden Confederate treasury. An undercover government operative (Edd Byrnes) infiltrates the outfit to locate the treasure and neutralize the renegades.

Title: Pecos Cleans Up
Alternative_Titles: Pecos È Qui: Prega e Muori
Co_Stars: Luciana Gilli, Erno Crisa, Pedro Sanchez, Umberto Raho, Piero Vida, Carlo Gaddi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lighter, adventure-oriented sequel to My Name Is Pecos. Robert Woods returns as Pecos, who embarks on a treasure-hunting expedition into the Mexican wilderness to locate lost Aztec ruins and hidden gold, contending with rival mercenaries, booby-trapped temples, and opportunistic local bandits.

Title: Piluk, the Timid One
Alternative_Titles: Gun Shy Piluk; Piluk il Timido; Giurò... E li Uccise ad Uno ad Uno
Co_Stars: Peter Holden, Dan Harrison, Micaela Pignatelli, Luis Barboo, Livio Lorenzon
Synopsis_and_Notes: A unique revenge western featuring an elderly protagonist. When his only son, the respected sheriff of Boise, is murdered by the ruthless Mason gang, an unassuming old frontiersman named Piluk (Edmund Purdom) discards his peaceful ways and sets out on a methodical, calculated mission of vengeance.

Title: Pirates of the Mississippi
Alternative_Titles: River Pirates of the Mississippi; Agguato sul Grande Fiume; Die Flusspiraten vom Mississippi
Co_Stars: Horst Frank, Sabine Sinjen, Hansjörg Felmy, Dorothea Parker, Tony Kendall, Dan Vadis
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early German-Italian-French co-production revolving around a gang of river pirates who hijack a mail boat carrying a Cherokee land grant and take over a frontier trading town. Pioneers and local native tribes set aside their mutual distrust to join forces under an American frontiersman (Brad Harris) to liberate the river valley.

Title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
Alternative_Titles: Una Pistola per Cento Bare
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Gloria Osuna, Eduardo Fajardo, Victor Israel, Julio Peña, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: Wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit, a young gunfighter known as The Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence) is released and attempts to track down the true culprit. His quest takes a bizarre and violent turn when a gang of axe-wielding asylum escapees led by Eduardo Fajardo takes a nearby town hostage.

Title: Pistol for Ringo
Alternative_Titles: Una Pistola per Ringo
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Nieves Navarro, George Martin, José Manuel Martin, Hally Hammond, Antonio Casas
Synopsis_and_Notes: A genre-defining hit from Duccio Tessari. Following a violent bank raid, wounded Mexican bandit Sancho (Fernando Sancho) and his gang seize a wealthy hacienda, taking hostages. The local authorities enlist imprisoned gunslinger Ringo (Giuliano Gemma), an agile angel-faced marksman with a love for milk and money, to infiltrate the stronghold and orchestrate a rescue.

Title: Pistol Packin' Preacher
Alternative_Titles: Posate le Pistole Reverendo; Déposez les Colts
Co_Stars: Veronica Korocia, Floranna Di Bernardo, Richard Melville, Pietro Ceccarelli, Carla Mancini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A con-artist family traveling west stages an elaborate 'faith healing' miracle with an undercover Confederate deserter named Slim (Mark Damon). When the grateful town boss appoints the patriarch as the town's official minister, Slim orchestrates a series of fraudulent miracles and a staged resurrection to swindle the syndicate's wealth.

Title: Place Called Glory
Alternative_Titles: Place Called Glory City; Die Hölle von Manitoba
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Gerard Tichy, Angel Del Pozo, Marianne Koch, Jorge Rigaud, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: Pairing German cinema legends Lex Barker and Pierre Brice in an American-style western, the story follows a veteran bounty hunter and a dapper New Orleans gunslinger who meet on the plains and form a close friendship. Arriving in Glory City, their bond is tested when competing loyalties and a love triangle force them toward a high-noon showdown.

Title: Poker with Pistols
Alternative_Titles: Un Poker di Pistole
Co_Stars: George Eastman, Annabella Incontrera, Dick Palmer, José Torres
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bankrupt gambler named Lucas (George Eastman) incurs a massive debt during a poker game with seasoned player Ponson (George Hilton). In exchange for forgiving the loss, Ponson recruits Lucas to spy on a wealthy regional rancher suspected of running a large-scale counterfeit currency operation.

Title: Porno-Erotic Western
Alternative_Titles: Porno Erotico Western; Western Porno-Érotique
Co_Stars: Karin Well, Tomas Rudy, Lorenz Bien, Rosemarie Lindt, Patrizia Mayer
Synopsis_and_Notes: An exploitative hybrid production created by an Italian film distributor that took Mel Welles' 1970 western Requiem for a Bounty Hunter, excised portions of the original narrative, and inserted hardcore erotic footage to market the hybrid feature to adult theater circuits under a pseudonym.

Title: Prairie in the City
Alternative_Titles: Grossstadtprärie
Co_Stars: Günter Ungeheuer, Emilie Reuer, Hans Nielson, Georg Schlöb
Synopsis_and_Notes: An experimental, avant-garde German drama blending contemporary urban politics with frontier tropes. Two modern businessmen discover they are carrying on an affair with the same woman; deciding to resolve their romantic conflict in western fashion, they don full cowboy regalia and stalk each other with six-guns through city rush-hour traffic.

Title: Prey of Vultures
Alternative_Titles: The Artist Is a Gunfighter; Un Dolar Recompensa; Preda d'Avvoltoi
Co_Stars: Orchidea De Santis, Carlos R. Marchent, Andres Mesuto, Eduardo Calvo, Raf Baldassare, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peter Lee Lawrence plays Kit, a peaceful magazine illustrator with hidden, lethal marksman skills. After witnessing his father's murder during a stagecoach robbery, Kit relocates to a quiet mountain settlement, falling for the sheriff's daughter before discovering the lawman is secretly the mastermind behind the gang.

Title: Price of Death
Alternative_Titles: Last Gunfight; Il Venditore di Morte
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Alan Collins, Gely Genka, Franco Abbiana, Laura Gianoli, Luciano Lorcas
Synopsis_and_Notes: When local troublemaker Chester Conway (Klaus Kinski) is convicted of murder and sentenced to hang on circumstantial evidence, his attorney recruits retired bounty hunter Silver (Gianni Garko) to investigate. Silver exposes the true conspiracy, only to face Conway in a final duel after discovering he committed a separate unsolved killing.

Title: Price of Power
Alternative_Titles: Texas; Il Prezzo del Potere; Muerte de un Presidente
Co_Stars: Fernando Rey, Van Johnson, José Suarez, Antonio Casas, Warren Vanders, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: A political thriller allegorizing the JFK assassination within a 19th-century western framework. President Garfield (Van Johnson) is assassinated while visiting Dallas, and corrupt local officials frame an innocent black man for the crime. A lone frontiersman (Giuliano Gemma) uncovers the conspiracy orchestrated by wealthy former Confederate bankers.

Title: Pyramid of the Sun God
Alternative_Titles: Die Pyramide des Sonnengottes
Co_Stars: Michele Girardon, Gerard Barray, Hans Nielsen, Rik Battaglia, Gustavo Rojo, Teresa Lorca
Synopsis_and_Notes: The concluding chapter of Robert Siodmak's two-part epic based on Karl May's Aztec adventure tales. Dr. Karl Sternau (Lex Barker) and his loyal allies navigate Mexican revolutionary conflicts, hostile native tribes, and scheming French mercenaries to protect a sacred, ancient Aztec treasure cache.

Title: Quinta: Fighting Proud
Alternative_Titles: Quinta: Non Ammazzare
Co_Stars: German Cobos, Sarah Ross, Alfonso Rojas, Joe Karmel, José Marco, Roberto Camardiel, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rare and obscure Eurowestern directed by Leon Klimovsky that saw limited theatrical release during the late-60s genre glut. The narrative centers on a rugged frontiersman who relies on cunning and marksmanship to survive in a violent border territory dominated by opportunistic outlaws.

Title: Quintana: Dead or Alive
Alternative_Titles: Quintana
Co_Stars: Femi Benussi, Pedro Sanchez, John Levery, Marisa Traversi, Celso Faria, Spartaco Conversi
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Stevenson stars as Quintana, a masked, poncho-clad people's hero fighting for peasant rights in colonial Mexico. When his peaceful companion is framed for murder by a tyrannical provincial governor pursuing the man's beautiful fiancée (Femi Benussi), Quintana mounts a daring rescue mission.

Title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man... You're Under Arrest
Alternative_Titles: Su le Mani, Cadavere! Sei agli Arresti
Co_Stars: Espartaco Santoni, Franco Agostini, Helga Line, Aurora De Alba, Mary Zan
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Texas Ranger known as Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence) goes undercover as an eccentric traveling perfume salesman to investigate land-grabbing baron Mancino. Discovering the tycoon plans to evict local ranchers before the railroad arrives, Sando and an ally set a trap that culminates in a massive town gun battle.

Title: Ramon the Mexican
Alternative_Titles: Ramon il Messicano
Co_Stars: Wilma Lindamar, Jean Louis, José Torres, Thomas Clay, Renato Trottolo, Aldo Berti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A grim, violent revenge western. Ruthless outlaw leader Ramon (Jean Louis) raids the Baxter ranch, killing the owner and abducting his sister. When the woman's fiancé (Robert Hundar) is severely wounded trying to stop them, he recovers and infiltrates the bandit stronghold disguised as a priest during an open-air wedding ceremony to execute his revenge.

Title: Rampage at Apache Wells
Alternative_Titles: Uccidere a Apache Wells; Der Ölprinz
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Walter Barnes, Harald Leipnitz, Macha Meril, Antje Weisgerber, Mario Girotti (Terence Hill)
Synopsis_and_Notes: Part of the popular German Karl May franchise. Frontier scout Old Surehand (Stewart Granger) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) intervene when unscrupulous white speculators attempt to trick local tribes into an all-out war in order to seize valuable petroleum-rich lands.

Title: Rattler Kid
Alternative_Titles: L'Uomo Venuto per Uccidere
Co_Stars: Brad Harris, William Spolt, Jesus Puente, Femi Benussi, Aurora De Alba, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: Falsely accused of robbery and murder during a court-martial, Lieutenant Tony Garnett (Richard Wyler) escapes custody and tracks down the real culprits. Adopting the outlaw persona of 'The Rattler Kid,' he eventually joins forces with a determined sheriff (Brad Harris) to defend a frontier town during a bank raid.

Title: Reach You Bastard!
Alternative_Titles: The Django Story; Down with Your Hands... You Scum!; Giù le Mani... Carogna!
Co_Stars: Gordon Mitchell, Dean Stratford, Dennis Colt, Lucky McMurray, Jerry Ross
Synopsis_and_Notes: A notorious clip-show feature directed by Demofilo Fidani. In a border saloon, Wild Bill Hickok (Dean Stratford) meets legendary bounty killer Django (Hunt Powers), who recounts his most violent exploits, prompting a series of flashbacks repurposed from earlier Fidani westerns.

Title: Rebels of Arizona
Alternative_Titles: Los Rebeldes de Arizona
Co_Stars: Claudia Gravy, Michael Rivers, Luis Induñi, Dianik Zurakowska, José Truchado
Synopsis_and_Notes: A traditional Spanish-filmed frontier drama following a hardy community of Arizona pioneers. The settlers spend the narrative defending their isolated ranches and homesteads from repeated, coordinated raids launched by Mexican bandidos and hostile native tribes.

Title: Red Blood, Yellow Gold
Alternative_Titles: Professionals for a Massacre; Professionisti per un Massacro; Los Profesionales de la Muerte
Co_Stars: Edd Byrnes, George Martin, Milo Quesada, Monica Randall, Gerard Herter, José Bodalo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Three loyal rogue comrades—an ex-priest explosives expert, a sharp-shooting bank robber, and a Mexican horse thief—are dispatched into the desert to recover a stolen Confederate gold payroll and a rapid-fire machine gun hijacked by an unscrupulous mercenary officer (Gerard Herter).

Title: Red Coat
Alternative_Titles: Royal Mounted Police; Giubbe Rosse
Co_Stars: Lionel Stander, Robert Hundar, Renato Cestiè, Guido Mannari, Lynn Frederick
Synopsis_and_Notes: Inspired by Jack London's adventure stories and the success of Call of the Wild. Fabio Testi plays a courageous Canadian Mountie who, accompanied by his faithful dog, rescues an orphaned youth in the wilderness and protects him from harsh weather, predatory wolves, and a band of murderous renegades.

Title: Red Hot Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Les Aventures Galantes de Zorro
Co_Stars: Alice Arno, Evelyne Scott, Rose Kiekens, Ghislaine Kay, Evelyne Gatou
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lighthearted French-Belgian adult western comedy. Jean-Michel Dhermay portrays an amorous incarnation of Zorro who uses his swordsmanship, charm, and athletic wit to outmaneuver an authoritarian California governor while engaging in comedic romantic exploits with local women.

Title: Red Sun
Alternative_Titles: Sole Rosso; Soleil Rouge
Co_Stars: Ursula Andress, Toshiro Mifune, Alain Delon, Lee Burton, Capucine, Anthony Dawson
Synopsis_and_Notes: A landmark East-meets-West international co-production. When a treacherous outlaw (Alain Delon) robs a train and steals a ceremonial gold katana intended for the American President, a betrayed gang member (Charles Bronson) and an honorable samurai warrior (Toshiro Mifune) form an unlikely alliance to track the bandit across the frontier.

Title: Relentless Four
Alternative_Titles: I Quattro Inesorabili
Co_Stars: Robert Hundar, Dina Loy, Luis Induñi, José Jaspe, Raf Baldassare, John Bartha, Cris Huerta
Synopsis_and_Notes: TV's Batman, Adam West, stars as Marshall Garrett, an honest lawman who intervenes to stop a corrupt bounty hunter (Robert Hundar) from collecting an unlawful reward. Framed for murder in retaliation, Garrett must wage an all-out range war to clear his name and expose the true conspirators.

Title: Requiem for a Bounty Hunter
Alternative_Titles: Requiem per un Bounty Hunter
Co_Stars: Lawrence Bien, Thomas Rudy, Michael Forest, Steven Tedd, Giovanni Petti, Anna Bacchi
Synopsis_and_Notes: When an outlaw gang raids his farm and murders his family on orders from an extortionist town boss, homesteader Tom (Ray O'Connor) hires an enigmatic, flute-playing bounty hunter named Sabata to help him track down the perpetrators for a cold-blooded reckoning.

Title: Return of Clint the Stranger
Alternative_Titles: Ritorno di Clint il Solitario
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Marina Malfatti, Augusto Pesarini, Susanna Atckinson, Daniel Martin, Fernando Sancho
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Martin directs and stars, reprising his role as gunslinger Clint Harrison. Clint attempts to settle down peacefully with his family, but finds his quiet life shattered when an aggressive gang of cattle-rustling mercenaries (featuring Klaus Kinski) terrorizes the valley, forcing him to draw his guns again.

Title: Return of Halleluja
Alternative_Titles: The West Is Very Close, Amigo; Il West Ti Fa Stretto, Amico... È Arrivato Alleluia
Co_Stars: Lincoln Tate, Agata Flori, Raymond Bussieres, Riccardo Garrone, Roberto Camardiel, Nello Pazzafini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A fast-paced comedy-heist sequel to Heads You Die... Tails I Kill You. George Hilton returns as the dapper rogue Hallelujah, partnering with an eccentric strongman and an agile female thief to locate and steal a valuable Aztec religious idol amidst an endless sequence of double-crosses.

Title: Return of Ringo
Alternative_Titles: Ballad of Death Valley; Il Ritorno di Ringo
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Nieves Navarro, Hally Hammond, George Martin, Antonio Casas
Synopsis_and_Notes: An acclaimed dramatic sequel to A Pistol for Ringo loosely adapting the Odyssey myth. Giuliano Gemma plays a traumatized Civil War soldier who returns home in disguise to find his community seized, his father slain, and his wife held captive by a vicious Mexican bandit family led by Fernando Sancho.

Title: Return of Sabata
Alternative_Titles: È Tornato Sabata, Hai Chiuso un'Altra Volta
Co_Stars: Reiner Schöne, Annabella Incontrera, Pedro Sanchez, Mario Brega, Giampiero Albertini, Vasili Karis
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lee Van Cleef reprises his iconic role as the gadget-wielding bounty hunter Sabata. Working as a traveling circus marksman, Sabata arrives in Hobsonville and uncovers an elaborate municipal tax swindle orchestrated by an Irish town boss who is laundering counterfeit currency through local businesses.

Title: Return of Shanghai Joe
Alternative_Titles: Il Ritorno di Shanghai Joe; Zwei durch Dick und Dünn
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Tommy Polgar, Karin Field, Fausto Ulisse, Primiano Muratori
Synopsis_and_Notes: A comedic sequel to Fighting Fists of Shanghai Joe. Wandering martial artist Shanghai Joe (Chen Lee) teams up with a traveling medicine-show quack to protect a frontier town from a corrupt, cigar-chomping town boss played with eccentric relish by Klaus Kinski.

Title: Revenge for Revenge
Alternative_Titles: Vendetta per Vendetta
Co_Stars: John Hamilton, Loredana Nusciak, Lemmy Carson, Giuseppe Lavricella, Conny Caracciolo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bitter, cynical frontier drama. When an army major (John Ireland) discovers his unfaithful wife has given the location of his hidden gold cache to her outlaw lover, he kills her and embarks on a desert hunt to recover the treasure, resulting in a mutual shootout where neither man survives.

Title: Reverend Colt
Alternative_Titles: Reverendo Colt
Co_Stars: Richard Harrison, Thomas Moore, Maria Martin, German Cobos, Pedro Sanchez, Alfonso Rojas
Synopsis_and_Notes: A peaceful former gunfighter turned preacher (Guy Madison) arrives in Tucson to open a church, only to be falsely accused of an armed bank raid pulled by Mexican outlaws. An open-minded sheriff (Richard Harrison) grants him temporary release to track down the true gang and clear his name.

Title: The Reward's Yours, the Man's Mine
Alternative_Titles: La Taglia È Tua, l'Uomo l'Ammazzo Io
Co_Stars: Aldo Berti, Mario Brega, Rosalba Neri, Fabrizio Gianni, Maurizio Bonuglia
Synopsis_and_Notes: Robert Woods plays a hardened bounty hunter hired to capture an elusive fugitive alive so the man can stand trial. When unexpected violence forces him to shoot the outlaw instead, the story culminates in a bitterly ironic climax regarding who collects the reward.

Title: Rick and John, Conquerors of the West
Alternative_Titles: Rick and John in the Conquest of the West; Ric e Gian alla Conquista del West
Co_Stars: Riccardo Miniggio, Gianfabio Bosco, Francesco Mulè, Barbara Carroll, Tiberio Murgia
Synopsis_and_Notes: A military comedy following two bumbling Union army conscripts who are entrusted with transporting a wagon equipped with solid gold wheels to pay for cavalry horses. Oblivious to the wheels' true value, the pair trade them away to local natives, triggering an absurd frontier pursuit.

Title: Ride and Kill
Alternative_Titles: Sheriff Brandy; Brandy; Cavalco e Uccidi
Director: José Luis Borau / Mario Caiano (as J. L. Boraw)
Co_Stars: Robert Hundar, Lawrence Palmer, Pauline Baards, John MacDouglas, Luis Induñi, Antonio Casas
Synopsis_and_Notes: A syndicate of corrupt town officials hires a lethal assassin (Robert Hundar) to murder the local marshal and replaces him with the town drunk, Brandy (Alex Nicol), expecting an easily manipulated puppet. Reformed by his new badge and the support of a barmaid, Brandy takes a courageous stand.

Title: Ringo: Face of Revenge
Alternative_Titles: Ringo Volto della Vendetta
Co_Stars: Frank Wolff, Eduardo Fajardo, Armando Calvo, Alejandra Nilo, Alfonso Goda
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two adventurers (Anthony Steffen and Frank Wolff) rescue a wounded Mexican outlaw and discover half of a secret treasure map tattooed onto his back. Partnering to find the other half tattooed onto a local sheriff, the gunslingers become embroiled in a violent quest for hidden frontier gold.

Title: Ringo and Gringo Against All
Alternative_Titles: Rebels on the Loose; Ringo e Gringo Contro Tutti
Co_Stars: Raimondo Vianello, Maria Martinez, Monica Randall, Alfonso Rojas, Miguel Del Castillo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Civil War farce starring Italian comedy team Lando Buzzanca and Raimondo Vianello as two dimwitted Confederate soldiers stationed at an isolated frontier outpost who remain completely unaware that the war ended eight years earlier, continuing their sabotage operations.

Title: Ringo and His Golden Pistol
Alternative_Titles: Johnny Oro
Co_Stars: Valeria Fabrizi, Franco De Rosa, Andrea Aureli, John Bartha, Ettore Manni, Ken Wood
Synopsis_and_Notes: Mark Damon stars as Johnny Oro (retitled Ringo in international markets), an extravagant bounty hunter who uses customized solid-gold pistols and dynamite. When he arrests an outlaw chieftain's brother, the bandit gang lays siege to the town of Coldstone, forcing Oro into an explosive defense.

Title: Ringo, It's Massacre Time
Alternative_Titles: Wanted Ringo; Reward for Ringo; Ringo, Tempo di Massacro
Co_Stars: Omero Gargano, Peter Martell, Lucye Bonerz, Jean Louis, Anna Cerreto
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay stars as a determined frontier marksman who arrives in a corrupt territory to track down an elusive bandit ring terrorizing isolated ranches and mining transports, taking justice into his own hands when local authorities prove helpless.

Title: Ringo, the Lone Rider
Alternative_Titles: Two Brothers, One Death; Ringo il Cavaliere Solitario
Co_Stars: Piero Lulli, Dianik Zurakowska, Miguel Del Castillo, Alfonso Rojas, Jesus Puente, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: Citizens of Springfield hire a formidable wandering gunfighter named Ringo (Peter Martell) to protect their community from an oppressive gang of outlaws commanded by Bill Anderson (Piero Lulli). Ringo uses sniper tactics and quick-draw ambushes to eradicate the threat.

Title: Ringo's Big Night
Alternative_Titles: Grande Notte di Ringo; La Notte del Desperado
Co_Stars: Adriana Ambesi, Eduardo Fajardo, Walter Maestosi, Guido De Salvi, Tom Felleghy, José Bodalo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Jack Balman (William Berger) is framed by a town mayor and his corrupt associates for a $200,000 stagecoach robbery. Escaping custody, Balman infiltrates the corrupt network and systematically exposes the civic leaders who engineered the crime.

Title: Rita of the West
Alternative_Titles: Little Rita nel Far West; Crazy Westerners
Co_Stars: Terence Hill, Lucio Dalla, Nina Larker, Kirk Morris, Gordon Mitchell, Fernando Sancho
Synopsis_and_Notes: A pop-musical western spoof starring Italian singing sensation Rita Pavone as a quick-drawing female champion of justice. When she falls for a deceptive outlaw named Black Star (Terence Hill) who intends to rob sacred native gold, she embarks on an absurd series of musical numbers and comedic duels.

Title: Road to Fort Alamo
Alternative_Titles: Arizona Bill; La Strada per Fort Alamo; Camino de Fuerte Alamo
Co_Stars: Jany Clair, Michel Lemoine, Adreina Paul, Kirk Bert, Antonio Gradoli, Dean Ardow
Synopsis_and_Notes: Directed by Italian horror maestro Mario Bava. An outlaw named Arizona Bill (Ken Clark) leads a bank robbery disguised in Union uniforms, but redeems himself after being abandoned in the desert when he rescues a federal wagon train heading for Fort Alamo from hostile raiders.

Title: Rojo
Alternative_Titles: El Rojo
Co_Stars: Peter Carter, Nieves Navarro, Mirko Ellis, Annie Gorassini, José Jaspe, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: A mysterious, black-clad gunman calling himself El Rojo (Richard Harrison) arrives in a mining town to methodically assassinate four prominent local leaders. In the final confrontation, Rojo reveals that the corrupt men murdered his entire family years ago to steal their lucrative gold claim.

Title: Roy Colt and Winchester Jack
Alternative_Titles: Colt e Winchester Jack
Co_Stars: Charles Southwood, Marilu Tolo, Teodoro Corra, Lee Burton, Bruno Corazzari, Franco Pesce
Synopsis_and_Notes: Mario Bava directs an eccentric comedic western following two lifelong outlaw companions, Roy and Jack (Brett Halsey and Charles Southwood), whose partnership dissolves when Roy decides to become the sheriff of Carson City. The former friends must reunite to stop a deranged preacher searching for hidden gold.

Title: Run Man, Run
Alternative_Titles: Big Gundown 2; Corri, Uomo, Corri
Co_Stars: Donald O'Brien, John Ireland, Rick Boyd, Linda Veras, Chelo Alonso, José Torres, Nello Pazzafini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A direct sequel to The Big Gundown. Tomás Milian reprises his iconic role as the agile, knife-throwing Mexican peasant Cuchillo. Released from prison, Cuchillo must stay one step ahead of French mercenaries, federal agents, and American opportunists to locate a fortune in revolutionary gold.

Title: Ruthless Colt of the Gringo
Alternative_Titles: Gringo's Pitiless Colt; La Spietata Colt del Gringo
Co_Stars: Carlo Fabrizi, Martha Dovan, Pat Greenhill, Luis Induñi, Charles Otter, Germana Monteverdi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Wrongfully imprisoned for the murder of a mine proprietor, innocent gunslinger Sol Lester (Jim Reed) is released and returns to Paso City seeking retribution. Allied with the murdered man's daughter, he takes on the ruthless town boss who framed him.

Title: The Ruthless Four
Alternative_Titles: Sam Cooper's Gold; Every Man for Himself; Ognuno per Se
Co_Stars: Gilbert Roland, Klaus Kinski, George Hilton, Sarah Ross, Rick Boyd, Sergio Doria
Synopsis_and_Notes: A tense, character-driven masterpiece of suspicion and greed. Aging prospector Sam Cooper (Van Heflin) discovers a massive gold deposit and recruits his estranged adopted son (George Hilton), an old associate (Gilbert Roland), and a sinister blond mercenary (Klaus Kinski) to transport the ore, with lethal paranoia destroying their alliance.

Title: Sabata
Alternative_Titles: Ehi, Amico... C'è Sabata, Hai Chiuso!; Hey, Friend, There Is Sabata... You've Closed
Co_Stars: William Berger, Pedro Sanchez, Franco Ressel, Robert Hundar, Linda Veras, Spean Convery, Ken Wood
Synopsis_and_Notes: The film that coined the iconic tag 'The man with gunsight eyes'. Lee Van Cleef stars as the calculating, black-clad bounty hunter Sabata, who foils a $100,000 bank heist in Daugherty. Allied with an agile acrobat and an eccentric banjo-carrying gunman (William Berger) who conceals a rifle inside his instrument, Sabata blackmails the corrupt town leaders who masterminded the robbery.

Title: Sabata the Killer
Alternative_Titles: Viva Sabata!; Sabata Is Coming; Llega Sabata; Reza por Tu Alma... Y Muere
Co_Stars: Anthony Steffen, Eduardo Fajardo, Alfredo Mayo, Luis Induñi, Rossana Rovere, Alfonso Rojas
Synopsis_and_Notes: Young Peter (Peter Lee Lawrence) double-crosses an unscrupulous banker (Eduardo Fajardo) by stealing $300,000 in cash. He escapes with the assistance of two traveling rogues, Sabata and Mangusta (Anthony Steffen and Alfredo Mayo), who arrive in town driving a modern motor car. When professional killers hunt them down, the breezy comedy takes a violent, grotesque turn.

Title: Saguaro
Alternative_Titles: Sapevano Solo Uccidere
Co_Stars: Larry Ward, Alan Steel (Sergio Ciani), Gordon Mitchell, Kim Arden, Ana Castor
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peplum muscleman Kirk Morris stars as Jeff, an embittered Confederate veteran wandering through the southwest. When Mexican bandits ambush his party and murder his closest companion, Jeff assumes the identity of a territorial marshal and robs a local bank to finance his private vigilante army to eradicate the outlaws.

Title: Sartana
Alternative_Titles: If You Meet Sartana... Pray for Your Death; Gunfighters Die Harder; Se Incontri Sartana Prega per la Tua Morte
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Fernando Sancho, William Berger, Sydney Chaplin, Gianni Rizzo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko introduces the legendary archetype of Sartana, the immaculate, cloak-wearing 'Angel of Death'. After an army gold coach is ambushed by bandits and wiped out with a Gatling gun, Sartana manipulates the double-crossing conspirators—including a corrupt banker, a greedy widow, and rival bounty hunters (Klaus Kinski)—into destroying each other.

Title: Sartana Does Not Forgive
Alternative_Titles: Sonora; Sartana Non Perdona
Co_Stars: Gilbert Roland, Jack Elam, Tony Norton, Hugo Blanco, Gerard Tichy, Diana Lorys, Rosalba Neri
Synopsis_and_Notes: A somber revenge western blending the Sartana name with a classic family tragedy. When a ruthless outlaw crew led by Kirchner (Gilbert Roland) tortures and murders a young homesteader and his wife, the victim's vengeful brother, Sartana (George Martin), tracks the gang across the desert to execute them one by one.

Title: Sartana in the Valley of Death
Alternative_Titles: Ballad of Death Valley; Sartana nella Valle degli Avvoltoi
Co_Stars: Wayde Preston, Aldo Berti, Jolanda Modio, Alan Collins, Pamela Tudor, Carlo Giordana
Synopsis_and_Notes: William Berger stars as Lee Calloway (called Sartana in international prints), a mercenary hired to break three criminal brothers out of prison in exchange for half of their hidden gold cache. The brothers betray him after escaping, leaving him for dead in the desert until an enigmatic woman nurses him back to health.

Title: Sartana Kills Them All
Alternative_Titles: Lo Irritarono... e Sartana Fece Piazza Pulita
Co_Stars: William Bogart, Maria Silva, Carlos R. Marchent, Luis Induñi, Raf Baldassare, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: An unofficial entry in the series starring Gianni Garko as Sartana. The vigilante arrives in a frontier outpost to investigate a heavily armed smuggling ring that has been raiding military depots and trafficking weapons to outlaws, utilizing cunning traps, ambushes, and trick weapons to clear out the syndicate.

Title: Savage Gringo
Alternative_Titles: Gunman Called Nebraska; Ringo from Nebraska; Nebraska il Pistolero
Co_Stars: Piero Lulli, Yvonne Bastien, Alfonso Rojas, Paco Sanz, Renato Rossini, Frank Braña, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: A wandering cowboy named Nebraska (Ken Clark) takes employment at a sprawling ranch owned by a tyrannical cattleman (Alfonso Rojas) who is widely hated throughout the valley. Nebraska finds himself caught in a deadly trap orchestrated by the rancher's unfaithful wife and her lover when the local sheriff is assassinated.

Title: Savage Guns
Alternative_Titles: Tierra Brutal
Co_Stars: Paquita Rico, Don Taylor, Alex Nicol, Fernando Rey, Maria Granada, José Nieto, Victor Israel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Considered one of the earliest modern precursors to the Spaghetti Western boom, filmed in the deserts of Spain. A weary American gunfighter (Richard Basehart) attempts to renounce violence while living in Sonora, Mexico. When an arrogant land baron (Fernando Rey) slaughters his host's family, the gunslinger takes up his weapons to lead a bloody resistance.

Title: Savage Pampas
Alternative_Titles: Pampas Salvaje
Co_Stars: Ty Hardin, Ron Randell, Rosenda Monteros, Marc Lawrence, Fela Roque, Angel Del Pozo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Set in the rugged Argentine pampas during the late 19th century. Robert Taylor stars as an army captain tasked with escorting a wagon train of unruly women across desolate terrain to a remote frontier garrison to prevent mutiny among the soldiers, while fending off attacks from renegade deserters and hostile native forces.

Title: Scalps
Alternative_Titles: Sie Kämpft wie ein Mann
Co_Stars: Mary Galan, Charlie Bravo, Beny Cardoso, Albert Farley
Synopsis_and_Notes: One of the most graphic, brutal Eurowesterns ever made, directed by exploitation specialist Bruno Mattei. When an unhinged Confederate colonel (Albert Farley) orders the massacre of an entire Comanche village after the chief refuses to surrender his daughter, the surviving woman and an outcast tracker launch a savage, gory crusade of vengeance.

Title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
Alternative_Titles: Segreto di Ringo
Co_Stars: Marta Padovan, Mariano Vidal Molina, Frank Braña, Charito Tijero, José Canalejas, Tomás Blanco
Synopsis_and_Notes: Captain Richard O'Hara (German Cobos) leads a cavalry detachment that rescues a woman from a native ambush. Escorting her to Fort San Antonio to meet her fiancé, O'Hara clashes with the garrison commander, a ruthless officer intent on inciting an all-out Indian war to clear land for speculators.

Title: Seven Dollars on the Red
Alternative_Titles: Seven Dollars to Kill; Sette Dollari sul Rosso
Co_Stars: Elisa Montes, Fernando Sancho, Loredana Nusciak, Umberto Miali, J. Manuel Martin, Halina Zalenwi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen stars as Johnny, an embittered frontiersman who spends fifteen years relentlessly tracking down El Chacal (Fernando Sancho), the sadistic bandit chieftain who murdered his wife and abducted his infant son. The search culminates in a massive, brutal street battle and an intense physical brawl inside a slaughterhouse.

Title: Seven for Pancho Villa
Alternative_Titles: Los 7 de Pancho Villa
Co_Stars: Nuria Torray, Gustavo Rojo, Mara Cruz, Ricardo Palacios, James Philbrook, Pastor Serrador
Synopsis_and_Notes: Following a disastrous military engagement, wounded revolutionary general Pancho Villa (Ricardo Palacios) is rescued and hidden by a loyal band of supporters. Joined by a sympathetic American adventurer (John Ericson), the small band conducts guerrilla raids against government forces to reignite the revolution.

Title: Seven Guns for the MacGregors
Alternative_Titles: Sette Pistole per i MacGregor
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Agata Flori, Nazzareno Zamperla, Paolo Magalotti, Leo Anchóriz, Perla Cristal
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively, highly successful western following the Scottish-American MacGregor clan living on a sprawling ranch. When a vicious Mexican outlaw gang commanded by Miguel (Fernando Sancho) steals their prized horse herd and savings, the seven brothers unite to infiltrate the bandit stronghold and retrieve their stolen property.

Title: Seven Guns for Timothy
Alternative_Titles: Seven Magnificent Guns; Siete Pistolas para Timothy; Sette Magnifiche Pistole
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Evelyn Stewart, Daniel Martin, Frank Oliveras, Spartaco Conversi, Tito Garcia
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sean Flynn (son of Errol Flynn) stars as a frontier mine manager who narrowly escapes a massacre orchestrated by a ruthless bandit gang led by Fernando Sancho. Seeking to reclaim the mine, he recruits a specialized team of convicts and mercenaries in a Magnificent Seven-style campaign.

Title: Seven Guns from Texas
Alternative_Titles: Seven from Texas; Camino del Sur; I Sette Pistolaros del Texas
Co_Stars: Robert Hundar, Fernando Sancho, Gloria Milland, Jesus Puente, Paco Sanz, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dramatic survival journey across the desert. An armed escort—including a former convict (Robert Hundar), a seasoned tracker, and a doctor—accompanies a gravely ill woman (Gloria Milland) to El Paso for emergency medical treatment, fighting off repeated ambushes by outlaws and native war parties along the route.

Title: Seven Hours of Gunfire
Alternative_Titles: Adventures in the West; Sette Ore di Fuoco
Co_Stars: Adrian Hoven, Elga Sommerfeld, Gloria Milland, Carlos R. Marchent, Helga Line, Alfonso Rojas
Synopsis_and_Notes: A multi-character frontier actioner bringing together legendary folk heroes Buffalo Bill (Rick Van Nutter), Wild Bill Hickok (Adrian Hoven), and Calamity Jane (Gloria Milland). The trio joins forces to broker a peace treaty between indigenous chiefs and frontier pioneers before a rogue attack sparks open war.

Title: Seven Nuns in Kansas City
Alternative_Titles: Sette Monache a Kansas City
Co_Stars: Paul McCray, Lea Gargano, Tony DeLeo, Pedro Sanchez, Irta D'Angelis, Bruno Boschetti
Synopsis_and_Notes: An eccentric slapstick farce about two bumbling prospectors who stumble upon a rich gold vein after a wagon crash. When their claim is invaded by outlaws and regional bandits, the pursuit spills into a peaceful frontier convent, where the resident nuns take up kitchenware and tools to defend their grounds.

Title: Seven Pistols for a Gringo
Alternative_Titles: Sette Pistole per el Gringo
Co_Stars: Gérard Landry, Fernando Rubio, Marta May, Albert Farley, Patricia Loran
Synopsis_and_Notes: Framed for the murder of a professional card player by a corrupt town boss (Albert Farley), a young traveler named Dan (Dan Harrison) goes into hiding inside the covered wagon of an eccentric traveling dentist. Biding his time, Dan methodically uncovers the evidence needed to clear his name in a final street shootout.

Title: Shadow of Sartana... Shadow of Your Death
Alternative_Titles: Meet the Sign of the Cross; Passa Sartana... È l'Ombra della Tua Morte
Co_Stars: Dennys Colt, Simone Blondell, Frank Fargas, Dino Strano, Miles Deem (Demofilo Fidani), Elisabetta Fanti
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunter Sartana (Jeff Cameron) is targeted with a $10,000 price on his head by corrupt authorities. Seeking amnesty, he accepts an offer from territorial politicians to eliminate the vicious Randal brothers and an outlaw gang terrorizing the border. Notably features director Demofilo Fidani acting on-screen as a talkative mayor.

Title: Shadow of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Zorro the Avenger; L'Ombra di Zorro; La Venganza del Zorro
Co_Stars: Maria Luz Galicia, Mario Feliciani, Marco Tulli, Robert Hundar, Raf Baldassare, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: In 1830s Spanish California, Don José (Frank Latimore) secretly adopts the mask and cape of El Zorro to protect the impoverished citizenry of San Pueblo from an extortionist bandit crew led by the ruthless Chinto (Raf Baldassare), who operates with impunity due to corrupt local officials.

Title: Shalako
Alternative_Titles: Shalako
Co_Stars: Brigitte Bardot, Stephen Boyd, Woody Strode, Jack Hawkins, Peter Van Eyck, Honor Blackman
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sean Connery plays Shalako, a seasoned frontier scout who encounters an aristocratic safari of wealthy European tourists hunting big game in Apache territory. When their double-crossing guide (Stephen Boyd) abandons them, Shalako must shepherd the helpless aristocrats through hostile desert terrain, culminating in a hand-to-hand fight with an Apache warrior (Woody Strode).

Title: Shango
Alternative_Titles: Shango, la Pistola Infallibile
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Maurice Poli, Barbara Nelli, Andrea Scotti, Massimo Carrocci, Franco Pesce
Synopsis_and_Notes: Texas Ranger Shango (Anthony Steffen) rides into a frontier town dominated by a rogue Confederate officer (Eduardo Fajardo) who refuses to accept the South's surrender. Teaming up with a local bandit gang to locate buried gold, the tyrant finds his empire challenged when Shango launches an undercover campaign to free the oppressed citizens.

Title: Sheriff of Rock Spring
Alternative_Titles: Lo Sceriffo di Rock Spring
Co_Stars: Cosetta Greco, Donald O'Brien, Maria Morgan, Marino Sidri
Synopsis_and_Notes: A seasoned gunfighter (Richard Harrison) hangs up his weapons and retires to the peaceful community of Rock Spring, where the grateful citizens appoint him town sheriff. His hopes for a tranquil life are ruined when a crooked banker conspires with saloon outlaws to violently seize regional property.

Title: Sheriff Was a Lady
Alternative_Titles: In the Wild West; Freddy und das Lied der Prärie
Co_Stars: Mamie Van Doren, Rik Battaglia, Beba Loncar, Trude Herr, Carlo Croccolo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A colorful German-produced musical western.
