German pop idol Freddy Quinn plays a naive-seeming young man hunting down the bandit gang (led by Rik Battaglia) responsible for slaying his parents. Teaming up with a glamorous saloon entertainer (American bombshell Mamie Van Doren), they hatch a scheme to install her as sheriff to trap the killers.

Title: Sheriff with the Gold
Alternative_Titles: Uno Sceriffo Tutto d'Oro
Co_Stars: Jacques Berthier, Kathleen Parker, Bob Messenger, Ares Lucky, Ivan Scratuglia
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a notorious bandit is scheduled for execution, a corrupt federal marshal steps in with forged documents to stay the hanging. The rescue turns out to be part of the lawman's elaborate plan to force the prisoner to guide him to a buried cache of stolen gold bars.

Title: Sheriff Won't Shoot
Alternative_Titles: Lo Sceriffo Che Non Spara; Poker d'As pour Django; Poker d'Assi per Django
Co_Stars: Vincente Cashino, Dan Clark, Manuel Zarzo, Pilar Clemens, Angel Ter, Sancho Garcia
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peplum bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay stars as a pacifist frontier sheriff who has long avoided lethal gunplay. His peaceful resolve is shattered when he discovers that his reckless younger brother has fallen in with an aggressive outlaw outfit, forcing the lawman into a final showdown to save his family.

Title: Shoot, Gringo... Shoot!
Alternative_Titles: The Longest Hunt; Rainbow; Spara, Gringo, Spara; Tire, Django, Tire
Co_Stars: Fabrizio Moroni, Keenan Wynn, Folco Lulli, Erika Blanc, Rik Battaglia, Gigi Bonos
Music: Sante Maria Romitelli (as Richard Ira Silver)
Synopsis_and_Notes: A famous gunman named Stark (Brian Kelly) is hired by a wealthy Mexican landowner to retrieve his wayward son, who has joined an outlaw gang led by a former Union officer (Keenan Wynn). After bringing the youth back, Stark is horrified to discover the father intends to crucify the boy over an infidelity accusation, prompting the gunslinger to intervene.

Title: Shoot Joe, and Shoot Again
Alternative_Titles: Joe Dakota; Joe Dakota, Spara... e Così Sia
Co_Stars: José Torres, Franca Polesello, Indio Gonzales, Rick Boyd, Roberto Maldera
Synopsis_and_Notes: Richard Harrison stars as Joe Dakota, an undercover operative hunting down an elusive outlaw gang that stole a fortune in gold coins. Captured and tortured by the bandits, Joe miraculously survives to settle the score during an explosive final shootout at their mountain hideout.

Title: Shoot the Living... Pray for the Dead
Alternative_Titles: Pray to Kill and Return Alive; Prega per il Morto e Ammazza il Vivo
Co_Stars: Victoria Zinny, Paul Sullivan, Dean Stratford, Ares Lucky, Anthony Rock, Aldo Barberito
Synopsis_and_Notes: Following a successful $100,000 bank heist in Phoenix, an outlaw gang hole up at an isolated border waystation. Tensions and power struggles erupt between gang leaders (Klaus Kinski and Dean Stratford), while an apparently innocent trail guide (Paul Sullivan) secretly bides his time to avenge his murdered parents.

Title: Shoot to Kill
Alternative_Titles: Texas Jim; Se Sparo... Ti Uccido; Cuatreros
Co_Stars: Frank Latimore, Fernando Sancho, Silvia Solar, Luis Induñi, Santiago Rivero, Laura Granados
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early Spanish-Italian co-production centering on an intense romantic rivalry. A dedicated ranch foreman (Edmund Purdom) falls in love with his employer's daughter (Silvia Solar), but finds his courtship contested by the rancher's outlaw nephew (Frank Latimore), culminating in a fiery battle inside a burning barn.

Title: Shotgun
Alternative_Titles: Vengeance Is My Forgiveness; La Vendetta È il Mio Perdono
Co_Stars: Erika Blanc, Piero Lulli, Mimmo Palmara, Daniele Vargas, Renato Romano
Synopsis_and_Notes: American actor Tab Hunter plays Sheriff Durango, whose quiet retirement plans are ruined when four masked marauders slaughter his fiancée and her family. Spiraling into despair, Durango is pulled together by a compassionate saloon owner (Erika Blanc) and uncovers that respected town businessmen were behind the raid.

Title: Shots Ring Out!
Alternative_Titles: Four Bullets for Joe; Si Udirono Quattro Colpi di Fucile
Co_Stars: Fred Canow (Fernando Casanova), Liz Poitel, Barbara Nelli, Angela Cavo, Francisco Moran
Synopsis_and_Notes: A murder-mystery western where a female wanderer is convicted of slaying a local man. When her brother, gunfighter Frank Dalton (Paul Piaget), arrives in town, key witnesses and jury members are systematically assassinated, forcing the town sheriff to uncover the true killer before a lynch mob acts.

Title: Showdown for a Badman
Alternative_Titles: Nevada Kid; Coffin Full of Dollars; Per una Bara Piena di Dollari
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Gordon Mitchell, Jeff Cameron, Ray Saunders, Simone Blondell, Dennis Colt
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunters Nevada (Hunt Powers) and his unnamed companion (Jeff Cameron) team up to dismantle an outlaw outfit commanded by the sadistic Hagen (Gordon Mitchell). Known for its energetic ensemble cast including Klaus Kinski and stylized cinematography by Aristide Massaccesi.

Title: Sign of Coyote
Alternative_Titles: Vengador of California; Il Segno di Coyote
Co_Stars: Maria Luz Galicia, Mario Feliciani, Piero Lulli, Giulia Rubini, Fernando Sancho, José Jaspe
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively adventure patterned on the Zorro myth. In 19th-century Spanish California, an agile masked vigilante known as Coyote (Fernand Canova) relies on pistols, traps, and disguises to frustrate an oppressive provincial governor and protect local peasants from unjust taxes.

Title: Sign of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Il Segno di Zorro
Co_Stars: Folco Lulli, Gaby André, Enrique Diosdado, Armando Calvo, Helga Line, Danielle De Metz
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sean Flynn portrays Don Ramon, who returns to his ancestral home in colonial Mexico to discover his father assassinated by an illegitimate dictator. Donning a black mask and cape, Ramon becomes Zorro, leading a grassroots underground resistance against the tyrant's troops.

Title: Silver Saddle
Alternative_Titles: They Died with Their Boots On; Sella d'Argento
Co_Stars: Sven Valsecchi, Ettore Manni, Donald O'Brien, Aldo Sambrell, Cinzia Monreale, Licinia Lentini
Music: Franco Bixio / Fabio Frizzi / Vince Tempera
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lucio Fulci directs an emotional, beautifully crafted late-era western. After killing his father's murderer as a boy, Roy Blood (Giuliano Gemma) grows up to become a legendary bounty hunter. When a job goes wrong, Roy rescues an orphaned child related to his sworn enemies, protecting the youth from a sadistic gang of kidnappers.

Title: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof
Alternative_Titles: . . .E per Tetto un Cielo di Stelle
Co_Stars: Mario Adorf, Magda Konopka, Anthony Dawson, Rick Boyd, Cris Huerta, Julie Menard
Synopsis_and_Notes: A breezy, episodic buddy adventure from Giulio Petroni. Giuliano Gemma and Mario Adorf star as two mismatched vagabonds—a nimble gunfighter and a lumbering drifter—who tumble into a series of comedic scrapes involving traveling circuses, card cheats, and pursuing outlaws.

Title: Sometimes Life Is Hard, Right Providence?
Alternative_Titles: Life Is Tough, Eh Providence?; La Vita, a Volte, È Molto Dura, Vero Provvidenza?
Co_Stars: Gregg Palmer, Janet Agren, Maurice Poli, Ken Wood (Giovanni Cianfriglia), Carla Mancini, Paul Müller
Synopsis_and_Notes: Tomás Milian plays Providence, an eccentric, bowler-hatted, umbrella-wielding bounty hunter patterned after Charlie Chaplin. Teaming up with a brutish outlaw named Hurricane Kid (Gregg Palmer), Providence repeatedly turns his partner in for rewards, springs him from jail, and moves on to the next town to repeat the scam.

Title: Son of a Gunfighter
Alternative_Titles: El Hijo del Pistolero
Co_Stars: Kieron Moore, Fernando Rey, James Philbrook, Maria Granada, Aldo Sambrell, Antonio Casas
Synopsis_and_Notes: Russ Tamblyn stars as Johnny, a fast-drawing avenger pursuing an elusive outlaw named Ketchum (James Philbrook), the man who killed his mother. When he finally corners his quarry, Johnny discovers Ketchum is his biological father, leading them to unite to protect a Mexican hacienda from raiding bandits.

Title: Son of Django
Alternative_Titles: Vengeance Is a Colt .45; Return of Django; Il Figlio di Django
Co_Stars: Guy Madison, Ingrid Schoeller, Daniele Vargas, Pedro Sanchez, Andrew Scott, Bob Messenger
Synopsis_and_Notes: Years after watching his father (the legendary Django) murdered by an outlaw cartel, grown son Clint (Gabriele Tinti) rides into Topeka City seeking retribution against town boss Clay. A traveling preacher and former gunfighter (Guy Madison) steps in to mentor Clint and help him dismantle the gang.

Title: Son of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Man with the Golden Winchester; Figlio di Zorro; L'Uomo dal Winchester
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Elisa Ramirez, William Berger, George Wang, Franco Fantasia
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lighthearted action-comedy teaming Alberto Dell'Acqua as a dashing, masked folk hero alongside Fernando Sancho as his boisterous Mexican companion, combining acrobatic stunt work and gunfire to overthrow a regional tyrant.

Title: Specialists
Alternative_Titles: Drop Them or I'll Shoot; Gli Specialisti
Co_Stars: Sylvie Fennec, Mario Adorf, Françoise Fabian, Gastone Moschin, Serge Marquand, Gino Pernice
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sergio Corbucci's satirical take on late-60s counterculture. French rock icon Johnny Hallyday stars as Hud, a chainmail-vested gunfighter who rides into the corrupt town of Blackstone to investigate his brother's lynching, contending with a sanctimonious elite, greedy bankers, and an unruly commune of young hippies.

Title: Sting of the West
Alternative_Titles: Con Men; Father Jackleg; Te Deum
Co_Stars: Lionel Stander, Timothy Brent (Giancarlo Prete), Eduardo Fajardo, Renzo Palmer, Romana Coluzzi, Carla Mancini
Synopsis_and_Notes: An energetic frontier comedy inspired by classic madcap ensemble capers. A fraudulent frontier preacher named Father Jackleg (Jack Palance) and an eccentric swindler (Lionel Stander) attempt to sell off a worthless mine deed, only to discover the claim is genuinely loaded with gold, triggering a frantic scramble.

Title: Stranger and the Gunfighter
Alternative_Titles: Blood Money; Là, Dove non Batte il Sole
Co_Stars: Lo Lieh, Karen Yeh, Femi Benussi, Julian Ugarte, Erika Blanc, Goyo Peralta
Synopsis_and_Notes: A wild kung-fu western co-production. A master safecracker (Lee Van Cleef) and a Chinese martial artist (Lo Lieh) team up to locate a hidden imperial treasure. The clues to the fortune's whereabouts have been tattooed onto the backsides of four different women, sparking a frantic chase across the frontier.

Title: Stranger in Japan
Alternative_Titles: Silent Stranger; Horseman and the Samurai; Lo Straniero di Silenzio
Co_Stars: Lloyd Battista, Kin Omae, Kenji Ohara, Yoshio Nukano, Rita Maura, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: The third entry in Tony Anthony's 'Stranger' cycle. The poncho-clad American gunfighter journeys to feudal Japan to deliver a sacred scroll for a $20,000 reward. Finding himself caught between rival samurai clans battling over regional control, the Stranger relies on his four-barreled shotgun to survive.

Title: Stranger in Paso Bravo
Alternative_Titles: Uno Straniero a Paso Bravo
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Giulia Rubini, José Jaspe, Pepe Calvo, Antonio Cintado, Adriana Ambesi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen stars as Gary, a quiet drifter who arrives in the border settlement of Paso Bravo seeking retribution for the murder of his wife and child. Despite facing public humiliation and torture from an authoritarian cattle baron (Eduardo Fajardo), Gary takes up his Winchester to settle the score.

Title: Stranger in Sacramento
Alternative_Titles: Uno Straniero a Sacramento
Co_Stars: Barbara Frey, Lucky Bennett, Gabriella Giorgelli, Big I. Matthews, Steve Saint-Claire, Aldo Berti
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay stars as Mike Jordan, an honest California rancher who returns home to find his family slaughtered and their livestock stolen by rustlers. When corrupt local officials refuse to investigate, Mike tracks the predatory land baron responsible across the Sacramento Valley.

Title: Stranger in Town
Alternative_Titles: A Dollar Between the Teeth; For a Dollar in the Teeth; Un Dollaro Tra i Denti
Co_Stars: Frank Wolff, Gia Sandri, Raf Baldassare, Jolanda Modio, Aldo Berti, Enrico Capoleoni
Synopsis_and_Notes: The film that launched Tony Anthony's iconic 'Stranger' character. A lone, poncho-clad opportunist arrives in an abandoned outpost seized by a Mexican bandit crew led by Aguilar (Frank Wolff). After helping the outlaws ambush a military gold convoy, the Stranger is betrayed and beaten, returning to reclaim the loot.

Title: Stranger Returns
Alternative_Titles: Shoot First, Laugh Last; Un Uomo, un Cavallo, una Pistola
Co_Stars: Dan Vadis, Marco Guglielmi, Jill Banner, Marina Berti, Raf Baldassare, Luciano Catenacci
Synopsis_and_Notes: Tony Anthony returns as the witty, pragmatic Stranger. Armed with his signature four-barrel pistol, he pursues a murderous bandit gang led by En Plein (Dan Vadis) that has hijacked a stagecoach. Discovering the carriage itself is constructed of solid gold, the Stranger methodically outwits the thieves.

Title: Stranger That Kneels Beside the Shadow of a Corpse
Alternative_Titles: Inginocchiati Straniero... i Cadaveri non Fanno Ombra
Co_Stars: Chet Davis, Gordon Mitchell, Dennys Colt, Simone Blondell, Ettore Manni
Synopsis_and_Notes: Boasting one of the most poetic titles in Italian cult cinema, this surreal outing follows a quiet bounty hunter (Hunt Powers) being tracked across the desert by a mysterious adversary (Chet Davis). The two men cross paths in an oppressed mining outpost controlled by a tyrannical boss (Gordon Mitchell).

Title: Sugar Colt
Alternative_Titles: Sugar Colt
Co_Stars: James Parker, Soledad Miranda, Julian Rafferty, George Rigaud, Victor Israel, Jeanne Oak
Synopsis_and_Notes: A unique blend of espionage and frontier action. Undercover agent Tom Cooper, known as Sugar Colt, is dispatched to investigate the sudden disappearance of 130 Union soldiers. Disguising himself as an eccentric doctor in Snake Valley, he uncovers an extortion conspiracy orchestrated by a corrupt syndicate.

Title: Sunscorched
Alternative_Titles: Jessy Does Not Forgive... He Kills!; Jessy Non Perdona... Uccide
Co_Stars: Mario Adorf, Marianne Koch, Vivien Dobbs, Oscar Pellicer, Frank Oliveras, Antonio Iranzo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Former outlaw turned sheriff Jess Kinley (Mark Stevens) finds his town taken hostage by his old gang, led by the sadistic Abel Dragna (Mario Adorf). Blackmailed by his former comrades who threaten to expose his past, the lawman is pushed to the limit when the gang attacks the community church.

Title: Take a Hard Ride
Alternative_Titles: La Parola di un Fuorilegge... È Legge!
Co_Stars: Jim Brown, Fred Williamson, Catherine Spaak, Jim Kelly, Dana Andrews, Barry Sullivan, Harry Carey, Jr.
Synopsis_and_Notes: Following the death of their employer, two loyal ranch hands (Jim Brown and Fred Williamson) undertake a perilous trek across Mexico to deliver $86,000 in livestock profits to the man's family. They are pursued by a cold-blooded bounty hunter named Kiefer (Lee Van Cleef) and rival gangs of mercenaries.

Title: Talent for Loving
Alternative_Titles: Talento por Amor
Co_Stars: Cesar Romero, Caroline Munro, Topol, Fran Jeffries, Genevieve Page, Judd Hamilton
Synopsis_and_Notes: An eccentric western comedy based on a Richard Condon novel. Richard Widmark plays a notorious gambler who journeys into Mexico to claim an inherited estate, becoming entangled with a decadent local aristocrat (Cesar Romero) who believes his family is afflicted by an ancient Aztec curse.

Title: Tall Women
Alternative_Titles: Seven Vengeful Women; Donne alla Frontiera
Co_Stars: Maria Perschy, Gustavo Rojo, Rossella Como, Adriana Ambesi, Christa Linder, Luis Prendes
Synopsis_and_Notes: When an Apache war party massacres a frontier wagon train, seven surviving women take refuge inside a mountain cave. Led by a resolute pioneer (Academy Award-winner Anne Baxter), the unarmed women navigate the desert wilderness and native warriors to reach safety.

Title: Taste for Killing
Alternative_Titles: Lanky Fellow; Per il Gusto di Uccidere
Co_Stars: George Martin, Peter Carter, Fernando Sancho, Frank Ressel, George Wang, Diana Martin, Rada Rassimov
Synopsis_and_Notes: Craig Hill stars as Lanky Fellow, a calculating bounty hunter who tails money convoys, allowing bandits to raid them so he can eliminate the robbers and collect rewards from the bank. When an Omaha banker wagers a double bounty, Lanky takes on a bandit outfit commanded by Fernando Sancho.

Title: Taste of Violence
Alternative_Titles: Le Goût de la Violence
Co_Stars: Giovanna Ralli, Mario Adorf, Madeleine Robinson, Hans Neubert, Dany Jacquet
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early French-produced precursor to the Spaghetti Western cycle. A revolutionary leader (Robert Hossein) kidnaps the daughter of a Latin American dictator to hold her as political collateral, only for romantic bonds and moral dilemmas to complicate their survival trek through the mountains.

Title: Ten Thousand Dollars Blood Money
Alternative_Titles: Guns of Violence; 10.000 Dollari per un Massacro
Co_Stars: Fidel Gonzales, Loredana Nusciak, Adriana Ambesi, Fernando Sancho, Claudio Camaso
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko plays Django, a mercenary bounty hunter who refuses to accept any contract paying under $10,000. When an escaped Mexican outlaw (Claudio Camaso) abducts the daughter of a wealthy land baron and murders Django's lover, the manhunter embarks on a vicious vendetta.

Title: Tequila
Alternative_Titles: Fuzzy the Hero; Uno, Dos, Tres... Dispara Otra Vez
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Roberto Camardiel, Agata Lys, Maria Elena Arpon, Mirko Ellis, John Bartha
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen plays a deadpan gunfighter teamed with an eccentric, bumbling sidekick named Fuzzy (Roberto Camardiel). Arriving in a frontier outpost controlled by a corrupt town boss (Eduardo Fajardo), the duo uses quick-draw gunplay and slapstick antics to dismantle the extortion syndicate.

Title: Terrible Sheriff
Alternative_Titles: Two Against All; Due Contro Tutti
Co_Stars: Licia Calderón, Maria Silva, Raimondo Vianello, Antonio Molino Rojo, José Calvo, Fernando Hilbeck
Synopsis_and_Notes: A madcap early Spanish-Italian western farce. Two cowardly brothers (Walter Chiari and Raimondo Vianello) accidentally consume a rooster treated with an experimental super-strength formula. Becoming fearless gunslingers, they are appointed dual town marshals to rid Golden City of an elusive masked bandit.

Title: Terror of Oklahoma
Alternative_Titles: La Terrore de Oklahoma
Co_Stars: Delia Scala, Alberto Bonucci, Livio Lorenzon, Valeria Moriconi, Alberto Sorrentino
Synopsis_and_Notes: One of the earliest Italian-produced frontier comedies, directed by screenwriter Mario Amendola. A bumbling greenhorn sheriff attempts to bring order to an unruly boomtown, relying on slapstick good fortune to outmaneuver frontier outlaws.

Title: Terror of the Black Mask
Alternative_Titles: L'Invincibile Cavaliere Mascherato; Terrore di Masque di Indio
Co_Stars: Daniele Vargas, Hélène Chanel, Giselle Arden, Aldo Bufi Landi, Carlo Latimer
Synopsis_and_Notes: Cult director Umberto Lenzi helms this masked adventure set in 17th-century Spanish California. Pierre Brice stars as Don Diego, an unassuming nobleman who secretly dons a black mask and cape to champion the cause of oppressed peasants against an autocratic military governor.

Title: Tex and the Lord of the Deep
Alternative_Titles: Tex e il Signore degli Abissi
Co_Stars: William Berger, Carlo Mucari, Isabel Russinova, Aldo Sambrell, Flavio Bucci
Synopsis_and_Notes: Based on the iconic Italian comic series by Gianluigi Bonelli. Giuliano Gemma stars as Texas Ranger Tex Willer, investigating a mysterious arms-smuggling ring supplying weapons to Yaqui warriors. He uncovers an ancient occult threat involving green mystical rocks capable of mummifying victims.

Title: Texas, Adios
Alternative_Titles: Avenger; Goodbye Texas; Texas, Addio
Co_Stars: José Suarez, Hugo Blanco, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Livio Lorenzon, Luigi Pistilli, Elisa Montes
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sheriff Burt Sullivan (Franco Nero) takes a leave of absence to travel to Mexico with his younger brother to avenge their father's murder by ruthless land baron Cisco Delgado. During the showdown, a scandalous family secret regarding his brother's true parentage threatens to tear their mission apart.

Title: Texican
Alternative_Titles: Ringo el Texano
Co_Stars: Broderick Crawford, Diana Lorys, Luis Induñi, Victor Israel, Antonio Casas, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: Decorated war hero Audie Murphy stars as Jess Carlin, an ex-lawman living in exile across the Mexican border. When he receives word that his newspaper-publisher brother was assassinated by a corrupt frontier town boss (Broderick Crawford), Carlin returns to Texas to clear his name and take down the syndicate.

Title: They Call Him Cemetery
Alternative_Titles: His Pistols Smoked... They Call Him Cemetery; Gli Fumavano le Colt... lo Chiamavano Camposanto
Co_Stars: William Berger, Christopher Chittel, Franco Ressel, Nello Pazzafini, John Fordyce
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko plays the laconic, lethal bounty hunter known as Cemetery. Arriving in a frontier outpost, he assists two pacifist rancher brothers being terrorized and extorted by a predatory land baron named Duke (William Berger), culminating in a meticulously executed town shootout.

Title: They Call Him Veritas
Alternative_Titles: Lo Chiamavano Verità
Co_Stars: Pat Nigro, William Bogart, Enzo Fiermonte, Pietro Ceccarelli, Franco Garofalo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Mark Damon stars as Veritas, an educated, smooth-talking frontier con artist who uses a handbook on how to get rich to orchestrate elaborate swindles with his companions. The gang successfully steals a stash of gold from outlaws, only to be outsmarted by the author of the very book they study.

Title: They Call Me Trinity
Alternative_Titles: Lo Chiamavano Trinità
Co_Stars: Bud Spencer, Farley Granger, Elena Pedemonte, Steffen Zacharias, Dan Sturkie, Gisela Hahn
Synopsis_and_Notes: The comedy that revolutionized the genre. The lazy, dust-caked drifter Trinity (Terence Hill) visits his horse-thief brother Bambino (Bud Spencer), who is masquerading as the sheriff of a quiet valley. The duo reluctantly bands together to defend a peaceful community of Mormon settlers against an aggressive cattle baron.

Title: They Called Him Trinity
Alternative_Titles: His Colt, Himself, His Revenge; Arriba Trinity!
Co_Stars: Gordon Mitchell, Maily Doria, Lucky MacMurray, Gastry Gay, Haim Bogart, Mike Monty
Synopsis_and_Notes: A low-budget vengeance thriller directed by Luigi Batzella. A lone gunfighter relentlessly tracks down the masked bandits who murdered his sister, only to discover the secret mastermind behind the gang is none other than his own brother-in-law.

Title: They Still Call Me Amen
Alternative_Titles: Mamma Mia È Arrivato Così Sia
Co_Stars: Sydne Rome, Alf Thunder (Alfio Caltabiano), Tano Cimarosa, Mila Beran, Renato Cestiè
Synopsis_and_Notes: A broad, slapstick sequel to A Man Called Amen. Rogue gunslinger Horacio (Luc Merenda) and his double-crossing partner (Alfio Caltabiano) continue their chaotic search across the frontier to recover their stolen loot from an elusive schoolteacher who swindled them.

Title: Thirteenth Is a Judas
Alternative_Titles: Il Tredicesimo È Sempre Giuda
Co_Stars: Maurice Poli, Dean Stratford, Maily Doria, Fortunato Arena, Giuseppe Bellucci
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gritty whodunit western where a seasoned former lawman turned bounty hunter (Donald O'Brien) arrives in an isolated territory to track down a sadistic, elusive serial killer known as the 'Monster of the Prairie'.

Title: Thirty Winchesters for El Diablo
Alternative_Titles: Trenta Winchester per El Diablo
Co_Stars: Topsy Collins, John Heston, Anthony Garof, José Torres, Mila Stanic
Synopsis_and_Notes: Cowboy Jeff Benson (Carl Möhner) is hired by a rancher to safely escort a massive herd across territory contested by the ruthless Mexican rustler El Diablo. After outsmarting the bandits, Benson leads an armed resistance aboard a gold train to eliminate the gang for good.

Title: This Man Can't Die
Alternative_Titles: Long Days of Hate; I Lunghi Giorni dell'Odio
Co_Stars: Lucienne Bridou, Rik Battaglia, Rosalba Neri, Robert Widmark, Steve Merrick, Peter Martell
Synopsis_and_Notes: Guy Madison stars as Martin Benson, a federal agent who returns home to find his parents slaughtered and his sister traumatized by a corrupt town boss (Rik Battaglia). Joining forces with his younger brother, Benson launches a calculated, cold-blooded manhunt.

Title: Thompson 1880
Alternative_Titles: Thompson 1880; Schneller als 1000 Colts
Co_Stars: Gian Sandri, José Bodalo, Gordon Mitchell, José Jaspe, Pedro Sanchez, Paul Müller
Synopsis_and_Notes: A mysterious drifter named Raymond Thompson (George Martin) arrives in Desert Spring to challenge the despotic rule of casino owner Blackie. Left for dead after a severe beating, Thompson recovers and straps on a custom rapid-fire prototype machine gun to wipe out the cartel.

Title: Those Dirty Dogs!
Alternative_Titles: Campa Carogna... la Taglia Cresce; Los Cuatro de Fort Apache
Co_Stars: Stephen Boyd, Howard Ross, Simon Andrew, Harry Baird, Dan Vargas, Helga Line, Lee Burton
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively, action-packed military caper. Three cavalry soldiers led by Chadwell (Stephen Boyd) are dispatched to Texas to quell an uprising by Mexican revolutionaries, teaming up with an eccentric bounty hunter named Korano (Gianni Garko) who uses specialized gadgets and trick rifles.

Title: Three Bullets for a Long Gun
Alternative_Titles: Friss den Staub von meinen Stiefeln
Co_Stars: Keith Van Der Wat, Patrick Mynhardt, Tullio Moneta, Don McCorkindale, Gaby Getz
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rare South African-produced western. A Yankee gunfighter (Beau Brummell) and a Mexican bandit form an uneasy partnership to uncover a massive cache of hidden Confederate gold, but their mutual greed quickly devolves into a deadly duel across rugged terrain.

Title: Three from Colorado
Alternative_Titles: Grave of the Gunfighter; Tre del Colorado; La Tumba del Pistolero
Co_Stars: Luis Dávila, Mercedes Alonso, Silvia Solar, Diana Lorys, Jack Taylor, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: Retired bounty hunter George Martin attempts to establish a quiet horse ranch with his family in Laramie. When an extortionist cattle baron and his gunmen attempt to drive them off their land, the gunfighter is forced to unearth his weapons to defend his home.

Title: Three Graves for a Winchester
Alternative_Titles: Tre Colpi di Winchester per Ringo
Co_Stars: Mickey Hargitay, John Heston, Milla Sannoner, Mike Moore, Spean Convery
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dark, low-budget vengeance entry pairing bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay with cult heavy Gordon Mitchell. A lone gunman seeks retribution against the outlaw gang that terrorized his frontier community, leading to a series of ambushes and cave shootouts.

Title: Three Musketeers of the West
Alternative_Titles: Tutti per Uno, Botte per Tutti
Co_Stars: Timothy Brent, Eduardo Fajardo, Karin Schubert, Cris Huerta, Leo Anchóriz
Synopsis_and_Notes: A comedic frontier adaptation of the classic Dumas novel. A bumbling greenhorn (Timothy Brent) joins three eccentric Texas Rangers escorting a secret operative (Karin Schubert) into revolutionary Mexico, battling outlaws to a quirky, eclectic musical score.

Title: Three Silver Dollars
Alternative_Titles: I Protect Myself Against My Enemies; ...Dai Nemici Mi Guardo Io
Co_Stars: Alida Chelli, Julian Mateos, Pietro Ceccarelli, Dada Gallotti, Marco Rual, Maria Mizar
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dying soldier gives a cowboy (Charles Southwood) a carved silver dollar, revealing that three such coins together mark the coordinates to a hidden treasure. The cowboy pursues the remaining coins, facing off against an outlaw chieftain (Julian Mateos) whose final gunshot defaces the coins forever.

Title: Three Supermen of the West
Alternative_Titles: ...E Così Divennero i 3 Supermen del West
Co_Stars: Sal Borgese, Frank Braña, Pedro Sanchez, Fernando Sancho, Antonio Casas, Agata Lys
Synopsis_and_Notes: A superhero fantasy crossover where three acrobatic, bulletproof heroes in tights and red capes are transported back in time to the 1890s American frontier. Recruited by federal marshals, the trio uses slapstick combat and acrobatics to thwart bandit chieftain Cucho (Fernando Sancho).

Title: Three Swords of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Sword of Zorro; Le Tre Spade di Zorro
Co_Stars: Gloria Milland, Mikaela Wood, Antonio Prieto, Franco Fantasia, Rafael Vaquero
Synopsis_and_Notes: In 1830s California, the legendary masked vigilante Zorro mentors his adult son and daughter in swordsmanship and guerrilla tactics so they can help defend local peasants from an authoritarian regional governor and his troops.

Title: Thunder Over El Paso
Alternative_Titles: The Godless Ones; Sentence of God; I Senza Dio
Co_Stars: Chris Avram, Erika Blanc, Paul Stevens, Pilar Velazquez, José Rivas Jaspe, Ken Wood
Synopsis_and_Notes: Antonio Sabàto stars as Minnesota, a black-clad bounty hunter stripped of his earnings by a ruthless Mexican bandit chief. Minnesota forms an alliance with a young outlaw to infiltrate the bandit's fortified compound and reclaim the stolen gold.

Title: Time and Place for Killing
Alternative_Titles: And Then a Time for Killing; ...E Venne il Tempo di Uccidere
Co_Stars: Jean Sobieski, Dick Palmer, Furio Meniconi, Felicità Fanni, Fidel Gonzales
Synopsis_and_Notes: A grim, methodical western following a determined frontier marshal (Anthony Ghidra) who defies legal orders and crosses the border into Mexico to track down the notorious bandit gang responsible for murdering his sister.

Title: Time of Vultures
Alternative_Titles: Last of the Badmen; Il Tempo degli Avvoltoi
Co_Stars: Frank Wolff, Pamela Tudor, Eduardo Fajardo, Franco Balducci, Femi Benussi
Synopsis_and_Notes: When an agile vaquero named Kitosch (George Hilton) is beaten and branded by his cruel cattle-baron employer, he flees to join an outlaw band led by a psychopathic killer (Frank Wolff). Horrified by the gang's sadism, Kitosch turns against them to defend his former home.

Title: To Hell and Back
Alternative_Titles: One More to Hell; Uno di Più all'Inferno
Co_Stars: Paul Stevens, Claudie Lange, Gerard Herter, Krista Nell, Carlo Gaddi, Paul Müller
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Hilton stars as a relentless avenger whose family was massacred during an armed ranch raid. He embarks on an obsessive pursuit of the ruthless outlaw leader (Gerard Herter) responsible, resulting in a cold-blooded trail of executions across the borderlands.

Title: Today It's Me... Tomorrow You
Alternative_Titles: Oggi a Me... Domani a Te
Co_Stars: Bud Spencer, William Berger, Wayde Preston, Tatsuya Nakadai, Jeff Cameron
Synopsis_and_Notes: Scripted by Dario Argento. Wrongfully convicted of his wife's murder by a sadistic bandit (Japanese cinema star Tatsuya Nakadai), an innocent man is released from prison and spends his fortune hiring four specialized gunfighters (including Bud Spencer and William Berger) to enact his revenge.

Title: Too Much Gold for One Gringo
Alternative_Titles: They Believed He Was No Saint; Lo Credevano uno Stinco di Santo
Co_Stars: Daniel Martin, Fernando Sancho, Tania Alvarado, Robert Hundar, Manuel Guitian
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bandit leader Rojas (Fernando Sancho) raids a Mexican chapel and steals the hollowed-out statue of a patron saint containing a fortune in gold. A wandering American gunfighter (Anthony Steffen) uncovers the secret and wages a solitary campaign to intercept the treasure.

Title: Torrejon City
Alternative_Titles: Torrejon City
Co_Stars: May Hetherly, Mara Laso, Mari Begona, Antonio Garisa, Venancio Muro
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early Spanish frontier comedy starring Tony Le Blanc as an inept, accidental sheriff who attempts to enforce the law in an unruly boomtown, relying on slapstick good fortune to outsmart a gang of cattle thieves.

Title: Town Called Hell
Alternative_Titles: Town Called Bastard; Una Ciudad Llamada Bastardo
Co_Stars: Telly Savalas, Stella Stevens, Martin Landau, Fernando Rey, Charlie Bravo, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: A brutal, existential British-Spanish production. A former Mexican revolutionary turned disillusioned priest (Robert Shaw) hides in a decaying border settlement ruled by a sadistic warlord (Telly Savalas), while a vengeful widow (Stella Stevens) and an army officer (Martin Landau) arrive to settle old blood debts.

Title: Trail of the Falcon
Alternative_Titles: Spur des Falken
Co_Stars: Hannjo Hasse, Barbara Brylska, Lali Meszchi, Ralf Hoppe, Helmut Schreiber
Synopsis_and_Notes: An East German 'Red Western' presenting the frontier conflict from the indigenous perspective. Yugoslavian athletic star Gojko Mitic portrays Dakota chief Falke, who leads his warriors in a desperate struggle to defend sacred tribal lands against corrupt gold prospectors and speculative rail tycoons.

Title: Train for Durango
Alternative_Titles: Un Treno per Durango
Co_Stars: Mark Damon, Enrico Maria Salerno, Dominique Boschero, Roberto Camardiel, José Bodalo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively adventure caper following two American rogues (Anthony Steffen and Mark Damon) who steal the keys to a secure train safe. When Mexican revolutionaries rob the train, the duo tracks down the guerrillas and an eccentric European aristocrat to claim a share of the gold.

Title: Tramplers
Alternative_Titles: Gli Uomini dal Passo Pesante
Co_Stars: Joseph Cotten, Mariel Franklin, James Mitchum, Ilaria Occhini, Franco Nero
Synopsis_and_Notes: Joseph Cotten plays an authoritarian Confederate patriarch who refuses to accept the Civil War's end, waging a private war of terror against incoming settlers. His sons (Gordon Scott and James Mitchum) are forced to turn against their father to stop the slaughter. Notable as Franco Nero's genre debut.

Title: Treasure of Silver Lake
Alternative_Titles: Der Schatz im Silbersee
Co_Stars: Herbert Lom, Pierre Brice, Götz George, Karin Dor, Ralf Wolter, Eddi Arent
Synopsis_and_Notes: The historic German production that launched the Eurowestern craze. Frontier scout Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) track an unprincipled gang of outlaws led by Colonel Brinkley (Herbert Lom), who murdered a stagecoach passenger to seize a map leading to an ancient tribal gold cache.

Title: Treasure of the Aztecs
Alternative_Titles: Der Schatz der Azteken
Co_Stars: Gerard Barray, Michele Girardon, Rik Battaglia, Teresa Lorca, Fausto Tozzi, Gustavo Rojo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Part one of Robert Siodmak's lavish historical epic based on Karl May. Dr. Karl Sternau (Lex Barker) travels to 1860s Mexico on a diplomatic mission for President Lincoln, becoming entangled in the Mexican civil war and a dangerous quest to safeguard a legendary Aztec treasure from French mercenaries.

Title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
Alternative_Titles: Trinity and Sartana... Those Dirty S.O.B.s; Trinità e Sartana: Figli di... Dio
Co_Stars: Harry Baird, Beatrice Pella, Stelio Candelli, Daniela Giordano, Carla Mancini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lowbrow comedy capitalizing on two major genre franchises. A black adventurer named Trinity (Harry Baird) and a bumbling bandit named Sartana (Alberto Dell'Acqua) bungle an attempted bank heist and inadvertently become folk heroes when they liberate a town from an oppressive outlaw gang.

Title: Trinity Is Still My Name
Alternative_Titles: Continuavano a Chiamarlo Trinità
Co_Stars: Bud Spencer, Yanti Sommer, Enzo Tarascio, Harry Carey, Jr., Jessica Dublin
Synopsis_and_Notes: The smash-hit official sequel to They Call Me Trinity. Brothers Trinity and Bambino promise their dying father they will become successful outlaws, but their soft-hearted natures repeatedly ruin their criminal plans as they inadvertently foil an arms-smuggling ring operating out of a frontier monastery.

Title: Trinity Plus the Clown and a Guitar
Alternative_Titles: Prima Ti Suono e Poi Ti Sparo
Co_Stars: Rinaldo Talamonti, Piero Lulli, Herbert Fux, Pedro Sanchez, Christa Linder
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Hilton stars as Trinity, a wandering gunfighter who travels the frontier accompanied by an agile circus acrobat and a traveling minstrel (Piero Lulli). The trio rides into an isolated border settlement and uses comedic combat and trickery to liberate the townspeople from a marauding bandit gang.

Title: Trinity Sees Red
Alternative_Titles: La Collera del Vento; Trinità Voit Rouge
Co_Stars: Maria Grazia Buccella, Mario Pardo, Maximo Valverde, Fernando Rey, Angel Lombarte
Synopsis_and_Notes: A politically charged drama starring Terence Hill as Marco, an aimless gunfighter hired by an aristocratic Spanish landowner (Fernando Rey) to assassinate union organizers. Witnessing the brutal oppression of the peasant laborers, the gunman shifts his allegiance and leads a violent agrarian revolt.

Title: Twenty Paces to Death
Alternative_Titles: Saranda; Veinte Pasos para la Muerte
Co_Stars: Albert Farley, Patty Shepard, Luis Induñi, Maria Pia Conte, Tony Chandler
Synopsis_and_Notes: Saranda (Dean Reed), a native orphan raised by a frontier mayor, falls in love with his guardian's daughter. Exiled from the settlement due to racial prejudice, Saranda returns to defend the community when he uncovers a treacherous plot by a corrupt senator to seize the town's gold mines.

Title: Twenty Thousand Dollars for Seven
Alternative_Titles: Kidnapping; Ventimila Dollari sul Sette
Co_Stars: Herman Lang, Aurora Battista, Fernando Sancho, Spartaco Conversi, Antonio Casas, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rare and obscure 1968 actioner starring Brett Halsey as a seasoned gunfighter hired to locate and rescue an abducted frontier child held for ransom by a notorious Mexican bandit gang led by Fernando Sancho.

Title: Twice a Judas
Alternative_Titles: They Were Called Graveyard; Due Volte Giuda
Co_Stars: Antonio Sabàto, Cristina Galbo, Pepe Calvo, Milo Quesada, Franco Leo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Antonio Sabàto stars as Luke, a gunfighter suffering from total amnesia after an assassination attempt. Returning to his family estate, he is manipulated by an unscrupulous land baron (Klaus Kinski), gradually recovering his memories to uncover the horrifying truth about who betrayed him.

Title: Twins from Texas
Alternative_Titles: I Gemelli del Texas
Co_Stars: Raimondo Vianello, Diana Lorys, Alfonso Rojas, Miguel Del Castillo, Bruno Scipioni
Synopsis_and_Notes: A frontier slapstick comedy featuring the Italian comedy duo Walter Chiari and Raimondo Vianello as two bumbling, identical twin brothers separated at birth who unwittingly swap identities in a lawless border town, confusing local marshals and outlaw gangs.

Title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
Alternative_Titles: Due Croci a Danger Pass; Dos Cruces en Danger Pass
Co_Stars: Anthony Freeman, Mara Cruz, Luis Gasper, Armando Calvo, Dianik Zurakowska, Jesus Puente
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a corrupt outlaw gang murders a frontier sheriff and his family, the only survivor—a young boy—grows up to become a lethal marksman known as The Kid (Peter Martell). Armed with a custom rifle, he returns to Danger Pass to systematically hunt down and execute each killer.

Title: Two Gangsters in the Wild West
Alternative_Titles: Two Mafiamen in the Far West; Due Mafiosi nel Far West
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Fernando Sancho, Aroldo Tieri, Hélène Chanel, Anna Casarès, Aldo Giuffrè
Synopsis_and_Notes: Franco and Ciccio play two Sicilian convicts who inherit a lucrative Texas gold mine from their murdered cousins. Escaping to America, the inept pair stumble through encounters with Mexican bandits (Fernando Sancho), native tribes, and scheming saloon con-artists.

Title: Two Gunmen
Alternative_Titles: Two Violent Men; Texas Ranger; I Due Violenti
Co_Stars: George Martin, Susy Andersen, Mary Badmayer, Mike Brendell, José Jaspe, Silvia Solar
Synopsis_and_Notes: Texas Ranger Robert Logan (Alan Scott) is ordered to arrest his childhood friend Cassidy (George Martin) on false murder charges. When the two discover that a ruthless female ranch boss (Susy Andersen) framed Cassidy to seize his land, they join forces to expose the syndicate.

Title: Two Pistols and a Coward
Alternative_Titles: Gunman Sent by God; Due Pistole e un Vigliacco
Co_Stars: Richard Wyler, Liz Barret, Ken Wood, Nello Pazzafini, Furio Meniconi, Gia Sandri
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gary McGuire (Anthony Steffen) is a brilliant trick-shooter in a traveling circus who is privately paralyzed by cowardice. When a town bully murders his friends and threatens an orphaned boy, Gary overcomes his fear, transforming into a ruthless avenger.

Title: Two R-R-Ringos from Texas
Alternative_Titles: Due R-R-Ringos nel Texas
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Enio Girolami, Gloria Paul, Livio Lorenzon, Hélène Chanel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Franco and Ciccio star as two delicate city dandies from Baltimore who travel west to take possession of an inherited Texas ranch, bumbling their way through shootouts with Mexican bandits and romancing glamorous dancehall performers.

Title: Two Sergeants of General Custer
Alternative_Titles: Two Idiots at Fort Alamo; Due Sergenti del General Custer
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Fernando Sancho, Riccardo Garrone, Margaret Lee, Moira Orfei
Synopsis_and_Notes: In this Civil War military comedy, Franco and Ciccio play two inept soldiers who accidentally infiltrate the Confederate lines as undercover scouts, running into hilarious complications with an alluring female spy (Margaret Lee) and Mexican bandidos.

Title: Two Sides of the Dollar
Alternative_Titles: Two Faces of the Dollar; Le Due Facce del Dollaro
Co_Stars: Jacques Herlin, Gerard Herter, Mario Maranzana, Andrea Bosić, Gabriella Giorgelli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A meticulous heist drama. A brilliant intellectual nicknamed Matematica (Maurice Poli) orchestrates an intricate robbery of a military payroll safe inside a fortified Union outpost, but greed and betrayal among his criminal partners turn the escape into a bloody disaster.

Title: Two Sons of Ringo
Alternative_Titles: Due Figli di Ringo
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Gloria Paul, George Hilton, Pedro Sanchez, Mimmo Palmara, Umberto D'Orsi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Franco and Ciccio play two petty swindlers pretending to be the heirs of legendary gunfighter Ringo to claim a $100,000 inheritance. Their scheme backfires when the will stipulates they must first hunt down and execute Ringo's fiercest enemy, the ruthless bandit Indio.

Title: Two Sons of Trinity
Alternative_Titles: I Due Figli di Trinità
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Anny Degli Umberti, Lucretia Love, Franco Ressel, Freddy Hungar
Synopsis_and_Notes: A late-cycle comedy parodying the Trinity series. Franco and Ciccio star as two clumsy frontiersmen who inherit an isolated property and stumble into an escalating conflict with local cattle rustlers and a corrupt saloon syndicate.

Title: Two Thousand Dollars for Coyote
Alternative_Titles: Dos Mil Dólares por Coyote
Co_Stars: Nuria Torray, Perla Cristal, Vidal Molina, Julio P. Tabernero, Alfonso Rojas, Rafael Vaquero
Synopsis_and_Notes: James Philbrook stars as the masked freedom fighter Coyote, operating in colonial California to defend small farmers and villagers against an authoritarian provincial governor and his corrupt military tax collectors.

Title: Ugly Ones
Alternative_Titles: The Bounty Killer; El Precio de un Hombre
Co_Stars: Richard Wyler, Mario Brega, Ella Karin, Hugo Blanco, Luis Barboo, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: Tomás Milian makes his genre debut in this acclaimed psychological western based on Marvin H. Albert's novel Bounty Killer. Milian plays José Gomez, an escaped Mexican outlaw sheltered by the good citizens of his hometown who remember him as a boy. Professional bounty hunter Luke Chilson (Richard Wyler) tracks him down, forcing the townspeople and Gomez's lover (Ella Karin) to recognize the outlaw's ruthless, cold-blooded transformation.

Title: Up the MacGregors!
Alternative_Titles: Seven Women for the MacGregors; Sette Donne per i MacGregor
Co_Stars: Agata Flori, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Cole Kitosch, Roberto Camardiel, Nick Anderson, George Rigaud
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lighter, family-oriented sequel to Seven Guns for the MacGregors. The Scottish MacGregor brothers and their sweethearts join forces once again to track down and recover their stolen savings from a band of opportunistic Mexican outlaws across the border.

Title: Valley of the Dancing Widows
Alternative_Titles: Das Tal der tanzenden Witwen
Co_Stars: Audrey Allen, Hugo Blanco, Harry Baer, Tilo Pruckner, Cris Huerta, George Rigaud
Synopsis_and_Notes: A satirical European western adaptation of Aristophanes' Lysistrata. When the men of a Texas frontier town return home after fighting in the American Civil War, they discover their wives have taken control of the municipality and instituted an organized sex strike to protest violence and militarism.

Title: Vendetta at Dawn
Alternative_Titles: Terrible Day of the Big Gundown; Quel Maledetto Giorno della Resa dei Conti
Co_Stars: Ty Hardin, Lee Burton, Bruno Corazzari, Nello Pazzafini, Costanza Spada, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: A violent, horror-tinged revenge western. Dr. George Benton (George Eastman) returns to Culver City from medical school, only to find the region overrun by ruthless outlaws. When a gang of sadistic cutthroats massacres his family, the physician abandons his peaceful Hippocratic oath to execute cold-blooded retribution.

Title: Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: Joko, Invoca Dio... e Muori
Co_Stars: Claudio Camaso, Sheyla Rosin, Lee Burton, Werner Pochath, Paolo Gozlino, Alberto Dell'Acqua
Synopsis_and_Notes: Richard Harrison stars as Joko, a gunfighter who discovers his close friend drawn and quartered by rival outlaws over a cache of gold. Taking the five severed rope pieces from the crime, Joko vows to return one to each of the responsible killers, culminating in a gothic, fog-shrouded cemetery confrontation.

Title: Vengeance Is a Dish Served Cold
Alternative_Titles: Vengeance Is a Dish Eaten Cold; Three Amens for Satan; La Vendetta È un Piatto Che Si Serve Freddo
Co_Stars: Ivan Rassimov, Klaus Kinski, Elizabeth Eversfield, Steffen Zacharias
Synopsis_and_Notes: Traumatized after witnessing his family slaughtered during what appeared to be an Indian raid, Jeremiah Bridger (Leonard Mann) becomes a ruthless native-hunter. Along the way, he uncovers that the attack was actually staged by a corrupt land baron (Ivan Rassimov) employing hired mercenaries in disguise. Co-stars Klaus Kinski as an opportunistic journalist.

Title: Viva Cangaceiro
Alternative_Titles: Magnificent Bandit; O Cangaceiro
Co_Stars: Ugo Paplisi, Eduardo Fajardo, Leo Anchóriz, Alfredo Santa Cruz, Jesus Guzman, Claudio Scarchelli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Set during the 1920s bandit uprisings in the arid scrublands of northeastern Brazil. Tomás Milian stars as Miguelin, an outlaw leader hailed as a folk hero by impoverished rural peasants. A corrupt military commandant (Eduardo Fajardo) hires a foreign mercenary to eliminate him before he can stage a regional rebellion.

Title: Viva Maria
Alternative_Titles: Viva Maria
Co_Stars: Jeanne Moreau, George Hamilton, Gregor Von Rezzori, Paulette Dubost, Claudio Brook
Synopsis_and_Notes: Louis Malle directs this lavish adventure comedy set in 1910 Mexico. Two traveling music-hall performers named Maria (Brigitte Bardot and Jeanne Moreau) inadvertently invent the striptease during a circus act. When their troupe visits San Miguel, the women join forces with a handsome rebel leader (George Hamilton) to lead an armed revolution against a brutal dictator.

Title: Wanted
Alternative_Titles: Wanted, le Recherche
Co_Stars: Teresa Gimpera, Serge Marquand, Daniele Vargas, German Cobos, Gia Sandri, Nello Pazzafini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A stylish, classic western where Giuliano Gemma stars as framed sheriff Gary Ryan. Wrongfully accused of murder by an influential syndicate of horse rustlers and local officials, Ryan escapes custody and goes undercover to expose the actual criminal mastermind (Serge Marquand).

Title: Wanted Johnny Texas
Alternative_Titles: Johnny Texas
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Monika Brugger, Dante Maggio, Howard Ross, Rosalba Neri
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bizarre, visually discordant frontier actioner shot in Florence. Johnny Texas (James Newman) is recruited by the military to guide a wagon train loaded with munitions through territory held by an unhinged bandit gang, leading to an explosive siege against a desert fortress.

Title: Wanted Sabata
Alternative_Titles: Wanted Sabata
Co_Stars: Vassili Karis, Enzo Redemonte, Piero Magalotti, Gino Turini
Synopsis_and_Notes: Brad Harris plays a lone-wolf gunman operating as an undercover vigilante in a corrupt border town. He methodically tracks an elusive outlaw ring while unmasking a syndicate of municipal officials pulling the strings behind local stage robberies.

Title: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return
Alternative_Titles: Attento Gringo, È Tornato Sabata
Co_Stars: Victor E. Richelmy, Fernando Sancho, Rosalba Neri, Daniel Martin, Luciano Rossi
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Martin leads an ensemble cast in a tangled border dispute involving stolen Mexican gold, crooked town bosses, and bandit raids. Despite the title and international promotional materials, the character of Sabata never actually appears in the narrative.

Title: What Am I Doing in the Middle of the Revolution?
Alternative_Titles: Che C'Entriamo Noi con la Rivoluzione?
Co_Stars: Paolo Villaggio, Eduardo Fajardo, Leo Anchóriz, Rossana Yanni, Riccardo Garrone
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two traveling Italian vaudeville actors (Vittorio Gassman and Paolo Villaggio) wander into Mexico seeking a fortune to finance their passage home. Caught in the chaos of the 1910 Revolution, one actor is mistaken for rebel leader Emiliano Zapata, sparking accidental heroics against an authoritarian government.

Title: White Apache
Alternative_Titles: L'Apache Bianco
Co_Stars: Lola Forner, Albert Farley, Charlie Bravo, Cinzia De Ponti
Synopsis_and_Notes: An exploitation western directed by Bruno Mattei. An orphaned white child raised by Apaches grows up to become the warrior Shining Sky (Sebastian Harrison). When he leaves the tribe, he encounters racism and cruelty from a sadistic local gang, culminating in a brutal and tragic frontier confrontation.

Title: White Comanche
Alternative_Titles: E Venne l'Ora della Vendetta; Comanche Blanco
Co_Stars: Joseph Cotten, Rossana Yanni, Victor Israel, Perla Cristal, Barta Barry, Luis Prendes
Synopsis_and_Notes: William Shatner stars in a dual role as twin half-breed brothers: Johnny Moon, a peace-seeking cowboy, and Garvin, a psychopathic peyote-addicted Comanche war leader. The sibling rivalry boils over into an all-out battle for control of the border town of Rio Hondo. Co-stars Joseph Cotten.

Title: White, the Yellow, and the Black
Alternative_Titles: Shoot First... Ask Questions Later; Samurai; Il Bianco, il Giallo, il Nero
Co_Stars: Tomás Milian, Eli Wallach, Manuel De Blas, Mirta Miller, Victor Israel, Maria Isbert
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sergio Corbucci's final western is a broad, colorful frontier farce. A dapper Swiss gunfighter (Giuliano Gemma), a clumsy Japanese martial artist (Tomás Milian), and an escaped bandit (Eli Wallach) form an uneasy trio searching for a priceless sacred horse stolen by renegade cavalry deserters.

Title: Who Killed Johnny R.?
Alternative_Titles: 5000 Dollar für den Kopf von Johnny Ringo; La Balada de Johnny Ringo
Co_Stars: Joachim Fuchsberger, Marianne Koch, Ralf Wolter, Carlos Otero, Barbara Bold, Sieghardt Rupp
Synopsis_and_Notes: German cinema icon Lex Barker stars as an unassuming traveling gun salesman named Dillon. Arriving in a frontier territory, he is mistakenly identified as notorious fugitive outlaw Johnny Ringo and faces imminent lynching until his companion helps him prove his identity.

Title: Who's Afraid of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Ah Sì? E Io lo Dico a Zzzzorro!
Co_Stars: Lionel Stander, Charo Lopez, Flora Carosello, Rod Licari, Antonio Pica
Synopsis_and_Notes: A comedic take on the Zorro legend starring George Hilton as a clumsy, reluctant freedom fighter whose heroics in colonial California are secretly orchestrated and guided by a clever Catholic monk (Lionel Stander) working behind the scenes.

Title: Winchester Does Not Forgive
Alternative_Titles: Buckaroo; Il Winchester Che Non Perdona
Co_Stars: Monika Brugger, Livio Lorenzon, Ugo Sasso, Omero Gargano, Jean Louis
Synopsis_and_Notes: American singer Dean Reed stars as Buckaroo, a quiet horse trainer who takes employment on a remote ranch. In reality, he is a calculating avenger intent on exposing the wealthy rancher (Livio Lorenzon) who assassinated his father years earlier over a silver claim.

Title: Winnetou: Last of the Renegades
Alternative_Titles: Last of the Renegades; Winnetou 2; Giorni di Fuoco; Le Trésor des Montagnes Bleues
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Anthony Steel, Terence Hill (Mario Girotti), Karin Dor, Renato Baldini, Klaus Kinski
Synopsis_and_Notes: Frontier scout Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) strive to prevent an all-out war when a renegade gang of oil prospectors attacks a pioneer convoy and attempts to frame peaceful native tribes. Features early genre appearances by Terence Hill and Klaus Kinski.

Title: Winnetou: The Desperado Trail
Alternative_Titles: Desperado Trail; Winnetou 3
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Rik Battaglia, Renato Baldini, Ralf Wolter, Sophie Hardy, Karin Dor
Synopsis_and_Notes: The dramatic third installment of the German Karl May franchise. Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Winnetou (Pierre Brice) struggle against ruthless land speculators who attempt to poison settler relations. The film features the dramatic and unexpected sacrifice of Chief Winnetou.

Title: Winnetou: Thunder at the Border
Alternative_Titles: Thunder at the Border; Winnetou und sein Freund Old Firehand
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Marie Versini, Todd Armstrong, Harald Leipnitz, Nadia Gray
Synopsis_and_Notes: Veteran American actor Rod Cameron takes on the role of frontier trapper Old Firehand. Alongside Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice), he helps fortify and defend a vulnerable border town from an impending siege by a large, heavily armed outlaw outfit.

Title: Winnetou and Shatterhand in the Valley of Death
Alternative_Titles: Winnetou und Shatterhand im Tal der Toten
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Ralf Wolter, Karin Dor, Eddie Arent, Rik Battaglia, Clarke Reynold
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lex Barker and Pierre Brice reunite for this adventure where Old Shatterhand and Winnetou defend the honor of an army officer falsely accused of embezzling military funds, escorting the man's daughter through hostile territory to recover the hidden treasure.

Title: Winnetou the Warrior
Alternative_Titles: Apache Gold; Winnetou 1. Teil; La Révolte des Indiens Apaches
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Mario Adorf, Walter Barnes, Chris Howland, Ralf Wolter, Marie Versini
Synopsis_and_Notes: The foundational entry in the European Winnetou series. Railroad surveyor Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) turns against his corrupt employers after discovering they violated tribal treaties to steal sacred gold, earning the eternal blood-brotherhood of young Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice).

Title: With Friends, Nothing Is Easy
Alternative_Titles: Fabulous Trinity; Alla Larga Amigos... Oggi Ho il Grilletto Facile
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Cris Huerta, Ricardo Palacios, Tito Garcia, Fanny Grey
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunter Scott (Richard Harrison) agrees to assist a young woman in breaking her three outlaw uncles out of a corrupt Mexican penitentiary run by Colonel Jimenez (Fernando Sancho), secretly intending to collect the bounties on all three once they cross back into Texas.

Title: Woman for Ringo
Alternative_Titles: Two Guns for Two Twins; Sharp-Shooting Twin Sisters; Una Donna per Ringo; Dos Pistolas Gemelas
Co_Stars: Sean Flynn, Jorge Rigaud, Beni Deus, Rogelio Madrid, Renato Baldini, Luis Induñi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A musical western vehicle crafted for popular Spanish twin pop duo Pili and Mili. The sisters play traveling trick-shot performers who inherit a deed to a frontier ranch, teaming up with their neighbors (including Sean Flynn) to thwart a corrupt banker plotting to steal the property.

Title: Wrath of God
Alternative_Titles: L'Ira di Dio; Hasta la Última Gota de Sangre
Co_Stars: Dana Ghia, Howard Ross, Fernando Sancho, Wayde Preston, Franco Fantasia, Paola Todisco
Synopsis_and_Notes: Returning home to discover his ranch torched, his fiancée murdered, and his money stolen, a vengeful gunfighter (Brett Halsey) tracks down each perpetrator, leaving a single silver dollar on each corpse as a calling card, culminating in a duel against his former best friend.

Title: Yankee
Alternative_Titles: Yankee, l'Americano
Co_Stars: Adolfo Celi, Mirella Martin, Tomás Torres, Paco Sanz, Victor Israel, Jacques Herlin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Cult director Tinto Brass crafts a highly stylized, Pop-Art-influenced western. Philippe Leroy plays Yankee, a solitary drifter who arrives in the Mexican town of Pueblo to challenge the territory's brutal bandit boss, Cobra (Adolfo Celi), turning the outlaw outfit against one another for profit.

Title: Yankee Dudler
Alternative_Titles: Verflucht dies Amerika
Co_Stars: William Berger, Arthur Brauss, Francisco Algora, Sigi Graue, Kinoto
Synopsis_and_Notes: An unconventional, contemplative German-Spanish frontier drama following a family of Bavarian immigrant woodcutters attempting to build a peaceful homestead in the lawless West. Co-stars Geraldine Chaplin as Kate Elder alongside William Berger as Doc Holliday.

Title: You're Jinxed, Friend, You Just Met Sacramento
Alternative_Titles: Sei Iettato Amico, Hai Incontrato Sacramento
Co_Stars: Christian Hay, Jenny Atkins, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Silvano Tranquilli, Krista Nell, Stan Cooper
Synopsis_and_Notes: Ty Hardin plays Jack 'Sacramento' Thompson, a peaceful rancher forced into a deadly feud with a tyrannical local town boss. When the boss retaliates by kidnapping Sacramento's children, the quiet cowboy wages a ruthless, one-man siege to rescue them.

Title: Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Zorro
Co_Stars: Stanley Baker, Adriana Asti, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Ottavia Piccolò, Moustache, Enzo Cerusico
Synopsis_and_Notes: Alain Delon stars as Don Diego, an agile adventurer who assumes the identity of his murdered friend, the incoming governor of Nuova Aragona. Posing as a foppish, cowardly official by day, he dons the black cape and mask of Zorro by night to lead the oppressed citizenry in a revolt against a tyrannical military colonel (Stanley Baker).

Title: Zorro, Rider of Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: Zorro, il Cavaliere della Vendetta
Co_Stars: Malisa Longo, Maria Mahor, Arturo Dominici, Ignazio Balsamo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Guided by an enigmatic spiritual entity, the masked avenger Zorro returns to colonial California to dismantle an occult criminal syndicate known as the Brotherhood of the Scorpion, who have assassinated his close friend and abducted his bride.

Title: Zorro, the Navarra Marquis
Alternative_Titles: Zorro Marchese di Navarra
Co_Stars: Maria Luisa Longo, Daniele Vargas, Loris Gizzi, Renato Montalbano, Gisella Arden
Synopsis_and_Notes: A European costume-action adventure featuring Zorro operating in 19th-century Spain. Dispatched by the exiled King Ferdinand VII, the masked hero conducts guerrilla sabotage operations against occupying French military forces commanded by a sadistic colonel (Daniele Vargas).

Title: Bad Kids of the West
Alternative_Titles: Kid, Terror of the West; Western Kid; Kid il Monello del West
Director: Mario Amendola, Bruno Corbucci, Tonino Ricci (as Tony Good)
Co_Stars: Mirko Ellis, Ray O'Connor, Flavio Colombaioni, Franco Ressel, Carlo Carlini, Maurizio Fiori
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two wanted outlaws seeking shelter in what appears to be a deserted ghost town discover it is entirely inhabited and governed by children who bizarrely emulate adult behavior and vice. The film descends into surreal and absurd slapstick gags as the young townsfolk outwit the bewildered intruders. Directed under a collective pseudonym by three genre veterans.

Title: Bad Man's River
Alternative_Titles: E Continuavano a Fregarsi il Milione di Dollari; El Hombre del Río Malo; Les Quatre Mercénaires d'El Paso
Co_Stars: James Mason, Gina Lollobrigida, Eduardo Fajardo, Gianni Garko, José M. Martin, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: A chaotic action comedy revolving around eccentric bank robber Bomba (Lee Van Cleef), who marries a conniving con-woman (Gina Lollobrigida) only to be swindled and locked in an asylum. After escaping, Bomba and his partners are recruited by a riverboat captain (James Mason) to obliterate an arsenal for a million-dollar payday, leading to an endless round of double-crosses along the Mexican border.

Title: Ballad of a Gunman
Alternative_Titles: Ringo, Pray to Your God and Die; Ballata per un Pistolero
Co_Stars: Angelo Infanti, Anthony Freeman, Al Northon (Alfio Caltabiano), Dan May, Monica Teuber
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two distinct gunmen track the ruthless Mexican outlaw El Bedoja. One is a calculating bounty hunter seeking a lucrative cash reward, while the other is an innocent man framed by the bandit fifteen years prior, driven entirely by a desire to clear his name and exact revenge for his murdered father.

Title: Bandera Bandits
Alternative_Titles: Sonny and Jed; Far West Story; Banda J & S, Cronaca Criminale del Far West
Co_Stars: Susan George, Telly Savalas, Eduardo Fajardo, Rossana Vanny, Franco Giacobini, Herbert Fux
Synopsis_and_Notes: A western reimagining of the Bonnie and Clyde narrative. Escaped Mexican bandit Jed (Tomás Milian) finds himself teamed with an unconventional, free-spirited wanderer named Sonny (Susan George) as they rob their way across the borderlands while being pursued by a vengeful lawman (Telly Savalas).

Title: Bandidos
Alternative_Titles: Crepa Tu... Che Vivo Io
Co_Stars: Terry Jenkins, Luigi Pistilli, Chris Huerta, Marco Guglielmi, Venantino Venantini, Antonio Pica
Synopsis_and_Notes: After a sadistic gunslinger shoots his hands to ruin his career, a former trick-shot marksman establishes a traveling circus act. Along the way, he takes a framed fugitive under his wing, training him in lethal marksmanship to hunt down the outlaw gang responsible for his maiming. Renowned for its stylish cinematography by former Leone cameraman Massimo Dallamano.

Title: Bang Bang Kid
Alternative_Titles: Il Bang Bang Kid
Co_Stars: Guy Madison, Riccardo Garrone, Sandra Milo, José Caffarel, Dianik Zurakowska
Synopsis_and_Notes: A quirky sci-fi-infused frontier farce where an eccentric inventor creates an automated mechanical gunfighter to liberate a mining town from an oppressive industrial baron (Guy Madison). Highlights include Tom Bosley as the bewildered inventor facing off against traditional western heavies.

Title: Bastard, Go and Kill
Alternative_Titles: Bastardo, Vamos a Matar
Co_Stars: Scilla Gabel, Furio Meniconi, Lincoln Tate, Vincenzo Norvese, Tomas Rudy, José M. Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Eastman stars as a peaceful frontiersman who is pushed over the edge when a detachment of rogue soldiers ravages his homestead and murders his entire family. Driven by fury, he tracks the perpetrators across the territory with relentless brutality, aided by stark camera work by Aristide Massaccesi.

Title: Beast
Alternative_Titles: Rough Justice; The Bell; La Belva
Co_Stars: Steven Tedd, Gabriella Giorgelli, Luisa Rivelli, Lee Burton, Gianni Pallavicino
Synopsis_and_Notes: Klaus Kinski plays the depraved outlaw Machete, a vicious criminal terrorizing the frontier while leaving a trail of assault and destruction in his wake. Known for Kinski's eccentric wardrobe choices and unhinged performance.

Title: Behind the Mask of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Oath of Zorro; Il Giuramento di Zorro
Co_Stars: Jesus Puente, José Alfonso, Roberto Paoletti, Rosita Yaraza, Maria Seoane
Synopsis_and_Notes: In 19th-century Spanish California, the masked champion of the oppressed works undercover as a mild-mannered servant inside the governor's estate to protect regional officials from an insurgent warlord plotting a violent uprising.

Title: Belle Starr Story
Alternative_Titles: Il Mio Corpo per un Poker
Co_Stars: Robert Woods, George Eastman, Francesca Righini, Dan Harrison, Bruno Corazzari
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rare female-led Eurowestern scripted and directed by famed auteur Lina Wertmüller under an alias. Elsa Martinelli stars as the legendary frontier outlaw Belle Starr, who leverages her lethal pistol skills, gambling prowess, and sexuality to hold her own among violent bandits and deceitful partners.

Title: Ben and Charlie
Alternative_Titles: Amigo, Stay Away; Humpty Dumpty Gang; Amico, Stammi Lontano Almeno un Palmo
Co_Stars: George Eastman, Vittorio Congia, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Marisa Mell
Synopsis_and_Notes: A comedy-tinged buddy adventure chronicling the misadventures of two small-time rogues who wander into Desert City. After being wrongly imprisoned by a crooked sheriff seeking to pin local robberies on them, they orchestrate an escape to clear their records and retrieve the missing loot.

Title: Between God, the Devil and a Winchester
Alternative_Titles: God Was in the West, Too, at One Time; Anche nel West, C'era una Volta Dio
Co_Stars: Richard Harrison, Ennio Girolami, Folco Lulli, Raf Baldassare, Roberto Camardiel, Luis Barboo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Treasure Island-style adventure transposed to the frontier, revolving around a sacred church treasure stolen during the Civil War. A rogue priest and a masked gunfighter independently employ the skills of a wilderness tracker to recover the hidden hoard before a rival gang reaches it.

Title: Beyond the Law
Alternative_Titles: Bloodsilver; Good Die First; Al di Là della Legge
Co_Stars: Antonio Sabàto, Gordon Mitchell, Lionel Stander, Bud Spencer, Graziella Granata, Herbert Fux
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lee Van Cleef delivers an atypical performance as Cudilip, an aging con man and bandit who is unexpectedly handed the sheriff's badge of a mining outpost. As he learns the value of civic duty, he must choose between his criminal past and defending the townspeople against former associates planning a massive payroll raid.

Title: Big Gundown
Alternative_Titles: Account Rendered; La Resa dei Conti
Co_Stars: Tomás Milian, Fernando Sancho, Nieves Navarro, Roberto Camardiel, Walter Barnes, Gerard Herter
Synopsis_and_Notes: Widely considered a pinnacle of the genre outside Leone's trilogy. Veteran lawman Jonathan Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) is hired by an aspiring railroad tycoon to capture Cuchillo (Tomás Milian), a peasant accused of an atrocity. The chase across Mexico reveals the true nature of corruption and morality, culminating in an iconic duel sequence in a cane field.

Title: Big Ripoff
Alternative_Titles: The Dirty Outlaws; El Desperado; King of the West; Massacre et le Sang
Co_Stars: Rosemarie Dexter, Aldo Berti, Franco Giornelli, Dana Ghia, Giovanni Petrucci, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A nihilistic caper about a gang of outlaws who seize an abandoned, disease-ridden town as their base to ambush a military gold convoy. Internal greed, mutual distrust, and shifting loyalties lead to mutual destruction among the participants.

Title: Big Showdown
Alternative_Titles: Storm Rider; The Grand Duel; Hell's Fighters; Il Grande Duello
Co_Stars: Horst Frank, Peter O'Brien, Marc Mazza, Jess Hahn, Klaus Grumberg
Synopsis_and_Notes: A mystery-laden western where an exiled sheriff (Lee Van Cleef) shields a young man wrongfully accused of killing a patriarch, facing down bounty hunters and three corrupt brothers to unravel who actually pulled the trigger.

Title: Billy the Kid
Alternative_Titles: Furia de la Ley
Co_Stars: Jack Taylor, Juny Brunell, Tomás Blanco, Alberto Dalbes, Luis Induni, Esther Grant
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early Spanish entry dramatizing the conflict between Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid, presenting an episodic and revised interpretation of the legendary outlaw's rise and subsequent confrontation with the law.

Title: Black Eagle of Santa Fe
Alternative_Titles: Gringos Do Not Forgive; Die Schwarzen Adler von Santa Fe; I Gringo non Perdonano
Co_Stars: Horst Frank, Tony Kendall, Joachim Hansen, Werner Peters, Helga Sommerfeld, Thomas Moore
Synopsis_and_Notes: A German-Italian co-production centering on an undercover government agent dispatched to New Mexico to investigate sudden Indian uprisings. He discovers a greedy land baron orchestrating raids disguised as native attacks in order to drive settlers out.

Title: Black Jack
Alternative_Titles: Blackjack
Co_Stars: Lucienne Bridou, Rik Battaglia, Larry Dolgin, Federico Chentres, Mimmo Palmara, Fredy Unger
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dark, amoral outing where Robert Woods stars as a ruthless outlaw leader who absconds with the entire haul of a Tucson bank robbery. Betrayed and targeted by his abandoned comrades and an allied native tracker, a brutal cycle of retaliation ensues.

Title: Black Killer
Alternative_Titles: Black Killer
Co_Stars: Fred Robsahm, Antonio Cantafora, Marina Mulligan, Paul Craine, Tiziana Dini, Claudio Trionfi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A town dominated by seven murderous brothers and a crooked judge sees its lawmen systematically executed. A vengeful brother pins on the badge to seek retribution for his murdered family, assisted by a mysterious lawyer in black (Klaus Kinski) who hides weapons inside leather-bound legal tomes.

Title: Black Tigress
Alternative_Titles: Lola Colt
Co_Stars: Peter Martell, German Cobos, Franco Balducci, Tom Felleghy, Andrea Scotti, Erna Schurer
Synopsis_and_Notes: American singer-actress Lola Falana stars as a saloon entertainer who arrives in a lawless border territory and uses her wits and influence to uncover clues to a concealed fortune while resisting local thugs.

Title: Blindman
Alternative_Titles: Blindman
Co_Stars: Ringo Starr, Lloyd Battista, David Dreyer, Lucretia Love, Magda Konopka, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: Inspired by Japanese Zatoichi films, Tony Anthony stars as a visually impaired sharpshooter hired to transport fifty mail-order brides. When they are kidnapped by Mexican bandidos led by Domingo and his brother Candy (Ringo Starr), the blind gunslinger relentlessly tracks them down with dynamite and a walking-stick shotgun.

Title: Blood and Guns
Alternative_Titles: Tepepa... Viva la Revolución; Long Live the Revolution
Co_Stars: Orson Welles, John Steiner, Luciano Casamonica, Angel Ortiz, José Torres, George Wang
Synopsis_and_Notes: A politically charged historical western detailing the struggle between peasant revolutionary Tepepa (Tomás Milian) and a cold, autocratic military colonel played by Orson Welles, examining the compromises and moral costs of armed insurrection.

Title: Blood at Sundown
Alternative_Titles: Stop the Slayings; Why Kill Again?; Blue Summer; Perché Uccidi Ancora?
Director: José Antonio De La Loma / Edward Muller
Co_Stars: Evelyn Stewart, Aldo Berti, Pepe Calvo, Hugo Blanco, José Torres, Franco Pesce
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen plays an army deserter who returns home determined to find the killers who crippled him, uncovering a web of local greed orchestrated by his fiancee's ruthless father.

Title: Blood at Sundown (Reissue)
Alternative_Titles: One Thousand Dollars on the Black; Mille Dollari sul Nero; Sartana: Sangue e la Penna
Co_Stars: Gianni Garko, Erika Blanc, Franco Fantasia, Sieghardt Rupp, Angelica Ott, Daniella Igliozzi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dramatic sibling rivalry where an innocent brother returns from unjust imprisonment to discover his sociopathic brother (Gianni Garko, in a pre-hero Sartana role) has terrorized the region and claimed his former lover.

Title: Blood Calls to Blood
Alternative_Titles: Sangue Chiama Sangue
Co_Stars: Stephen Forsyte, German Cobos, Lea Nanni, Antonella Judica, Marisa Salinas, Frank Farrel
Synopsis_and_Notes: A vicious bandit chieftain steals a sacred gem from a monastery, executing the monks inside. The brother of one of the victims vows retribution, launching a relentless pursuit of the outlaw gang across the arid frontier.

Title: Blood for a Silver Dollar
Alternative_Titles: One Silver Dollar; Un Dollaro Bucato
Co_Stars: Evelyn Stewart, Peter Cross, Andrew Scott, Max Dean, Nello Pazzafini, Frank Farrel
Synopsis_and_Notes: A discharged Confederate soldier travels west to build a new life, but is tricked by a town boss into a gunfight against his own brother. Saved from death when a bullet strikes a silver dollar in his pocket, he goes undercover to bring down the syndicate.

Title: Blood River
Alternative_Titles: Dieci Bianchi Uccisi da un Piccolo Indiano
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Rosalba Neri, Julie Newmar, Daniel Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: A very late-cycle, moody Eurowestern boasting an eclectic international ensemble including Julie Newmar and John Ireland, focusing on revenge, cross-country survival, and racial confrontations on the edge of the frontier.

Title: Boldest Job in the West
Alternative_Titles: El Más Fabuloso Golpe del Far West
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Carmen Sevilla, Yvan Verella, Charlie Bravo, Piero Lulli, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gang of multinational outlaws executes an elaborate and supposedly bloodless heist on a major frontier bank, but the plan implodes when an insider betrays the squad and steals the entire haul for himself.

Title: Boot Hill
Alternative_Titles: La Collina degli Stivali
Co_Stars: Bud Spencer, Lionel Stander, Woody Strode, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Victor Buono, Eduardo Ciannelli
Synopsis_and_Notes: The concluding entry in the Colizzi trilogy uniting Terence Hill and Bud Spencer. Wounded gunfighter Cat Stevens is sheltered by a traveling circus troupe, eventually recruiting trapeze acrobats and hard-hitting allies to liberate a mining settlement from a corrupt claim-jumper (Victor Buono).

Title: Born to Kill
Alternative_Titles: Nato per Uccidere
Co_Stars: Femi Benussi, Aldo Berti, Tom Felleghy, Giovanni Lenci, Ettore Manni, Aldo Cannistanni
Synopsis_and_Notes: Typically known for villainous roles, Gordon Mitchell plays a stoic gunfighter who rides into an oppressed town and is persuaded by local citizens and a saloon hostess (Femi Benussi) to confront the land baron running the county.

Title: Bounty Hunter in Trinity
Alternative_Titles: Un Bounty Killer a Trinità
Co_Stars: Paul McCren, Pat Miner, Attilio Dottesio, Carla Mancini, Antonio Cantafora
Synopsis_and_Notes: A professional manhunter is hired by town leaders to rid the settlement of an outlaw ring, only to discover the conspiracy runs straight to the town's prominent saloon proprietor. Directed and photographed by Joe D'Amato.

Title: Brother Outlaw
Alternative_Titles: Rimase Uno Solo e Fu la Morte per Tutti
Co_Stars: James Rogers, Celso Faria, Sophia Kammar, Dean Stratford, Sergio Sagrotti, Mimma Maggio
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a young man is wrongfully imprisoned for an armed holdup, his brother engineers a prison break. The pair spend the remainder of the story hunting down the actual bandits and the mastermind behind the scheme.

Title: Brothers Blue
Alternative_Titles: Blu Gang Vissero per Sempre Felici e Ammazzati
Co_Stars: Antonio Falsi, Guido Mannari, Tina Aumont, Maurizio Bonuglia, Lee Burton
Synopsis_and_Notes: A moody, stylistic western influenced by the rapid pace of late-60s American outlaw cinema. Jack Palance plays an uncompromising lawman obsessed with tracking down the elusive and doomed Blue brother bandit gang.

Title: Buddy Goes West
Alternative_Titles: Occhio alla Penna
Co_Stars: Amidou, Joe Bugner, Piero Trombetta, Carlo Reali, Sara Franchetti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A late-career comedy vehicle for Bud Spencer, who plays a traveling brawler mistaken for a licensed physician in a remote settlement. With his indigenous sidekick, he uses his physical might to defend the community against land-grabbers.

Title: Buffalo Bill, Hero of the Far West
Alternative_Titles: Buffalo Bill, l'Eroe del Far West; L'Attaque de Fort Adams
Co_Stars: Mario Brega, Jan Hendriks, Catherine Ribeiro, Piero Lulli, Mirko Ellis, Hans von Borsody
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bodybuilding star Gordon Scott portrays Buffalo Bill, tasked by the government with entering hostile territory to identify arms traffickers selling rifles to dissident tribes and preserve regional peace treaties.

Title: Bullet for Sandoval
Alternative_Titles: Vengeance Is Mine; Quei Disperati Che Puzzano di Sudore e di Morte; Desperate Men
Co_Stars: Ernest Borgnine, Annabella Incontrera, Alberto De Mendoza, Leo Anchóriz, Gustavo Rojo, Manuel Miranda
Synopsis_and_Notes: A Confederate deserter seeks vengeance against his aristocratic former landlord (Ernest Borgnine) after his family dies of illness through neglect. Complications arise when the deserter falls for his adversary's daughter.

Title: Bullet for the General
Alternative_Titles: Quien Sabe?
Co_Stars: Lou Castel, Klaus Kinski, Martine Beswick, Andrea Checchi, Spartaco Conversi, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: A landmark political Eurowestern. A mercenary joins a charismatic Mexican rebel leader's outfit on an ideological and financial train raid, secretly harboring a contract from the government to assassinate the general.

Title: Bullets and the Flesh
Alternative_Titles: Il Piombo e il Carne; I Sentieri dell'Odio
Co_Stars: Patricia Viterbo, Thomas Moore, Dan Harrison, Manolo Zarzo, Marie Versini, Alfredo Mayo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A frontier drama transposing classic family feud tropes. A timber baron attempts to burn down native forest preserves to secure lumber contracts for the railroad, triggering an armed uprising.

Title: Bullets Don't Argue
Alternative_Titles: Las Pistolas no Discuten; Le Pistole non Discutono
Co_Stars: Horst Frank, Angel Aranda, Vivi Bach, Ludwig Duran, Dick Palmer, Hans Nielsen
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dedicated sheriff has his wedding interrupted by a daring bank raid. He pursues the two bandit brothers across the Mexican border, but faces a gang of mercenaries attempting to hijack the recovered funds on the return journey.

Title: Bury Them Deep
Alternative_Titles: To the Last Drop of Blood; All'Ultimo Sangue
Co_Stars: Ettore Manni, Ken Wood, José Greci, Francesco Santovetti, Luciano Doria
Synopsis_and_Notes: A military payroll shipment is ambushed by an outlaw outfit. A hired tracker rescues the ringleader's imprisoned brother from the gallows to help track down the gang and recover the army gold.

Title: Calibre .38
Alternative_Titles: Panhandle Calibre .38; Padella Calibro .38; Poëlla Calibro .38; E alla Fine lo Chiamavano Jerusalem l'Implacabile
Co_Stars: Alberto Dell'Acqua, Keenan Wynn, Mimmo Palmara, Ray O'Connor, Carla Mancini, Ted Carter, Philippe Leroy
Synopsis_and_Notes: Jerusalem Wade (Scott Holden, son of William Holden) is a benevolent gunfighter and occasional bounty hunter who rides into town to protect his sister from an overbearing land baron (Keenan Wynn). A notable curiosity as the only directorial effort by acclaimed cinematographer Toni Secchi. Features solid genre support from Mimmo Palmara and Philippe Leroy.

Title: California
Alternative_Titles: Lo Chiamavano California
