Co_Stars: William Berger, Malisa Longo, Raimund Harmstorf, Chris Avram, Paola Bosè, Dana Ghia, Alfio Caltabiano, Robert Hundar
Synopsis_and_Notes: A somber, gritty post-Civil War drama starring Giuliano Gemma as an ex-Confederate soldier drifting through Missouri. After delivering the belongings of an executed comrade to the soldier's family, he falls for the sister (Malisa Longo) and stays to work their land. When ruthless bounty hunters slaughter the family and kidnap the woman, California launches a brutal pursuit. Grittily photographed in earthy tones by Alejandro Ulloa.

Title: Canadian Wilderness
Alternative_Titles: Rebeldes en Canada; Rebels in Canada; Revolt in Canada; Canada Salvaje
Co_Stars: Diana Lorys, Luis Marin, Santiago Rivero, Pamela Tudor, Franco Fantasia, Raf Baldassare, Francisco Nieto
Synopsis_and_Notes: A frontier survival adventure focused on the hardships faced by early pioneers carving out lives in the rugged northern wilderness. The settlers must band together to withstand harsh natural elements, hostile native factions, and opportunistic outlaw raiders. Directed by Spanish cult horror figure Armando De Ossorio.

Title: Captain Apache
Alternative_Titles: Captain Apache
Co_Stars: Carroll Baker, Stuart Whitman, Elisa Montes, Charlie Bravo, Percy Herbert, Tony Vogel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lee Van Cleef plays a Native American cavalry officer assigned to solve the mysterious murder of an Indian Commissioner whose dying words were 'April Morning.' His investigation leads him into a complex web of land speculation, corrupt politicians, and a plot by a rogue renegade (Stuart Whitman) to assassinate President Grant. The film is notorious for Van Cleef personally crooning the eccentric theme song.

Title: Carambola
Alternative_Titles: Carambola
Co_Stars: Michael Coby (Antonio Cantafora), Horst Frank, William Bogart, Pino Ferrara, Franco Fantasia, Pedro Sanchez
Synopsis_and_Notes: An action-heavy comedy modeled directly on the Terence Hill/Bud Spencer formula, featuring lookalike duo Paul Smith and Michael Coby. After breaking out of prison, the two con-men wander into Desert City and stumble onto an illegal arms-smuggling ring run by a crooked town boss. Features comic brawls, disguise gags, and an unexpected martial arts showdown inside a hall of mirrors.

Title: Carambola's Philosophy: In the Right Pocket
Alternative_Titles: Carambola Filosofo... Tutti in Buca
Co_Stars: Michael Coby, Clauco Onorato, Gabriela Andreini, Giovanni Pazzafini, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: The sequel to Carambola, following the same rogue pair as they hustle local frontier towns for quick cash. While heavyweight Lynn takes bets on brute tests of strength, partner Coby cleans up at the saloon pool tables through trick-shot trickery. Trouble arises when they target the wrong local syndicate and end up having to shoot their way out.

Title: Cavalry Charge
Alternative_Titles: La Carga de la Policia Montada
Co_Stars: Frank Latimore, Diana Lorys, Maria Silva, Alfonso Rojas, Juan Cortes, Barta Barry
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early Spanish-produced western that follows a mounted patrol stationed along a volatile border zone. Tasked with protecting pioneer outposts, the cavalrymen find themselves caught between regional bandits and escalating tensions with local tribes. Features music by frequent Jess Franco collaborator Daniel White.

Title: Cemetery Without Crosses
Alternative_Titles: The Rope and the Colt; Cimitero Senza Croci; Une Corde, un Colt
Co_Stars: Michèle Mercier, Lee Burton, Daniel Vargas, Anne-Marie Balin, Ivano Staccioli, Serge Marquand
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bleak, minimalist masterpiece cowritten by Dario Argento and directed by star Robert Hossein. When a woman's husband is lynched by a ruthless ranching dynasty, she hires a reclusive gunfighter living in a ghost town to execute an intricate plan of psychological and violent retribution. Sergio Leone famously makes a cameo appearance as a hotel clerk.

Title: Challenge of the Mackennas
Alternative_Titles: Badlands Drifters; Sfida dei MacKenna
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Annabella Incontrera, Vidal Molina, Roberto Camardiel, Ken Wood, Daniela Giordano
Synopsis_and_Notes: A drifter (Robert Woods) seeking to escape his violent past wanders directly into a deadly borderland range war between two tyrannical ranch owners (John Ireland and Roberto Camardiel). Forced to choose a side to protect innocent families caught in the crossfire, he takes up arms in a bloody campaign of self-defense.

Title: Charge of the Seventh Cavalry
Alternative_Titles: Assault on Fort Texan; Heroes of Fort Worth; La Carica del 7 Cavalleggeri
Co_Stars: Paul Piaget, Priscilla Steele, Aurora Julia, Isarco Ravaioli, Miguel Del Castillo, Eduardo Fajardo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Set in 1863, Confederate forces attempt to send an envoy into Mexico to negotiate military assistance from Emperor Maximilian. When their expedition is intercepted at Wichita Pass by the Union Seventh Cavalry, a Confederate scout must rely on assistance from friendly tribes to turn the tide in a large-scale battle.

Title: Charley One-Eye
Alternative_Titles: Charley One-Eye
Co_Stars: Roy Thinnes, Nigel Davenport, Jill Pearson, Aldo Sambrell, Luis Aller
Synopsis_and_Notes: An unconventional, allegorical western pairing an African-American Union deserter (Richard Roundtree) with a crippled, outcast Indian (Roy Thinnes). Taking refuge inside a desolate abandoned church in the desert, the two form an uneasy bond of survival until a ruthless bounty hunter (Nigel Davenport) tracks them down.

Title: Chetan, Indian Boy
Alternative_Titles: Tschetan der Indianer Junge
Co_Stars: Deschingis Bowakow, Willy Schultes, Horst Schram
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rare, melancholic German 'anti-western' focusing on the tender, bittersweet relationship between an aging homesteader and an orphaned native youth who helps him work his isolated ranch. Photographed by celebrated cinematographer Michael Ballhaus, the film prioritizes realism and atmosphere over conventional shootouts.

Title: China 9, Liberty 37
Alternative_Titles: Clayton and Catherine; Love, Bullets and Frenzy; Amore, Piombo e Furore
Co_Stars: Warren Oates, Jenny Agutter, Sam Peckinpah, Luis Prendes, Gianrico Tondivelli, Charlie Bravo, Helga Line
Synopsis_and_Notes: Railroad barons rescue a condemned gunfighter (Fabio Testi) from the gallows on the condition that he murder a defiant homesteader (Warren Oates) who refuses to yield his property. Instead, the gunman befriends the farmer and has an illicit affair with the man's wife (Jenny Agutter), leading to a shared stand against the railroad syndicate. Features a rare acting cameo by director Sam Peckinpah.

Title: Chino
Alternative_Titles: The Valdez Horses; Valdez, il Mezzosangue
Co_Stars: Jill Ireland, Marcel Bozzuffi, Vincent Van Patten, Fausto Tozzi, Ettore Manni, Diana Lorys
Synopsis_and_Notes: Charles Bronson stars as Chino Valdez, a solitary halfbreed horse breeder in the American Southwest who wants nothing more than to be left in peace. When he begins a romance with the sister of a wealthy, bigoted cattle baron (Marcel Bozzuffi), the rancher subjects Chino to brutal beatings and destroys his homestead, forcing Chino into an act of tragic defiance.

Title: Christmas Kid
Alternative_Titles: Joe Navidad; Lo Sceriffo Senza Stella
Co_Stars: Louis Hayward, Gustavo Rojo, Perla Cristal, Luis Prendes, Reginald Gilliam, Jack Taylor
Synopsis_and_Notes: When rich mineral deposits are discovered in Jasper, Arizona, the quiet community quickly descends into lawlessness, gambling, and corruption. Jeffrey Hunter plays the Christmas Kid, a gunman initially hired by the corrupt town boss who switches allegiance and becomes marshal after his lover is murdered during a turf dispute.

Title: Chrysanthemums for a Bunch of Swine
Alternative_Titles: Crisantemi per un Branco di Carogne
Co_Stars: John Manera, Marilena Possenti, Ivano Davoli, Livio Lorenzon, Joseph Logan
Synopsis_and_Notes: An outlaw gang attacks a rural wedding, slaughtering guests and abducting the young bride to an abandoned monastery. A mysterious, sharpshooting friar (Edmund Purdom) takes up weapons to track the kidnappers down and liberate the captive. An offbeat genre rarity from director Sergio Pastore.

Title: Chuck Moll
Alternative_Titles: Unholy Four; Chakmull, l'Uomo della Vendetta
Co_Stars: Woody Strode, Peter Martell, Helmut Schneider, Dino Strano, Evelyn Stewart, Luigi Montefiori (George Eastman)
Synopsis_and_Notes: An amnesiac gunfighter escaping from an asylum is manipulated by a deceptive former confederate who claims to be his father, aiming to weaponize him against an old business partner. As his memory slowly returns, Chuck discovers the horrifying truth about who murdered his real family. Directed by Trinity creator Enzo Barboni before his shift to pure comedy.

Title: Ciccio Forgives, I Don't
Alternative_Titles: Ciccio Perdona... Io No!
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Fernando Sancho, Adriano Micantoni, Mario Maranzana, Gia Sandri
Synopsis_and_Notes: A slapstick parody poking fun at Giuseppe Colizzi's hit film God Forgives, I Don't. Lowbrow comedy legends Franco and Ciccio play two bumbling insurance salesmen who make the terrible mistake of trying to sell life and accident policies to violent bandidos, chief among them the notorious El Pantera (Fernando Sancho).

Title: Cipolla Colt
Alternative_Titles: Cry Onion; Spaghetti Western
Co_Stars: Martin Balsam, Sterling Hayden, Dick Butkus, Leo Anchóriz, Romano Puppo, Emma Cohen
Synopsis_and_Notes: Franco Nero plays Onion Stark, an eccentric marksman whose sole obsession is buying land to farm sweet onions. When a corrupt oil syndicate led by a ruthless tycoon with a mechanical hand (Martin Balsam) attempts to drive him out, Stark retaliates using a bizarre assortment of customized weaponry, onion juice, and slapstick acrobatics.

Title: Cisco
Alternative_Titles: El Cisco
Co_Stars: George Wang, Antonella Murgia, Tom Felleghy, Nino Vingelli, Cristina Gajoni, Lucye Bomez
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a border sheriff leaves town, his corrupt deputy joins forces with an outlaw gang to plunder the regional bank. Cisco (William Berger), a cunning loner with a bounty on his head, stays one step ahead of both sides by taking the money first and staging his own death to expose the dishonest lawmen.

Title: Cjamango
Alternative_Titles: Cjamango
Co_Stars: Mickey Hargitay, Hélène Chanel, Livio Lorenzon, Pedro Sanchez, Piero Lulli, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: After winning a massive cache of gold in a high-stakes poker game, gunfighter Cjamango is ambushed and robbed by two rival bandit factions led by El Tigre and Don Pablo. When El Tigre kidnaps a young boy to blackmail the hero, Cjamango tracks down both outfits in a relentless war of attrition.

Title: Clint the Stranger
Alternative_Titles: Clint the Nevada Loner; Clint il Solitario
Co_Stars: Marianne Koch, Francisco J. Huetos, Fernando Sancho, Walter Barnes, Xan Das Bolas, Paolo Gozlino
Synopsis_and_Notes: Rancher Clint Harrison is sentenced to prison after killing two hired hands in self-defense during an aggressive land dispute. Years later, he returns home to find his homestead abandoned and his family missing, sparking a search that brings him into direct conflict with the region's tyrannical cattle baron.

Title: Coffin for the Sheriff
Alternative_Titles: Una Bara per lo Sceriffo; Lone and Angry Man
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Jorge Rigaud, Armando Calvo, Arthur Kent, Luciana Gilli, Miguel Del Castillo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen plays a former lawman who infiltrates a merciless bandit crew led by the treacherous Murdock (Eduardo Fajardo). Blaming the gang for the murder of his wife, the disguised sheriff acts as an inside operative until he can turn the outlaws against one another in a final town standoff.

Title: Colorado Charlie
Alternative_Titles: Colorado Charlie
Co_Stars: Charlie Lawrence, Barbara Hudson, Erika Blanc, Luis Chavarro, Andrew Ray, Luigi Batzella (as Paul Solvay)
Synopsis_and_Notes: A frontier marshal resigns his post to start a quiet family life, leaving law enforcement in the hands of his youthful deputy. When a vicious outlaw known as Colorado Charlie raids the town and shoots the new lawman, the retired marshal straps on his twin Colts to hunt the gang down.

Title: Colt 45, Five Dollars, and a Bandit
Alternative_Titles: Colt, Cinque Dollari, una Carogna; Seven Guns for Seven Bandits
Co_Stars: Cast uncredited / regional performers
Synopsis_and_Notes: An obscure, low-budget Italian-Spanish production that received minimal theatrical release outside southern Europe. The story follows a lone gunfighter navigating small frontier mining communities to capture an elusive bandit ring for a cash bounty.

Title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil (1967)
Alternative_Titles: Devil Was an Angel; An Angel with a Gun Is a Devil; Una Colt in Pugno del Diavolo
Co_Stars: Marisa Solinas, George Wang, Gerardo Rossi, Lucretia Love, Luciano Benetti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A military scout sent into the Mojave Desert to locate a missing wagon train discovers the settlers have been enslaved by a charismatic outlaw boss operating an illegal mine. The scout forms an unexpected camaraderie with the bandit leader before the cavalry arrives to force a final decision.

Title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil (1972)
Alternative_Titles: Una Colt in Mano del Diavolo
Co_Stars: William Berger, José Torres, George Wang, Mila Stanić, Harry Baird
Synopsis_and_Notes: Texas Ranger Wilton (Robert Woods) is tasked with tracking down the elusive and sadistic Butch Brown gang (headed by William Berger). Setting up traps across desert hideouts, the ranger methodically hunts down each gang member while safeguarding a local widow caught in the conflict.

Title: Colt Is the Law
Alternative_Titles: My Colt Is the Law; Colt è la Mia Legge
Co_Stars: Lucy Gilly, Miguel de la Riva, Peter White, Aldo Cecconi, Michael Martin, Jim Clay
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two undercover federal marshals are dispatched to San Felipe to investigate the disappearance of railroad construction payrolls. Discovering that prominent local businessmen are behind the thefts, the lawmen discard subtle detective work in favor of continuous, high-octane gun battles.

Title: Comin' at Ya!
Alternative_Titles: Comin' at Ya!
Co_Stars: Victoria Abril, Gene Quintana, Ricardo Palacios, Lewis Gordon
Synopsis_and_Notes: A landmark 3-D western produced and starring Tony Anthony. A bumbling bank robber decides to settle down and marry his sweetheart (Victoria Abril), but ruthless outlaws invade the church and abduct her. The groom mounts an obsessive chase across the borderlands, utilizing a sawed-off shotgun and flaming arrows to annihilate the kidnappers.

Title: Compañeros
Alternative_Titles: Vamos a Matar, Compañeros!
Co_Stars: Tomás Milian, Jack Palance, Karin Schubert, Fernando Rey, José Bodalo, Eduardo Fajardo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Corbucci's political adventure masterpiece set during the Mexican Revolution. A sharp, cynical Swedish arms merchant (Franco Nero) and a fiery peasant rebel (Tomás Milian) form an uneasy alliance to liberate an idealistic pacifist professor (Fernando Rey) from a military prison to unlock a safe full of revolutionary funds, all while being hunted by a marijuana-smoking mercenary (Jack Palance).

Title: Cost of Dying
Alternative_Titles: Taste of Death; Quanto Costa Morire
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Raymond Pellegrin, Betsy Bell, Bruno Corazzari, Giovanni Petrucci
Synopsis_and_Notes: A snowbound mountain western set in Colorado, where a vicious band of cattle rustlers takes over a freezing frontier settlement. When an elderly retired sheriff and his stepson are gunned down trying to resist the takeover, the townspeople band together in a unique shootout staged amidst deep snowdrifts.

Title: Cowards Don't Pray
Alternative_Titles: Taste of Vengeance; I Vigliacchi non Pregano
Co_Stars: Ivan Rassimov (as Sean Todd), Elisa Montes, Jerry Wilson, José Jaspe, Luciano Pignozzi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A grim psychological revenge tale. A veteran returns from the Civil War to find his homestead burned and his wife murdered by vigilantes. Consumed by hatred, he becomes a psychopathic bandit, eventually forcing his former friends and family to hunt him down when his thirst for violence spirals out of control.

Title: Coyote
Alternative_Titles: Judgment of Coyote; Giustizia del Coyote
Co_Stars: Gloria Marin, Manuel Monroy, Miguel Palenzuela, Billy Hayden
Synopsis_and_Notes: Mexican cinema favorite Abel Salazar plays the masked avenger Coyote, defending the oppressed citizens of 1840s California against the tyrannical abuses of an autocrat governor and his corrupt military garrisons.

Title: Cry for Revenge
Alternative_Titles: Quien Grita Venganza; I Morti non si Contano
Co_Stars: Anthony Steffen, Raf Baldassarre, Maria Martin, Luis Induñi, Piero Lulli, Dianik Zurakowska
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two bounty hunters (Mark Damon and Anthony Steffen) agree to help a widow avenge her husband's murder by an elusive outlaw outfit. Full of classic genre double-crosses, tense quick-draw confrontations, and a twisting trail of betrayals.

Title: Cut-Throats Nine
Alternative_Titles: Condenados a Vivir
Co_Stars: Emma Cohen, Manuel Tejada, Alberto Dalbes, Antonio Iranzo, Carlos R. Marchent
Synopsis_and_Notes: Renowned as one of the most violent and gruesome westerns ever made. When a prison wagon overturns in a blizzard, a cavalry sergeant and his daughter must escort a chain gang of psychotic, condemned killers on foot through the snow. Paranoia, greed, and mutilation quickly escalate into an apocalyptic struggle for survival.

Title: Dallas
Alternative_Titles: Il Mio Nome è Scopone e Faccio Sempre Cappotto
Co_Stars: Frank Braña, Angel Aranda, Karin Heske, Luis Induñi, Ralph Birks
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen plays Jake, a reformed gunslinger who tries to hang up his pistols and live a quiet life in Dallas. His retirement is ruined when a notorious bounty hunter (Frank Braña) wanders into town, forcing him back into gunplay to defend his homestead. Directed by Spanish workhorse Ignacio Iquino under his Juan Bosch pseudonym.

Title: Damned Pistols of Dallas
Alternative_Titles: Three Dollars of Lead; Le Maledette Pistole di Dallas; Tre Dollari di Piombo
Co_Stars: Evi Marandi, Olivier Mathot, Rob Messenger, Angel Alvarez, Luis Induñi, Dina De Saint
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early Spanish co-production where a frontier sheriff (Fred Bier) must organize reluctant, terrified Dallas citizens to defend their town against an advancing Mexican army detachment while awaiting cavalry reinforcements. Features French actor Olivier Mathot in an early genre role.

Title: Day of Anger
Alternative_Titles: Days of Wrath; I Giorni dell'Ira
Co_Stars: Giuliano Gemma, Walter Rilla, Crista Linder, Piero Lulli, Yvonne Sanson, Andrea Bosić
Synopsis_and_Notes: A masterpiece of the genre exploring the student-and-mentor relationship. Cynical, aging gunfighter Frank Talby (Lee Van Cleef) arrives in Clifton and takes Scott Mary (Giuliano Gemma), an abused town street-sweeper, under his wing, teaching him ten ruthless rules of survival. When Talby takes over the town by extortion, Scott is forced to use those very lessons against his teacher in a tragic showdown.

Title: Days of Violence
Alternative_Titles: I Giorni della Violenza
Co_Stars: Rosalba Neri, Beba Loncar, Luigi Vanucchi, Nello Pazzafini, Andrea Bosić, Lucio Rosato
Synopsis_and_Notes: Set in Missouri during the Civil War, two brothers find their farm torched and destroyed by Union soldiers. Seeking retribution, one brother joins a Confederate guerrilla outfit, only to discover the gang's leader is more interested in senseless robberies and bloodthirsty plunder than the Southern cause. Elevated by the presence of genre star Rosalba Neri.

Title: Dead Are Countless
Alternative_Titles: Garringo; I Morti Non Si Contano
Co_Stars: Peter Lee Lawrence, Solvi Stubing, José Bodalo, Luis Barboo, Raf Baldassare, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: A unique, dark psychological thriller with a serial killer motif. As a child, Johnny (Peter Lee Lawrence) witnessed his father's brutal execution by Union soldiers, leaving him so deeply traumatized that he now tracks and slaughters every military officer he encounters. Hardened federal officer Garringo (Anthony Steffen) is dispatched with orders to hunt the young madman down dead or alive.

Title: Dead for a Dollar
Alternative_Titles: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better; Fidarsi è Bene, Sparare è Meglio; T'Ammazzo, Raccomandati a Dio
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Dick Palmer (Mimmo Palmara), Gordon Mitchell, Piero Vida, Monica Pardo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lighthearted caper comedy following three rival outlaws (George Hilton, John Ireland, and Piero Vida) who successfully execute a $200,000 bank robbery. The thieves spend the rest of the narrative double-crossing, tricking, and chasing each other across the border until an opportunistic saloon woman swindles the entire fortune from under their noses.

Title: Dead Men Ride
Alternative_Titles: Anda Muchacho Spara!
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Massimo Serato, Alan Collins (Luciano Pignozzi), Daniel Martin, Charo Lopez, José Calvo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Escaped prisoner Roy Greenford (Fabio Testi) is nursed back to health by an impoverished Mexican peasant family. Seeing the local farmers brutalized and starved by greedy town boss Redfield (Eduardo Fajardo), Roy acts as an avenging angel to liberate their valley. Bruno Nicolai provides an explosive soundtrack heavily echoing his work with Ennio Morricone.

Title: Deadlock
Alternative_Titles: Deadlock
Co_Stars: Anthony Dawson, Marquard Bohm, Mascha Elm-Rabben, Sigurd Fitzek, Betty Segal
Synopsis_and_Notes: A sun-scorched, avant-garde contemporary German western filmed near the Dead Sea. A wounded bank robber carrying a suitcase packed with $700,000 collapses in a desolate desert outpost, where an opportunistic vagrant (Mario Adorf) and a ruthless partner (Anthony Dawson) battle over the buried money in a minimalist, feverish standoff punctuated by a krautrock score.

Title: Deadly Trackers
Alternative_Titles: Long Cavalcade of Vengeance; La Lunga Cavalcata della Vendetta
Co_Stars: Anita Ekberg, Rik Battaglia, George Wang, Men Fury (Furio Meniconi), Dada Gallotti, Lorenzo Piani
Synopsis_and_Notes: A traditional wagon-train drama starring Richard Harrison as a seasoned scout hired to escort homesteaders through treacherous, outlaw-infested territory in Wyoming. The plot takes a romantic turn when he falls for a Swedish traveler played by international screen siren Anita Ekberg.

Title: Deaf Smith and Johnny Ears
Alternative_Titles: Los Amigos
Co_Stars: Franco Nero, Pamela Tiffin, Ira Furstenberg, Adolfo Lastretti, Franco Graziosi, Tom Felleghy
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Quinn stars as the historical, hearing-impaired scout Erastus 'Deaf' Smith alongside his fast-talking partner Johnny Ears (Franco Nero). Sent on an undercover mission by Sam Houston to stop a corrupt general conspiring with foreign powers against Texas statehood, the duo uses dynamite, deception, and rifle skills to thwart the plot.

Title: Death at Owell Rock
Alternative_Titles: No Killing Without Dollars; La Morte Non Conta i Dollari
Co_Stars: Stephen Forsyte, Luciana Gilli, Pamela Tudor, Giovanni Pazzafini, Pedro Sanchez, Spartaco Conversi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Veteran Italian horror filmmaker Riccardo Freda directs this stylish revenge mystery. Gunfighter Lawrence (Mark Damon) returns to the sinister settlement of Owell Rock to investigate the murder of his father, only to find the terrified residents cowed into silence by a wealthy land baron and his ruthless gunmen.

Title: Death Is Sweet from the Soldier of God
Alternative_Titles: Django... Adios!; Seminò la Morte... Lo Chiamavano il Castigo di Dio
Co_Stars: José Torres, Paolo Magalotti, Zara Cilli, Vassili Karis, Roberto Messina, Franco Pasquetto
Synopsis_and_Notes: Brad Harris plays a mysterious wanderer in black—part ghost, part holy avenger—who arrives in a border territory to administer vigilante justice against an untouchable outlaw chieftain. Combining gothic overtones with bullet-riddled showdowns, this film was retitled Django Adios in several foreign markets.

Title: Death Knows No Time
Alternative_Titles: Tierra Brava; E Intorno a Lui Fu Morte
Co_Stars: Pedro Sanchez, Wayde Preston, Agnes Spaak, Miguel Del Castillo, Eduardo Fajardo, Sydney Chaplin
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lone, nameless bounty hunter tracks an elusive outlaw known as the Cactus Kid into a violent border town. After wiping out the local gang of bandits, the stranger is persuaded by the desperate townspeople to pin on the sheriff's tin star and restore order to the region.

Title: Death on High Mountain
Alternative_Titles: La Morte sull'Alta Collina
Co_Stars: Luis Dávila, Tano Cimarosa, Agnes Spaak, Antonio Gradoli, Nello Pazzafini, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a bumbling Mexican bandit general and a corrupt town boss stage an elaborate bank raid during a church wedding, two bystanders (Peter Lee Lawrence and Luis Dávila) shoot their way into the robbery and hijack the loot for themselves, sparking a series of double-crosses and mountain chases.

Title: Death Played the Flute
Alternative_Titles: Lo Ammazzo Come un Cane... Ma Lui Rideva Ancora
Co_Stars: Steven Tedd, Aldo Berti, Chet Davis, Anthony Freeman, Suzanne Levi, Clara Hope
Synopsis_and_Notes: Riffing on Charles Bronson's iconic harmonica-playing gunfighter, Michael Forrest stars as Ryan, an eccentric bounty hunter who carries a concert flute and plays melodic tunes before dispatching his targets. He takes on a corrupt gang terrorizing homesteaders along the frontier.

Title: Death Rides a Horse
Alternative_Titles: As Man to Man; Da Uomo a Uomo
Co_Stars: John Phillip Law, Anthony Dawson, José Torres, Mario Brega, William Bogart, Luigi Pistilli
Synopsis_and_Notes: As a child, Bill (John Phillip Law) survived the brutal slaughter of his entire family by a gang of bandits. Fifteen years later, he teams up with newly released convict Ryan (Lee Van Cleef), who is also hunting the same men for framing him. Bill gradually discovers the horrifying truth: Ryan was among the gang on the night his family died. Highlighted by one of Ennio Morricone's greatest and most savage musical scores.

Title: Death Rides Alone
Alternative_Titles: Con Lui Cavalca la Morte
Co_Stars: Robert Hundar, Peter Martell, Giorgio Gargiulo, Carlo Gaddi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A textbook tale of single-minded frontier retribution. Young Bobby (Mike Marshall) spends years mastering the fast draw after his mother and sister are murdered by bandits. Armed and hardened, he embarks on an unrelenting hunt across the badlands until every member of the gang is dead.

Title: Death Sentence
Alternative_Titles: Sentenza di Morte
Co_Stars: Richard Conte, Tomás Milian, Enrico Maria Salerno, Adolfo Celi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A pure, stripped-down episodic vengeance western. Cash (Robin Clarke) tracks down the four men responsible for his brother's execution: an aging gambler (Richard Conte), an epileptic albino bandit (Tomás Milian in a bravura performance), a corrupt former priest (Enrico Maria Salerno), and an arrogant land baron (Adolfo Celi).

Title: Death Walks in Laredo
Alternative_Titles: Three Golden Boys; Tre Pistole Contro Cesare; Tre Ragazzi d'Oro
Co_Stars: James Shigeta, Nadir Moretti, Femi Benussi, Delia Boccardo, Umberto D'Orsi, Enrico Maria Salerno
Synopsis_and_Notes: An outlandish, comic-book-inspired western. Three half-brothers—an American sharpshooter, a Japanese martial artist, and a French illusionist—inherit a gold mine in Laredo, only to find the territory ruled by an eccentric tyrant (Enrico Maria Salerno) who believes he is the reincarnation of Julius Caesar and rules from a hilltop Roman palace.

Title: Deguello
Alternative_Titles: Deguejo
Co_Stars: Dan Vadis, José Torres, Rosy Zichel, Ghia Arlen, Riccardo Garrone, John MacDouglas, Erika Blanc
Synopsis_and_Notes: Following the Civil War, an outlaw crew led by Ramon (Dan Vadis) tortures a Confederate officer to reveal the location of a buried fortune, killing him and his men. The officer's son forms a posse of vengeful sharpshooters, tracking the gang down to an abandoned ghost town for a bullet-strewn standoff.

Title: Deserter
Alternative_Titles: The Devil's Backbone; La Spina Dorsale del Diavolo
Co_Stars: Chuck Connors, Bekim Fehmiu, Ricardo Montalban, Fausto Tozzi, Slim Pickens, Woody Strode, John Huston
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gritty Dirty Dozen-style western starring Bekim Fehmiu as an embittered cavalry deserter recruited by a general (John Huston) to lead a specialized squad of cutthroats and misfits into an impregnable Apache mountain stronghold across the Mexican border.

Title: Desperado
Alternative_Titles: Now They Call Him Amen; I Bandoleros della Dodicesima Ora
Co_Stars: Fred Harrison, Malisa Longo, Paolo Gozlino
Synopsis_and_Notes: A wandering, weary gunfighter rides into an oppressed agricultural territory and comes to the defense of a community of terrified homesteaders. He falls in love with a spirited widowed rancher (Malisa Longo) and takes up arms to wipe out the extortion syndicate terrorizing the valley.

Title: Dick Luft in Sacramento
Alternative_Titles: Di Tressette C'è Ne Uno... Tutti gli Altri son Nessuno
Co_Stars: Tony Norton, Chris Huerta, Umberto D'Orsi, Nello Pazzafini, Renato Baldini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A broad, farcical satire directed by the genre's most prolific director, Giuliano Carmineo. George Hilton stars as Dick Luft, an incompetent wanna-be gunslinger whose clever sidekick Veleno orchestrates every encounter from the shadows to make him look like a legendary dead-eye hero.

Title: Dig Your Grave, Friend... Sabata's Coming
Alternative_Titles: Stagecoach of the Condemned; Not Sabata or Trinity... It's Sartana; Abre Tu Fosa, Amigo... Llega Sabata
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Raf Baldassare, Alejandro Ulloa, Erika Blanc, Indio Gonzalez, Luis Induñi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Steve McGowan (Richard Harrison) partners with a boisterous Mexican bandit (Fernando Sancho) to avenge his father's murder at the hands of a corrupt land baron. When the baron hires the ice-cold mercenary Sabata to wipe them out, an explosive, three-way tactical war erupts across the territory.

Title: Django
Alternative_Titles: Django
Co_Stars: Loredana Nusciak, Eduardo Fajardo, Jimmy Douglas, José Bodalo, Angel Alvarez, Simon Arriaga
Synopsis_and_Notes: Corbucci's genre-defining masterpiece. Franco Nero stars as the iconic, mud-splattered gunslinger dragging a coffin through a godforsaken border town torn between sadistic ex-Confederates and Mexican revolutionaries. Armed with a portable machine gun, Django wages a one-man war of vengeance that culminates in an unforgettable showdown among cemetery headstones.

Title: Django, a Bullet for You
Alternative_Titles: Django... Cacciatore di Taglia
Co_Stars: Aldo Berti, Maria Kost, José Marco, Andres Resino
Synopsis_and_Notes: One of the very first unofficial Django follow-ups released just months after the original. James Philbrook plays the titular vigilante who intervenes to protect small homesteaders in Wagon Valley from a ruthless land baron (Aldo Berti) conspiring with corrupt railroad executives to forcibly seize the territory.

Title: Django and Sartana Are Coming... It's the End
Alternative_Titles: Django and Sartana... Showdown in the West; Final Conflict... Django Against Sartana; Sartana, If Your Left Arm Offends, Cut It Off; Arrivano Django e Sartana... È la Fine
Co_Stars: Chet Davis, Gordon Mitchell, Simone Blondell, Krista Nell, Ettore Manni
Synopsis_and_Notes: Cult hack director Demofilo Fidani pairs the two biggest names of the genre for an offbeat outing. Gordon Mitchell plays bandit leader Black Burt, who abducts a wealthy rancher's daughter. Bounty hunters Django (Hunt Powers) and Sartana (Chet Davis) track the gang across the Mexican border, only to clash over whether to claim the girl or the bounties on the dead bodies.

Title: Django Challenges Sartana
Alternative_Titles: Django Defies Sartana; Django Sfida Sartana
Co_Stars: Georges Ardisson, Malisa Longo, José Jaspe, José Torres, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: A well-lensed, fast-paced actioner featuring two iconic western archetypes on the trail of the same elusive bandit gang. Initially clashing over competing bounties and mutual suspicion, Django (Tony Kendall) and Sartana (Georges Ardisson) eventually join forces to wage an explosive final assault on the outlaws' fortified mountain redoubt.

Title: Django Does Not Forgive
Alternative_Titles: Django Non Perdona
Co_Stars: Hugo Blanco, Frank Braña, Miguel De La Riva, Gustavo Rojo, Nuria Torray, Manuel Miranda, Luis Induñi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A unique revenge western transposed to a harsh Canadian frontier backdrop. When a rogue Mountie rapes and murders his sister, Django (John Clark) embarks on an obsessive pursuit that plunges him into the middle of a raging territorial war between the army and local indigenous tribes.

Title: Django, Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
Alternative_Titles: Se Sei Vivo Spara
Co_Stars: Ray Lovelock, Piero Lulli, Milo Quesada, Roberto Camardiel, Frank Braña, Marilu Tolo, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: Regarded as the most surreal, violent, and gothic Eurowestern ever created. Tomás Milian stars as a half-breed gunman who claws his way out of a mass grave armed with gold bullets. He wanders into The Lears, a nightmarish town torn apart by greed, sadism, and a bizarre gang of black-clad outlaws led by a villain named Zorro (Roberto Camardiel).

Title: Django Kills Softly
Alternative_Titles: Bill il Taciturno... Django Uccide
Co_Stars: Edwin G. Ross, Liana Orfei, Mimmo Maggio, Peter Hellmann, Spartaco Conversi, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: Horror director Massimo Pupillo helms this hyper-violent textbook revenge thriller. George Eastman plays a brooding, phantom-like Django who rescues a woman from Mexican bandits, only to arrive in a frontier town where the entire hotel staff and guests have been massacred by a sadistic local boss and his unhinged brothers.

Title: Django, Last Killer
Alternative_Titles: L'Ultimo Killer
Co_Stars: George Eastman, Dana Ghia, Daniele Vargas, John Hamilton, Mirko Ellis, John MacDouglas
Synopsis_and_Notes: A desperate young Mexican farmer named Ramon (George Eastman) sees his parents slaughtered and his land stolen by a tyrannical land baron. Despondent, he crosses paths with legendary bounty hunter Django (Anthony Ghidra), who takes pity on the youth and trains him in the deadly art of pistol marksmanship for an inevitable showdown.

Title: Django Shoots First
Alternative_Titles: He Who Shoots First; Django Spara per Primo
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Evelyn Stewart, Erika Blanc, José M. Martin, Lee Burton, Alberto Lupo, Diana Lorys
Synopsis_and_Notes: Glenn Saxon steps into the role of Django, arriving in town to claim his inheritance from his murdered father, only to discover his former business partner Doc Gordon (Fernando Sancho) has usurped control of the town. Packed with fast-paced saloon brawls, shootouts, and an exceptional musical score by Bruno Nicolai.

Title: Django Strikes Again
Alternative_Titles: Ritorno di Django
Co_Stars: Donald Pleasence, Christopher Connelly, William Berger, Licinia Lentini
Synopsis_and_Notes: The only official sequel to the 1966 original recognized by Sergio Corbucci and starring Franco Nero. Having lived in a secluded South American monastery for over a decade, Django is forced to dig up his buried machine gun from a grave when a tyrannical slaver (Christopher Connelly) kidnaps his young daughter.

Title: Django the Bastard
Alternative_Titles: Stranger's Gundown; Django il Bastardo
Co_Stars: Lu Kamenke, Paolo Gozlino, Rada Rassimov, Furio Meniconi, Jean Louis, Teodoro Corra, Riccardo Garrone
Synopsis_and_Notes: Widely cited as the uncredited inspiration for Clint Eastwood's High Plains Drifter. Anthony Steffen plays a spectral, black-clad avenger who appears from the shadows to execute the traitorous Confederate officers who massacred his battalion for gold years earlier, placing a cross marked with each man's name and hour of death before killing them.

Title: Djurado
Alternative_Titles: Dyurado; . . .E Djurado
Co_Stars: Scilla Gabel, Mary Jordan, Isarco Ravaioli, Margaret Lee, Luis Induñi, Goyo Lebrero
Synopsis_and_Notes: Montgomery Clark plays a suave, unbeatable gambler nicknamed 'Golden Poker' who wins half-ownership of a border saloon. When the town is terrorized by a sadistic bandit chief named Tucan (Luis Induñi), the gambler relies on his concealed quick-draw talents and a local federal lawman to liberate the settlement.

Title: Do Not Touch the White Woman
Alternative_Titles: Touche Pas la Femme Blanche; Non Toccate la Donna Bianca
Co_Stars: Catherine Deneuve, Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Piccoli, Philippe Noiret, Darry-Cowl, Franco Fabrizi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A biting surrealist art-house political satire from provocateur Marco Ferreri. The film restages Custer's Last Stand as an allegorical conflict inside the modern construction crater of the Forum des Halles in downtown Paris, blending period cavalry costumes, bloody battle sequences, and contemporary high-rise urban development.

Title: Dollar of Fire
Alternative_Titles: Un Dollaro di Fuoco
Co_Stars: Diana Garson, Albert Farley, Indio Gonzales, Jack Rocks, Mario Maranzana, Diana Sorel
Synopsis_and_Notes: A frontier marshal (Michael Riva) arrives in the vice-ridden town of Jerrington to clean up rampant corruption and gambling syndicates. After shutting down a notorious brothel, he finds himself targeted by the mayor, only to discover the enigmatic woman running the crime ring is the wife who abandoned him years earlier.

Title: Dollars for a Fast Gun
Alternative_Titles: One Hundred Thousand Dollars for Lassiter; 100.000 Dollari per Lassiter
Co_Stars: Peter Martell, Pamela Tudor, Luigi Pistilli, Jesus Puente, Roberto Camardiel, José Bodalo, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: A wheelchair-bound former bank robber turned ruthless land baron (José Bodalo) crushes local homesteaders with exorbitant taxes and hired muscle. Desperate, a widowed rancher hires a dapper gunfighter named Lassiter (Robert Hundar) to orchestrate an elaborate scheme that dismantles the baron's criminal enterprise.

Title: Don't Turn the Other Cheek
Alternative_Titles: Long Live Your Death; Viva la Muerte . . . Tua
Co_Stars: Eli Wallach, Lynn Redgrave, Eduardo Fajardo, José Jaspe, Horst Janson, Mirko Ellis
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively comedic romp directed by Duccio Tessari set during the Mexican Revolution. A cynical Russian con artist prince (Franco Nero), an earthy peasant bandit (Eli Wallach), and an idealistic, fiery Irish revolutionary journalist (Lynn Redgrave) form a volatile partnership in search of hidden gold and political chaos.

Title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
Alternative_Titles: Non Aspettare, Django... Spara!
Co_Stars: Pedro Sanchez, Rada Rassimov, Bill Jackson, Gino Buzzanca, Alfredo Rizzo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Django (Ivan Rassimov) and his sidekick Diego are hired by a young woman to avenge her uncle's murder by a greedy land baron. The plot turns chaotic when a rival band of Mexican bandits hijacks the conflict, forcing Django into a vicious rescue mission to save the girl from execution.

Title: Drummer of Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: Day of Judgment; Doomsday; Il Giorno del Giudizio
Co_Stars: Craig Hill, Gordon Mitchell, Rossano Brazzi, Ida De Benedetto, Raf Baldassarre, Rosalba Neri
Synopsis_and_Notes: A grim British-Italian co-production starring Ty Hardin as 'The Stranger', a traumatized wanderer who methodically hunts down and eliminates the six ruthless outlaws who raped and murdered his wife (Rosalba Neri) and child. Notable for its somber tone and an impressive lineup of genre regulars like Craig Hill and Gordon Mitchell.

Title: Duck You Sucker
Alternative_Titles: A Fistful of Dynamite; Giù la Testa
Co_Stars: Rod Steiger, Maria Monti, Rik Battaglia, Franco Graziosi, Romolo Valli, Domingo Antoine
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sergio Leone's grand, explosive epic of the Mexican Revolution. An IRA explosives expert on the run (James Coburn) crosses paths with an amoral Mexican bandit (Rod Steiger). What begins as an elaborate bank heist turns into an ideological awakening as both men are swept into the catastrophic violence of revolutionary warfare.

Title: Duel at Sundown
Alternative_Titles: Duel au Crépuscule; Duell vor Sonnenuntergang
Co_Stars: Carole Gray, Wolfgang Kieling, Mario Girotti (Terence Hill), Carl Lange, Walter Barnes
Synopsis_and_Notes: A classic German-backed drama featuring Terence Hill in an early role as Don McGow. He and his brother Larry (Peter Van Eyck) find themselves pitted against each other when Don falls in love with the daughter of a neighboring rancher targeted by their despotic land-grabbing father (Walter Barnes).

Title: Duel in the Eclipse
Alternative_Titles: Requiem for a Gringo; Requiem per un Gringo
Co_Stars: Femi Benussi, Fernando Sancho, Carlo Gaddi, Ruben Rojo, Aldo Sambrell, Carlo Simoni
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peplum star Lang Jeffries plays a quiet rancher who seeks vengeance after his brother is tortured and murdered by bandidos. He infiltrates the gang, biding his time until a total solar eclipse provides the darkness needed to wage an eerie, cinematic final shootout.

Title: Durango Is Coming, Pay or Die
Alternative_Titles: Arriva Durango, Paga o Muori
Co_Stars: José Torres, José Rivas Jaspe, Gabriella Giorgelli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Brad Harris stars as a hardened bounty hunter arriving in a corrupt border outpost to track down a gang of killers who have taken over the region. Packed with brawls and fast-draw confrontations typical of director Roberto Montero's energetic exploitation style.

Title: Dust in the Sun
Alternative_Titles: Lust in the Sun; Dans la Poussière du Soleil
Co_Stars: Maria Schell, Daniel Beretta, José Calvo, Perla Cristal, Karin Meier
Synopsis_and_Notes: An obscure French-produced frontier drama focusing on psychological drama, greed, and romantic betrayals among isolated desert dwellers. Notable for an original score by Academy Award-winning French composer Francis Lai.

Title: Dynamite Jack
Alternative_Titles: Dinamite Jack
Co_Stars: Eleonore Vargas, Adrienne Corri, Daniel Ivernel, Lucien Raimbourg, Jess Hahn, George Lycan
Synopsis_and_Notes: Legendary French comic Fernandel plays a dual role in this early western spoof, portraying both a feared, cold-blooded gunslinger named Dynamite Jack and a timid, clueless French tenderfoot who is repeatedly mistaken for him in a chaotic frontier settlement.

Title: Dynamite Jim
Alternative_Titles: Dinamite Jim
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Rosalba Neri, Aldo Sambrell, Mary Conte, Charles Sola
Synopsis_and_Notes: During the American Civil War, a Union secret agent nicknamed Dynamite Jim (Luis Dávila) attempts to escort a clandestine shipment of gold from Mexico to a northern fort, constantly fighting off Mexican bandits (Aldo Sambrell) and treacherous allies (Fernando Sancho).

Title: Dynamite Joe
Alternative_Titles: Joe l'Implacabile
Co_Stars: Halina Zalewska, Mercedes Caracuel, Renato Baldini, Santiago Rivero, Barta Barry, Aldo Cecconi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Rick Van Nutter stars as Dynamite Joe, a government special agent armed with specialized explosives who is assigned to solve a rash of gold stagecoach robberies, ultimately exposing a corrupt frontier senator as the mastermind behind the thefts.

Title: Eagle's Wing
Alternative_Titles: Eagles Wing
Co_Stars: Sam Waterston, Harvey Keitel, Stephane Audran, José Carlos Ruiz, Manuel Ojeda, Pedro Damieari
Synopsis_and_Notes: A symbolic and allegorical British-produced western written by John Briley. A solitary white trapper named Pike (Martin Sheen) and a determined Comanche warrior named White Bull (Sam Waterston) engage in a protracted, obsessive struggle over the capture of a magnificent wild white stallion. Co-stars Harvey Keitel.

Title: Even Django Has His Price
Alternative_Titles: Pistol for Django; Anche per Django Hanno un Prezzo
Co_Stars: John Desmont, Gengher Gatti, Esmeralda Barros, Edilio Kim, Dominique Badout, William Major
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunter Django (Jeff Cameron) pursues the bank-robbing Cortez brothers to claim the reward. He crosses paths with an eccentric gambler and Wells Fargo agent who convinces him to postpone the showdown until they can uncover the location of the gang's secret gold mine, leading to a tangled web of deceit.

Title: Execution
Alternative_Titles: Django Prépare ton Exécution
Co_Stars: Mimmo Palmara, Rita Clein, Franco Giornelli, Piero Vida, Nestor Garay, Romano Magnino
Synopsis_and_Notes: After serving a lengthy prison sentence for an armed robbery, former convict Chips (Mimmo Palmara) is released and embarks on a hunt to eliminate his treacherous former partner John (John Richardson), who fled with the entirety of their stolen gold hoard. Directed with gritty, cynical flair by Domenico Paolella.

Title: Eye for an Eye
Alternative_Titles: Taste of the Savage; Occhio per Occhio, Dente per Dente...
Co_Stars: Isela Vega, Helena Rojo, Jorge Luke, Nick Georgiade, Raymando Cafetella, Arthur Hansel
Synopsis_and_Notes: A brutal, unrelenting revenge saga directed by Mexican filmmaker Alberto Mariscal. An embittered widow (Isela Vega) hires a seasoned gunfighter with a conscience (Cameron Mitchell) to teach her young son how to kill so he can avenge his father's murder, but the bounty hunter soon regrets transforming the boy into an unfeeling assassin.

Title: Face to Face
Alternative_Titles: Faccia a Faccia
Co_Stars: Tomás Milian, William Berger, Jolanda Modio, Carole André, Nicoletta Machiavelli, José Torres
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sollima's intellectual, politically charged masterpiece tracing the psychological descent of Brad Fletcher (Gian Maria Volonté), an ailing history professor who travels west and falls under the sway of charismatic bandit Beauregard Bennet (Tomás Milian). Gradually seduced by unchecked power and violence, the professor usurps control of the gang, while Beauregard seeks redemption.

Title: Fasthand
Alternative_Titles: Fasthand Is Still My Name; Lo Chiamavano Requiescat Fasthand; Mano Rapida
Co_Stars: William Berger, Welma Truccol, Paco Sanz, Gill Roland, Celina Bessy, Francisco Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rogue Confederate officer named Macedo (William Berger) terrorizes an army fort and brutally shoots Captain Jeff Madison (Alan Steel) through the hands, leaving him for dead. Nursed back to health in the wilderness, Madison overcomes his physical disability to track down the guerrilla outfit with a vengeance.

Title: Few Dollars for Django
Alternative_Titles: Per Pochi Dollari per Django; Bravo Django
Co_Stars: Gloria Osuna, Frank Wolff, Joe Kamel, Alfonso Rojas, Angel Ter, Thomas Moore
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunter Django (Anthony Steffen) tracks an elusive train robber named Jim Norton into a frontier settlement. Upon arrival, he encounters Jim's supposedly peaceful identical twin brother George (Frank Wolff). When a ruthless town syndicate begins violently seizing local farmland, Django and George team up to take on the tyrant.

Title: Fifteen Scaffolds for the Killer
Alternative_Titles: Quindici Forche per un Assassino
Co_Stars: Susy Andersen, Aldo Sambrell, Tomás Blanco, Andrea Bosić, J. Manuel Martin, George Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Wrongfully accused of a brutal murder, Billy Mack (Craig Hill) and his companions flee from a relentless sheriff's posse and take refuge inside a crumbling, abandoned fort. Trapped under siege, the innocent men slowly turn against one another in an intense, claustrophobic psychological drama photographed by future director Stelvio Massi.

Title: Fighters from Ave Maria
Alternative_Titles: Twilight Avengers; Avengers of the Ave Maria; I Vendicatori dell'Ave Maria
Co_Stars: Peter Thorris, Alberto Dell'Acqua, Ida Meda, Spartaco Conversi, Albert Farley
Synopsis_and_Notes: A tyrannical town boss declares himself sheriff to subjugate and exploit the populace. A troupe of traveling circus acrobats led by Tony Kendall teams up with a band of exiled mountain guerrillas, combining athletic tumbling feats, traps, and gunplay to overthrow the dictator.

Title: Fighting Fists of Shanghai Joe
Alternative_Titles: My Name Is Shanghai Joe; Il Mio Nome È Shanghai Joe; Mezzogiorno di Fuoco per an Hao
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Robert Hundar, Gordon Mitchell, Carla Romanelli, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A famously graphic East-meets-West martial arts western. Chinese immigrant Shanghai Joe (Chen Lee) travels through the brutal American frontier, hoping to uphold his nonviolent Buddhist principles. Forced to defend himself against vicious racists and hired assassins (including Klaus Kinski as a scalp hunter), Joe uses lethal hand-to-hand combat to wipe out an entire syndicate.

Title: Find a Place to Die
Alternative_Titles: Joe, Find a Place to Die; Joe, Cercati un Posto per Morire
Co_Stars: Pascale Petit, Ted Carter (Nello Pazzafini), Daniela Giordano, Gianni Pallavicino, Aldo Lastretti, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a gang of outlaws raids a gold strike and slaughters a prospector, the surviving sister (Pascale Petit) recruits a down-on-his-luck gunfighter named Joe Collins (Jeffrey Hunter) and a small band of mercenaries to help her reclaim the stolen mine from the bandits.

Title: Finders Killers
Alternative_Titles: Seven Devils on Horseback; Seven Savage Men; Se t'Incontro t'Ammazzo
Co_Stars: Gordon Mitchell, Femi Benussi, Mario Brega, Pia Giancaro, Dean Stratford
Synopsis_and_Notes: An episodic, gritty western centered on a drifter named Jack (Donald O'Brien) hunting the killers of his brother. Meanwhile, an outlaw gang conspires with a crooked town banker (Mario Brega) to hijack an army gold shipment, leading to a sprawling confrontation aided by a mysterious gunman in black (Gordon Mitchell).

Title: Finger on the Trigger
Alternative_Titles: Sentiero dell'Oro; El Dedo en el Gatillo
Co_Stars: Aldo Sambrell, James Philbrook, Leo Anchoriz, Todd Martin, Jorge Rigaud, Silvia Solar
Synopsis_and_Notes: Following the Civil War, a squad of Union soldiers led by Larry Winton (Rory Calhoun) encounters a band of Confederate holdouts occupying a deserted outpost. When both factions are surrounded and besieged by hostile tribes, the former enemies join forces, melting down hidden gold horseshoes into ammunition to mount a desperate defense.

Title: Fistful of Death
Alternative_Titles: Strange Tale of Minnesota Stinky; Ballad of Django; Doppia Taglia per Minnesota Stinky
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Gordon Mitchell, Jeff Cameron, Dennys Colt, Lucky MacMurray, Pietro Fumelli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bizarre frontier tale directed by Demofilo Fidani. Gunman Macho Callaghan (Jeff Cameron) infiltrates Butch Cassidy's Wild Bunch to avenge an ambush, aided by an eccentric frontier preacher (Klaus Kinski). The two men turn out to be undercover Pinkerton agents manipulating rival gangs into destroying one another.

Title: Fistful of Dollars
Alternative_Titles: Per un Pugno di Dollari
Co_Stars: Marianne Koch, Gian Maria Volonté, José Calvo, Wolfgang Lukschy, Sieghart Rupp, Daniel Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: The landmark film that launched the Spaghetti Western craze. Adapting Akira Kurosawa's Yojimbo, Sergio Leone casts Clint Eastwood as the nameless, poncho-clad gunfighter who rides into the border town of San Miguel and secretly manipulates two feuding crime syndicates—the Baxters and the Rojos—into wiping each other out.

Title: Five Dollars for Ringo
Alternative_Titles: Cinque Dollari per Ringo
Co_Stars: Frank Wolff, Albert Farley, Maria Pia Conte, Indio Gonzales, Vicky Lagos, Romano Giomini
Synopsis_and_Notes: Despite the exploitative title, there is no character named Ringo in the film. Gunfighter Lester Sands is hired by an isolated agricultural community to defend their farms and families against marauding border bandits and a corrupt landowner seeking to evict them.

Title: Five Giants from Texas
Alternative_Titles: Five for Revenge; I Cinque della Vendetta
Co_Stars: Monica Randall, Mariano Vidal Molina, José Manuel Martin, Vassili Karamesinis, Antonio Molino Rojo
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a homesteader is murdered and his son abducted by ruthless Mexican outlaws, five of his former companions (led by Guy Madison) band together with the grieving widow (Monica Randall) to pursue the perpetrators across the desert and bring the child home.

Title: Five Man Army
Alternative_Titles: Un Esercito di Cinque Uomini
Co_Stars: Bud Spencer, James Daly, Claudio Gora, Tetsuro Tamba, Piero Lulli, Nino Castelnuovo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A tightly paced heist adventure scripted by Dario Argento. A mysterious strategist known as The Dutchman (Peter Graves) recruits four specialized operatives—a strongman (Bud Spencer), an acrobat, an explosives expert, and a silent samurai (Tetsuro Tamba)—to hijack a heavily guarded Mexican military train transporting a fortune in gold.

Title: Five Thousand Dollars on One Ace
Alternative_Titles: Pistoleros from Arizona; 5000 Dollari sull'Asso
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Helmut Schmidt, Maria Sebalt, Antonio Molino Rojo, Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gambler Jeff Clayton (Robert Woods) wins deed to half of a ranch in a high-stakes card match. Upon arriving at the property penniless after being robbed by bandido Carrancio (Fernando Sancho), he forms an alliance with his partner and his former robber to defeat a corrupt town attorney trying to seize the land.

Title: Flaming Frontier
Alternative_Titles: Old Surehand 1. Teil
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Paddy Fox, Terence Hill (Mario Girotti), Larry Pennell, Letitia Roman
Synopsis_and_Notes: Stewart Granger stars as frontier hero Old Surehand alongside Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice). When a renegade outlaw known as 'The General' murders a native brave to ignite a territorial war, the heroes must race against time to calm the frontier settlements and unmask the real conspirators.

Title: For a Book of Dollars
Alternative_Titles: Più Forte Sorelle
Co_Stars: Gabriella Farinon, Gill Roland, Gigi Bonos, Clara Colosimo, Franca Maresa, Suzy Monen
Synopsis_and_Notes: A broad comic western about a wandering bounty hunter named Amen (Lincoln Tate) who is hired by a convent of nuns to retrieve their stolen charitable funds from a gang of bandits. After tracking down the loot, Amen discovers that the holy sisters are actually a crew of hardened female outlaws in disguise.

Title: For a Few Dollars Less
Alternative_Titles: Per Qualche Dollaro in Meno
Co_Stars: Alberto Giraldi, Raimondo Vianello, Gloria Paul, Lucia Modugno, Angela Luce, Tony Renis
Synopsis_and_Notes: A direct slapstick parody of Sergio Leone's For a Few Dollars More, written by Sergio and Bruno Corbucci. Two bumbling frontier fools (Lando Buzzanca and Raimondo Vianello) attempt to impersonate bounty killers, inadvertently neutralizing an entire bandit gang using hallucinogenic chemicals to collect the rewards.

Title: For a Few Dollars More
Alternative_Titles: Per Qualche Dollaro in Più
Co_Stars: Lee Van Cleef, Gian Maria Volonté, Luigi Pistilli, Mario Brega, Klaus Kinski, Peter Lee Lawrence
Synopsis_and_Notes: The legendary second installment of Leone's Dollars trilogy. Two rival bounty hunters—the calculating Monco (Eastwood) and the vengeful Colonel Douglas Mortimer (Van Cleef)—form an uneasy truce to track down the deranged, pocket-watch-obsessed outlaw El Indio (Gian Maria Volonté) and his gang.

Title: For a Fist in the Eye
Alternative_Titles: Fistful of Knuckles; Por un Pugno nell'Occhio
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Francisco Moran, Monica Randall, Carmen Esbri, Jesus Puente
Synopsis_and_Notes: A madcap Italian comedy spoof of Fistful of Dollars. The iconic clown duo Franco and Ciccio wander into an isolated desert town only to find themselves stuck in the middle of a vicious turf war between two rival immigrant crime families battling for control of local businesses.

Title: For One Hundred Thousand Dollars Per Killing
Alternative_Titles: Vengeance Is Mine; Per 100.000 Dollari t'Ammazzo
Co_Stars: Carlo Gaddi, Claudio Camaso, Piero Lulli, Fernando Sancho, Claudie Lange, Bruno Corazzari
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko plays a stoic, deadly bounty hunter who allies himself with a hardened town sheriff to defend a territory against the marauding Clement gang. Full of cold-blooded showdowns and nihilistic atmosphere, serving as a stylistic precursor to Garko's Sartana character.

Title: For One Thousand Dollars Per Day
Alternative_Titles: Renegade Gunfighter; Per Mille Dollari al Giorno
Co_Stars: Dick Palmer (Mimmo Palmara), José Calvo, Ruben Rojo, Mirko Ellis, Manuel Gil, Pier Angeli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Young Hud (Zachary Hatcher) witnesses the murder of his family by a trio of brothers attempting to seize control of Sun Valley. Taking refuge in the hills, he learns advanced marksmanship from a paralyzed gunfighter, returning to town to take revenge by ironically hiring himself out as the killers' personal bodyguard.

Title: Forewarned, Half-Killed... the Word of the Holy Ghost
Alternative_Titles: Uomo Avvisato Mezzo Ammazzato... Parola di Spirito Santo
Co_Stars: Paolo Gozlino, Victor Israel, Pilar Velasquez, Jorge Rigaud, Massimo Serato, Piero Lulli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko returns as the mythical, white-clad gunfighter known as the Holy Ghost (Spirito Santo), who carries a trained dove on his shoulder. Alongside a companion known as the Preacher, he launches an assault on a heavily fortified Mexican garrison to rescue oppressed farmers and liberate a hidden military treasure.

Title: Forgotten Pistolero
Alternative_Titles: Gunmen of Ave Maria; Tierra de Gigantes
Co_Stars: Luciana Paluzzi, Alberto De Mendoza, Pilar Velazquez, Peter Martell, Piero Lulli, José Suarez
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dark, tragedy-laced western drawing direct parallels to the Oresteia myth. A traumatized gunslinger named Sebastian (Leonard Mann) tracks down the conspirators who murdered his father years earlier, only to find himself entangled in complex family betrayals and romantic intrigue.

Title: Fort Yuma Gold
Alternative_Titles: For a Few Extra Dollars; Per Pochi Dollari Ancora
Co_Stars: Dan Vadis, Sophie Daumier, Jacques Sernas, Nello Pazzafini, José Calvo, Alfonso Rojas
Synopsis_and_Notes: As the Civil War draws to a close, a diehard Confederate commander plots a rogue attack on Fort Yuma. An ex-Rebel prisoner (Giuliano Gemma) agrees to guide Union messengers through dangerous, outlaw-patrolled territory to warn the fort before the assault begins.

Title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
Alternative_Titles: Sartana, the Invincible Gunman; Beyond the Frontiers of Hate; E Vennero in Quattro... per Uccidere Sartana
Co_Stars: Anthony G. Staton, Daniela Giordano, Dennis Colt, Simone Blondell
Synopsis_and_Notes: In this typical Demofilo Fidani production, Jeff Cameron stars as Link, the leader of a small band of frontier vigilantes determined to bring down an outlaw gang using the Sartana moniker for terror and extortion.

Title: Four Dollars for Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: Quattro Dollari di Vendetta
Co_Stars: Ghia Arlen (Dana Ghia), Angelo Infanti, Antonio Casas, José Manuel Martin, Gerard Tichy
Synopsis_and_Notes: Former Confederate officer Roy Dexter (Robert Woods) is framed for treason and the robbery of an army gold transport. Surviving a massacre, he returns to the frontier to hunt down the real culprits and prove his innocence, aided by a resolute frontier woman.

Title: Four Gunmen of the Apocalypse
Alternative_Titles: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse; I Quattro dell'Apocalisse
Co_Stars: Tomás Milian, Lynn Frederick, Michael J. Pollard, Harry Baird, Donald O'Brien, Bruno Corazzari
Music: Franco Bixio / Fabio Frizzi / Vince Tempera
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lucio Fulci's grim, violent, and allegorical masterpiece. Four outcast survivors of a town massacre—a swindler, a pregnant woman, a drunkard, and a freedman—trek through the harsh wilderness. They are captured and tormented by Chaco (Tomás Milian), a sadistic, drug-crazed bandit, sparking an unrelenting quest for survival and vengeance.

Title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
Alternative_Titles: I Quattro Pistoleri di Santa Trinità
Co_Stars: Evelyn Stewart (Ida Galli), Philippe Hersent, Ralph Baldwin, Valeria Fabrizi, Daniela Giordano
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peter Lee Lawrence plays an undercover federal lawman disguised as an outlaw who rides into a remote territory to assist a woman whose gold mine has been seized by two vicious outlaws running an illegal weapons racket.

Title: Four Rode Out
Alternative_Titles: I Quattro sul Sentiero di Sparo
Co_Stars: Leslie Nielsen, Sue Lyon, Julian Mateos, Albert Salmi, Maria Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: A tense cross-border psychological chase starring Pernell Roberts as a US Marshal pursuing an accused Mexican bank robber (Julian Mateos). A resolute Pinkerton detective (Leslie Nielsen) and the fugitive's loyal lover (Sue Lyon) join the gruelling desert trek, where loyalties fray under the relentless sun.

Title: Frenchie King
Alternative_Titles: Legend of Frenchie King; Les Pétroleuses
Co_Stars: Claudia Cardinale, Michael J. Pollard, Patty Shepard, Micheline Presle, Henri Czarniak
Synopsis_and_Notes: An energetic French-Italian-Spanish co-production starring Brigitte Bardot and Claudia Cardinale as rival leaders of two opposing frontier factions—an all-female outlaw gang and a clan of rowdy brothers—who wage an all-out turf war over mineral rights to an oil-rich ranch.

Title: Fury of Johnny Kid
Alternative_Titles: Ultimate Gunfighter; Dove Si Spara di Più
Co_Stars: Paul Naschy, Cristina Galbo, Peter Martell, Luis Induñi, Piero Lulli, Andres Mejuto
Synopsis_and_Notes: A classic revenge western where young Johnny Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence) seeks retribution against the ruthless bandit gang responsible for slaughtering his parents. Notable as the only Spaghetti Western appearance of Spanish horror icon Paul Naschy, who features as a seasoned gunman.

Title: Fury of the Apaches
Alternative_Titles: El Hombre de la Diligencia; Furia degli Apache; Doomed Fort
Co_Stars: Nuria Torray, Georges Gordon, Jesus Puente, Yvonne Bastion, George Martin, Liza Moreno
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a violent tribal raid destroys an incoming wagon train, survivors are rescued by a cavalry unit led by Major Loman (Frank Latimore) and brought to a remote military outpost, where personal rivalries boil over as they prepare for a siege.

Title: Garter Colt
Alternative_Titles: Giarrettiera Colt
Co_Stars: Claudio Camaso Volonté, Marisa Solinas, Walter Barnes, Jasper Zola, Yorgo Voyagis
Synopsis_and_Notes: During the Mexican struggle against Emperor Maximilian, rebel Benito Juarez relies on a fearless female operative named Lulu (Nicoletta Machiavelli). Armed with hidden derringers, Lulu infiltrates the fortified town of Fort City to disrupt arms smugglers supplying weapons to the imperial troops. An atypical female-led adventure featuring Claudio Camaso and Walter Barnes.

Title: Genius
Alternative_Titles: Trinity Is Back Again; Genius, Two Friends, and an Idiot; Un Genio, Due Compari, un Pollo
Co_Stars: Miou Miou, Robert Charlebois, Patrick McGoohan, Klaus Kinski, Raimund Harmstorf, Jean Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Terence Hill plays Joe 'The Genius', the charismatic leader of an eccentric band of petty con-artists that includes the charming Lilla (Miou Miou) and Steamengine Bill (Robert Charlebois). Disguising themselves as a cavalry officer and his entourage, the trio infiltrates Fort Smith to orchestrate a high-stakes swindle against a corrupt commander (Patrick McGoohan).

Title: Gentleman Killer
Alternative_Titles: Gentleman Jo... Uccidi
Co_Stars: Eduardo Fajardo, Silvia Solar, Mariano Vidal Molina, Benito Stefaneli, Angel Lombardo
Synopsis_and_Notes: A quiet Texas border community is overrun by a brutal band of outlaws led by the ruthless Ferreras (Eduardo Fajardo). When his brother is murdered by the gang, Gentleman Jo (Anthony Steffen) arrives in town, adopting an unassuming, soft-spoken facade while systematically dismantling the syndicate with clinical marksmanship.

Title: Get Mean
Alternative_Titles: Get Mean; Time Breaker
Co_Stars: Lloyd Battista, Raf Baldassare, Diana Loris, David Dreyer, Mirta Miller
Music: Franco Bixio / Fabio Frizzi / Vince Tempera
Synopsis_and_Notes: The fourth and most bizarre entry in Tony Anthony's 'Stranger' series. The American gunfighter is offered $50,000 by a gypsy mystic to escort an exiled Spanish princess (Diana Loris) back to her homeland. Upon arrival in medieval Europe, the cowboy finds himself using his sawed-off shotgun in a surreal clash between warring factions of Moors and Viking invaders.

Title: Get the Coffin Ready
Alternative_Titles: Django, Prepare a Coffin; Viva Django; Preparati la Bara
Co_Stars: Horst Frank, George Eastman (Luigi Montefiori), José Torres, Pinuccio Ardia, Lee Burton
Synopsis_and_Notes: Before his slapstick Trinity fame, Terence Hill starred in this direct, gritty prequel-style companion to Corbucci's Django. After his wife is murdered by his treacherous politician friend David (Horst Frank), Django becomes a traveling executioner. He secretly spares innocent condemned men using a hidden harness, forging them into a vengeful strike force that culminates in a graveyard ambush.

Title: Girl Is a Gun
Alternative_Titles: Une Aventure de Billy le Kid
Co_Stars: Rachel Kesterber, Jean Valmore, Bruno Kresoja, Michel Minaud, Bernard Pinon
Synopsis_and_Notes: French New Wave director Luc Moullet crafts a quirky, avant-garde deconstruction of western myths. Jean-Pierre Léaud stars as an inept, erratic Billy the Kid who bumbles his way across the desert, eventually falling into an eccentric romance with an enigmatic suicidal woman while pursued by a bewildered posse and indigenous warriors.

Title: Go Away! Trinity Has Arrived in Eldorado
Alternative_Titles: Stay Away from Trinity...; Trinity in Eldorado; Scansati... Trinità Arriva ad Eldorado
Co_Stars: Stan Cooper, Lucky McMurray, Craig Hill, Carla Mancini, Daniela Giordano, Paul Crain
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two itinerant con-artists (Stan Cooper and Gordon Mitchell) wander across the territory selling fake elixir remedies and running crooked card games. Their antics hit a wall when they attempt to run a scheme against General Xavier, a vicious Mexican warlord with a short temper. A low-budget comedy outing directed by Demofilo Fidani.

Title: Go Kill and Come Back
Alternative_Titles: Any Gun Can Play; Blood River; Vado... l'Ammazzo e Torno
Co_Stars: George Hilton, Gilbert Roland, Kareen O'Hara, Pedro Sanchez, José Torres, Gerard Herter
Synopsis_and_Notes: A fast-paced, stylish caper mirroring the three-way rivalry of Leone's classics. A smooth bounty hunter (George Hilton), an American rogue (Edd Byrnes), and an experienced bandit (Gilbert Roland) engage in endless deceptions and dynamic gunfights to track down a fortune in gold bullion hidden inside the pipes of an abandoned church organ.

Title: Go with God, Gringo
Alternative_Titles: Vaya con Dios, Gringo
Co_Stars: Lucretia Love, Ignazio Spalla (Pedro Sanchez), Armando Guarnieri, Aldo Berti, Pasquale Simeoli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Glenn Saxon stars as Gringo, an innocent cowboy who escapes from prison alongside a ruthless band of killers. Sickened by the gang's unchecked brutality and cruelty toward defenseless settlers, Gringo turns against his fellow escapees, eliminating them one by one to earn both a government pardon and a cash reward.

Title: God Does Not Pay on Saturday
Alternative_Titles: Kill the Wicked; Dio non Paga, il Sabato
Co_Stars: Larry Ward, Maria Silva, Daniela Igliozzi, Vivi Gioi, Howard Beniconi, Furio Meniconi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A vicious outlaw named Lam (Larry Ward) is rescued from the gallows by his crew and immediately robs a stagecoach, fleeing into a desolate ghost town. There they torment an unassuming, retired gunfighter named Wyatt (Robert Mark) and his wife, eventually provoking Wyatt into strapping on his six-shooters for a merciless showdown.

Title: God Forgives, I Don't
Alternative_Titles: Blood River; Dio Perdona... Io No!
Co_Stars: Bud Spencer, Frank Wolff, Gina Rovere, José Manuel Martin, Luis Barboo, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: The landmark film that first paired the legendary screen team of Terence Hill and Bud Spencer in a gritty, serious tone. Gunfighter Cat Stevens (Hill) and insurance investigator Hutch Bessy (Spencer) join forces to track down a gang of train robbers led by the ruthless San Antonio (Frank Wolff), who faked his own death to keep a stolen fortune in gold.

Title: God in Heaven... Arizona on Earth
Alternative_Titles: Arizona on Earth; Dio in Cielo, Arizona in Terra
Co_Stars: Roberto Camardiel, Maria Pia Conte, Frank Braña, Luis Induñi, Juan Torres, Carlo Gaddi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peter Lee Lawrence stars as Arizona, a sharp-shooting wanderer who rescues an elderly rancher from an assault by land-grabbers. Learning that the local baron Austin Styles is systematically slaughtering homesteaders—and was responsible for his own father's suicide—Arizona launches a methodical campaign of personal vengeance.

Title: God Is My Colt .45
Alternative_Titles: La Colt Era il Suo Dio
Co_Stars: Donald O'Brien, Krista Nell, Esmeralda Barros, Mark Davis, John Turner
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gang of cattle rustlers and corrupt businessmen led by Collins (Donald O'Brien) seizes complete control of Langford City. When an undercover investigator is assassinated, federal agent Captain Mike Jackson (Jeff Cameron) is sent covertly into the settlement, posing as an outlaw to take down the syndicate from the inside.

Title: God Made Them... I Kill Them
Alternative_Titles: Dio li Crea... Io li Ammazzo
Co_Stars: Peter Martell, Piero Lulli, Agnes Spaak, Linda Veras, Ivano Staccioli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bleak, uncompromising actioner starring American-born actor Dean Reed as Compton, a lethal bounty hunter hired by border town citizens to protect their gold shipments from an elusive outlaw syndicate. Suspecting an inside conspiracy, Compton discovers that the community's respected banker is the mastermind orchestrating the ambushes.

Title: God Will Forgive My Pistol
Alternative_Titles: Dio Perdona la Mia Pistola
Co_Stars: Loredana Nusciak, Dan Vadis, Giuseppe Addobbati, José Torres, Livio Lorenzon, Joe De Santis
Synopsis_and_Notes: Texas Ranger Johnny Brennan (Wayde Preston) arrives in Oakland City to witness the execution of a rancher convicted of a postal robbery. Convinced by the condemned man's pleas of innocence, Brennan investigates the local elite, exposing an influential land baron (Dan Vadis) who framed the homesteader to secure valuable water rights.

Title: God's Gun
Alternative_Titles: Bullet from God; Pistola di Dio
Co_Stars: Jack Palance, Leif Garrett, Richard Boone, Sybil Danning, Robert Lipton
Synopsis_and_Notes: Lee Van Cleef plays a dual role: first as Father John, a peaceful frontier priest murdered by the vicious Clayton gang (led by Jack Palance), and secondly as his estranged twin brother Louis, an ex-gunfighter who returns to Juno City accompanied by a young parishioner (Leif Garrett) to exact cold-blooded retribution.

Title: Gold of the Heroes
Alternative_Titles: Gold of the Bravados; L'Oro dei Bravados; Chapaqua
Co_Stars: Linda Veras, Rik Battaglia, Franco Pesce, Rick Boyd, Bobby Lapointe
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two Confederate rogues, Doc and Chapaqua (George Ardisson and Bobby Lapointe), unearth $100,000 in gold bars inside an abandoned military fort. Their delicate truce is shattered by the arrival of an alluring, duplicitous woman (Linda Veras) who manipulates both partners against one another to seize the treasure for an outlaw band.

Title: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
Alternative_Titles: Il Buono, il Brutto, il Cattivo; The Good, the Bad and the Wicked
Co_Stars: Lee Van Cleef, Eli Wallach, Aldo Giuffre, Mario Brega, Luigi Pistilli, Rada Rassimov
Synopsis_and_Notes: Leone's sprawling Civil War masterpiece. Three cynical opportunists—the calculating Blondie (Eastwood), the sadistic mercenary Angel Eyes (Van Cleef), and the unprincipled rogue Tuco (Eli Wallach)—race across a war-torn southwest to uncover $200,000 in stolen Confederate gold buried in an unmarked cemetery grave, culminating in the historic three-way circular duel.

Title: Grandsons of Zorro
Alternative_Titles: Dream of Zorro; Sogno di Zorro
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Gianni Musy, Mario Carotenuto, Vittorio Daverio
Synopsis_and_Notes: Slapstick duo Franco and Ciccio star in this parody as two penniless buffoons who inherit the grand estate of Don Diego de la Vega on the condition that they carry on his secret legacy as the masked avenger Zorro, stumbling into misadventures with local soldiers and frontier bandits.

Title: Great Silence
Alternative_Titles: Big Silence; Il Grande Silenzio
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Frank Wolff, Luigi Pistilli, Vonetta McGee, Mario Brega, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: Corbucci's bleak, winter-bound masterpiece set in the snowdrifts of Utah. A mute gunfighter named Silence (Jean-Louis Trintignant), whose vocal cords were severed by outlaws as a child, is hired to defend starving outlaws and refugees from a pack of state-sanctioned, bloodthirsty bounty killers led by the sadistic Tigero (Klaus Kinski).

Title: Great Treasure Hunt
Alternative_Titles: Monta in Sella, Figlio Di...
Co_Stars: Stan Cooper, Luis Marin, Rosalba Neri, Alfredo Mayo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Mark Damon plays Kansas Lee, an agile gambler who teams with an alluring partner (Rosalba Neri) and a supposedly blind guide (Luis Marin) to steal a concealed hoard of gold from a notorious bandit fortress. As expected in the genre, the guide's visual handicap turns out to be an elaborate ruse.

Title: Greatest Robbery in the West
Alternative_Titles: Greatest Kidnapping in the West; Halleluja for Django; La Più Grande Rapina del West
Co_Stars: Walter Barnes, Hunt Powers, Sarah Ross, Jeff Cameron, Erika Blanc, Mario Brega
Synopsis_and_Notes: A stylish heist western where charming rogue David Faylord (George Hilton) orchestrates a bank robbery by concealing stolen gold coins inside an enormous hollowed-out religious statue. Complications arise when a drunken former gunfighter (Hunt Powers) quietly diverts the loot to settle an old score with the gang's outlaw leader.

Title: Gunfight at High Noon
Alternative_Titles: Three Ruthless Ones; I Tre Spietati
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Robert Hundar, Gloria Osuna, Miguel Palenzuela, Luis Induñi, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: An influential early Eurowestern following three brothers whose father was murdered during their childhood. While Jeff (Richard Harrison) grows up to become the respected sheriff of Silver City, his brother Chet (Robert Hundar) embarks on an obsessive death hunt, leading to a tragic showdown between family loyalty and civic duty.

Title: Gunfight at O Q Corral
Alternative_Titles: Règlements de Femmes O Q Corral; Arrière-Train Sifflera Trois Fois
Co_Stars: Will Van Ammelrooy, Vera Belmont, Jean Claude Stromme, Jacques Isermini, Gilda Arancio
Synopsis_and_Notes: A notorious French-produced adult western novelty directed by exploitation veteran Jean-Marie Pallardy. The plot centers on Billy the Kid and his outlaw cohort abducting a female troublemaker during a frontier bank heist, which slowly manipulates the gang members into turning their weapons against one another.

Title: Gunfight at Red Sands
Alternative_Titles: Gringo; Duello nel Texas
Co_Stars: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Sara Lezana, Daniel Martin, Barta Barry, Aldo Sambrell
Synopsis_and_Notes: Considered one of the very first modern Italian-Spanish westerns, preceding Fistful of Dollars by a year. Richard Harrison plays Gringo Martinez, an adopted son of a Mexican family who returns home to find his father murdered and his brother wounded by a gang of racist outlaws, embarking on a methodical pursuit of justice.

Title: Gunfighters of Casa Grande
Alternative_Titles: Pistoleros de Casa Grande
Co_Stars: Jorge Mistral, Steve Rowland, Dick Bentley, Mercedes Alonso, Aldo Sambrell, Diana Lorys
Synopsis_and_Notes: A group of American outlaws led by Joe Daylight (Alex Nicol) wins a sprawling Mexican hacienda in a poker match. Planning to use the estate as a cover to rustle local herds, the bandits gradually grow attached to the local community, taking a stand to defend the ranch against a vicious bandit army led by Rojo (Aldo Sambrell).

Title: Gunman of One Hundred Crosses
Alternative_Titles: Una Pistola per Cento Croci; Django: Eine Pistole für 100 Kreuze
Co_Stars: Marina Mulligan, Dick Palmer (Mimmo Palmara), Rai Saunders, Monica Miguel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Tony Kendall stars as Django, a traveling gunfighter who assists a resilient widowed rancher (Marina Mulligan) after her husband is murdered by henchmen working for an extortionist town boss (Mimmo Palmara). Django schools the determined widow in firearms so she can participate in defending her homestead.

Title: Gunmen and the Holy Ghost
Alternative_Titles: Return of the Holy Ghost; Spirito Santo e le 5 Magnifiche Canaglie
Co_Stars: Dick Palmer (Mimmo Palmara), Aldo Berti, Craig Hill, Ray O'Connor, Jolanda Modio, José Torres
Synopsis_and_Notes: Vassili Karis stars in Roberto Mauri's unofficial sequel to the Holy Ghost series. Playing the cape-wearing marksman, he and his gruff companion recruit a specialized unit of sharpshooters and mercenaries to defend a defenseless agricultural settlement from marauding Mexican outlaws.

Title: Gunmen of Rio Grande
Alternative_Titles: Duel at Rio Bravo; Sfida a Rio Bravo; Jennie Lee Ha una Nuova Pistola
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Madeleine Lebeau, Gerard Tichy, Carolyn Davys, Beni Deus, Massimo Serato
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a corrupt mine owner terrorizes the Mexican settlement of Rio Bravo, a French saloon proprietor writes to legendary lawman Wyatt Earp (Guy Madison) for assistance. Unable to act legally as a marshal in Mexico, Earp adopts an alias and rides south as a hired gun to dismantle the syndicate.

Title: Guns for San Sebastian
Alternative_Titles: Bataille de San Sebastian
Co_Stars: Charles Bronson, Jaime Fernandez, Rosa Furman, Sam Jaffe, Silvia Pinal, Anjanette Comer
Synopsis_and_Notes: Filmed entirely on location in Mexico. Anthony Quinn stars as an army deserter and rogue who is mistaken for a Catholic priest by the impoverished villagers of San Sebastian. Embracing the role, he organizes the peasants into a fortified military resistance against a renegade bandit leader (Charles Bronson) and hostile native raiders.

Title: Half Breed
Alternative_Titles: Half Breed; Winnetou und das Halbblut Apanatschi
Co_Stars: Pierre Brice, Götz George, Ursula Glass, Walter Barnes, Ralf Wolter
Synopsis_and_Notes: Part of the classic Karl May franchise. Frontier scout Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) intervene when predatory white claim-jumpers discover that a young half-breed woman (Ursula Glass) has inherited the rights to a secret, sacred gold mine on her twenty-first birthday.

Title: Halleluja and Sartana Strike Again
Alternative_Titles: Alleluja & Sartana Are Sons... of God; 100 Fists and a Prayer; Alleluja e Sartana Figli di... Dio
Co_Stars: Ron Ely, Uschi Glas, Angelica Ott, Alan Abbott
Synopsis_and_Notes: A slapstick Trinity-style buddy comedy pairing TV's Tarzan, Ron Ely, with Alberto Dell'Acqua. Disguised as frontier priests, the two bumbling bandits arrive in Redemption City and find it dominated by a ruthless gang.
