Allied with an attractive widow (Uschi Glas), they turn an abandoned church into an insurgent headquarters.

Title: Halleluja to Vera Cruz
Alternative_Titles: Partirono Preti, Tornarono... Curati
Co_Stars: Riccardo Salvino, Giampiero Albertini, Jean Louis, Clara Hope, Rick Boyd, Giancarlo Badessi
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two roguish con-artists posing as Catholic priests (Lionel Stander and Riccardo Salvino) gain the trust of a band of Mexican revolutionaries. Hearing of a $500,000 army payroll transport, the faux-friars race to intercept the money, navigating comedic brawls and greedy land barons.

Title: Hands of a Gunman
Alternative_Titles: Ocaso de un Pistolero; Mani di Pistolero
Co_Stars: Gloria Milland, Piero Lulli, Ralph Baldwin, Paco Sanz, Carlos R. Marchent, Jesus Puente
Synopsis_and_Notes: Craig Hill stars as Galen Stark, a notorious gunslinger who hangs up his weapons to settle down to a quiet family existence with his new bride (Gloria Milland). His past refuses to die, however, as ruthless bounty hunters and former rivals relentlessly track him to his remote retreat.

Title: Handsome, the Ugly, and the Stupid
Alternative_Titles: Il Bello, il Brutto, e il Cretino
Co_Stars: Ciccio Ingrassia, Mimmo Palmara, Brigitte Petry, Lotar Guntcher, Ivan Scratuglia, Bruno Scipioni
Synopsis_and_Notes: A direct slapstick spoof of Sergio Leone's The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly. Franco and Ciccio play two bumbling frontier idiots who possess half the coordinates to a buried Confederate treasure, teaming up with a rugged gunfighter named Handsome (Mimmo Palmara) to dig up graves across the West.

Title: Hannie Caulder
Alternative_Titles: Colt pour Trois Salopards
Co_Stars: Robert Culp, Ernest Borgnine, Christopher Lee, Jack Elam, Strother Martin, Stephen Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: Raquel Welch stars as Hannie Caulder, a frontier woman whose husband is murdered and homestead torched by the depraved Clemens brothers (Ernest Borgnine, Jack Elam, and Strother Martin). A passing bounty hunter (Robert Culp) mentors her in precision marksmanship with the help of a craftsman gunsmith (Christopher Lee), setting her on a deadly quest for revenge.

Title: Hate for Hate
Alternative_Titles: Odio per Odio
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Piero Vida, Nadia Marconi, Fernando Sancho, Mirko Ellis, Gloria Milland
Synopsis_and_Notes: An escaped convict (John Ireland) attempts to return stolen loot to an impoverished young sculptor (Antonio Sabàto). When the convict's ruthless former associates raid the home and kidnap the artist's family, the two men join forces to track down the gang in a stylish, violent pursuit written by Fernando Di Leo.

Title: Hate Thy Neighbor
Alternative_Titles: Odia il Prossimo Tuo
Co_Stars: Clyde Gardner, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Horst Frank, Robert Rice, Paolo Magalotti, Franco Fantasia
Synopsis_and_Notes: A ruthless bandit (George Eastman) murders a prospector to steal a map to a rich gold vein on orders from a corrupt landowner (Horst Frank). The victim's brother sets off into Mexico to avenge the killing, navigating a decadent estate where the host stages gladiator-style combat between slaves armed with razor-sharp claws.

Title: Hatred of God
Alternative_Titles: Hate Is My God; L'Odio è il Mio Dio
Co_Stars: Carlo Giordana, Herbert Fleischmann, Marina Berti, Gunther Philippe, Alberto Pozzilli
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dark, nihilistic revenge tale starring Tony Kendall as Carl, a peaceful rancher whose life is shattered when a marauding bandit crew brutally attacks his homestead and slaughters his wife. Hardened by tragedy, Carl picks up his rifles and embarks on a relentless, cold-blooded manhunt across the frontier.

Title: Have a Good Funeral, My Friend... Sartana Will Pay
Alternative_Titles: Stranger's Gold; Buon Funerale, Amigos... Paga Sartana
Co_Stars: Daniela Giordano, Ivano Staccioli, Helga Line, Luis Induñi, Franco Ressel, George Wang
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko returns as Sartana, the supernatural-tinged avenger of the frontier. Arriving in a mining settlement following the murder of a wealthy prospector, Sartana exposes a conspiracy orchestrated by a corrupt banker and a deceptive heiress, utilizing his signature arsenal of trick gadgets and miniature firearms.

Title: He Was Called the Holy Ghost
Alternative_Titles: . . .And His Name Was Holy Ghost; . . .E Lo Chiamarono Spirito Santo
Co_Stars: Dick Palmer (Mimmo Palmara), Hunt Powers, Jolanda Modio, Amero Capanna, Carlo Giordana
Synopsis_and_Notes: Vassili Karis takes over the title role in this unofficial follow-up to the popular Holy Ghost series. Dressed in a pristine white cape, the mysterious marksman arrives in a rural frontier territory to dismantle a crooked land-grabbing foreclosure scheme run by a corrupt sheriff and a treacherous town financier.

Title: Heads or Tails
Alternative_Titles: Testa o Croce
Co_Stars: Franco Lantieri, Sheyla Rosin, Edwige Fenech, Teodoro Corra, José Jaspe
Synopsis_and_Notes: John Ericson plays bounty hunter Will Hunter, who rides into a lawless border town tracking a charismatic bandit and gambler named Serpiente. Along the way, he intervenes to rescue a young woman (Edwige Fenech) from sadistic outlaws in a drama punctuated by stylized torture setpieces and frontier shootouts.

Title: Heads You Die... Tails I Kill You
Alternative_Titles: They Call Me Hallelujah; Guns for Dollars; Testa t'Ammazzo, Croce Sei Morto... Mi Chiamano Alleluia!
Co_Stars: Charles Southwood, Agata Flori, Roberto Camardiel, Rick Boyd, Paolo Gozlino, Andrea Bosić
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Hilton stars as the smooth gunfighter Hallelujah, hired by a revolutionary general to seize a shipment of royal jewels being used to purchase advanced firearms. Navigating rival secret agents, undercover spies disguised as nuns, and a Russian prince, Hallelujah triggers a chaotic web of double-crosses.

Title: Hellbenders
Alternative_Titles: The Cruel Ones; I Crudeli
Co_Stars: Norma Benguel, Al Mulock, Aldo Sambrell, Julian Mateos, Angel Aranda, Gino Pernice
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sergio Corbucci's grim, psychological masterpiece starring Joseph Cotten as Jonas, a fanatical former Confederate colonel who refuses to accept the South's defeat. With his sons, Jonas ambushes a Union gold transport and hides the stolen fortune inside a coffin, undertaking a treacherous journey across the plains under the guise of escorting a dead officer's body.

Title: Here We Go Again, Eh Providence?
Alternative_Titles: Ci Ridiamo, Vero Provvidenza?
Co_Stars: Gregg Hunter, Carole André, Rick Boyd, Luciano Catenacci, Angel Ortiz
Synopsis_and_Notes: A sequel to Sometimes Life Is Hard, Right Providence?, featuring Tomás Milian as the eccentric, bowler-hatted bounty hunter Providence. Teaming up once again with the hulking outlaw Hurricane Kid, the duo engages in convoluted schemes involving counterfeit bounties, high-society heists, and romantic misadventures.

Title: Hero Called Allegria
Alternative_Titles: His Name Was Pot... But They Called Him Allegria; Django Always Draws Second; Il Suo Nome Era Pot...
Director: Demofilo Fidani (as Dennis Ford / Slim Alone)
Co_Stars: Gordon Mitchell, Lincoln Tate, Daniela Giordano, Lucky MacMurray
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two inept bandit brothers, Pot and Ray (Peter Martell and Gordon Mitchell), pull off a chaotic bank robbery, only to be ambushed and stripped of their loot by a rival gang leader named Lobo (Lincoln Tate). The surviving brother embarks on a clumsy quest to recover the stolen money.

Title: Heroes of the West
Alternative_Titles: Gli Eroi del West
Co_Stars: Raimondo Vianello, Silvia Solar, Benny Deus, Maria Anderson, Tomás Blanco, Bruno Scipioni
Synopsis_and_Notes: A broad, lighthearted frontier comedy starring Italian comic duo Walter Chiari and Raimondo Vianello as two charming rogues who impersonate the heirs to a lucrative gold mine, finding themselves caught in the middle of a vicious blood feud between two rival pioneer families.

Title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death!
Alternative_Titles: Ehi Amico... Sei Morto!
Co_Stars: Rik Battaglia, Aldo Berti, Anna Mason, Agnes Spaak, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: Wayde Preston plays a hardened, aging bounty hunter who journeys deep into the badlands of northern Mexico to apprehend a notorious bandit leader. Along the way, the mission evolves into an armed hunt for a hidden Confederate treasure buried in the desert.

Title: Hills Run Red
Alternative_Titles: River of Dollars; Un Fiume di Dollari
Co_Stars: Henry Silva, Dan Duryea, Nicoletta Machiavelli, Gianna Serra, Nando Gazzolo
Synopsis_and_Notes: At the end of the Civil War, two Confederate soldiers steal an army payroll, but one partner betrays the other and leaves him to rot in prison. Years later, the wronged veteran (Thomas Hunter) returns to find his former friend has built a criminal empire protected by a sadistic killer (Henry Silva), sparking an explosive town siege.

Title: His Name Was Holy Ghost
Alternative_Titles: Blazing Guns; Lo Chiamavano Spirito Santo; They Call Him Holy Ghost
Co_Stars: Victor Israel, Poldo Bendanti, Chris Huerta, Pilar Velasquez, Nello Pazzafini
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko introduces his iconic Holy Ghost character, a suave, white-clad sharpshooter with a dove perched upon his shoulder. Fighting for law and order, the vigilante defends border-town settlers from Mexican bandits while scheming to take control of a profitable gold mine won in a card game.

Title: His Name Was King
Alternative_Titles: Lo Chiamavano King
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Anne Puskin, John Silver, Lorenzo Fineschi, Tom Felleghy, Vassili Karis
Synopsis_and_Notes: When his brother is murdered and his sister-in-law brutally assaulted by the notorious Benson gang, John 'King' Marley (Richard Harrison) embarks on an obsessive manhunt. His search for the gunrunners leads to a shocking confrontation when he discovers his friend, the local sheriff (Klaus Kinski), is the secret syndicate kingpin.

Title: His Name Was Sam Walbash, But They Call Him Amen
Alternative_Titles: Savage Guns; Era Sam Walbash... Lo Chiamavano 'Così Sia'
Co_Stars: Dean Stratford (Dino Strano), Dennis Colt, Simone Blondell, Custer Gail
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a sadistic gang leader (Dean Stratford) shoots up a frontier saloon to silence an informant, he murders an innocent youth. The victim's brother, Sam Walbash (Robert Woods), tracks the outlaw into Golden City, where the bandit has adopted a new identity, setting up an inevitable final confrontation.

Title: Hole in the Forehead
Alternative_Titles: Un Buco in Fronte
Co_Stars: Anthony Ghidra, Rosy Zichel, John Bryan, Giorgio Gargiulo, Luigi Marturano
Synopsis_and_Notes: A ruthless Mexican bandit named Manguja (Robert Hundar) hunts across the desert for a fortune in hidden gold. However, an enigmatic and deadly bounty hunter named John Blood (Anthony Ghidra) gets to the treasure first, donating the loot to a monastery before facing Manguja in a final duel.

Title: Holy Water Joe
Alternative_Titles: Acquasanta Joe
Co_Stars: Richard Harrison, Lincoln Tate, Silvia Monelli, Lee Banner, Anthony Freeman, Tucci Musumeci
Synopsis_and_Notes: When an outlaw gang led by Jeff Donovan (Ty Hardin) robs a frontier bank, they inadvertently steal the life savings of notorious bounty hunter Acquasanta Joe (Lincoln Tate). Joe tracks down the bandit, and the two form an uneasy alliance to hunt a rogue associate (Richard Harrison) who has run off with the gold.

Title: Hour of Death
Alternative_Titles: Hora de Morir
Co_Stars: Gloria Milland, Robert Hundar, Jesus Puente, Fernando Sancho, Raf Baldassare, Luis Induñi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dramatic frontier chronicle detailing the trials of a pioneer wagon train traveling through hostile territories. Personal rivalries, indigenous attacks, and opportunistic bandits constantly threaten the expedition, culminating in an unexpected and somber finale.

Title: Hunting Party
Alternative_Titles: Il Giorno dei Lunghi Fucili
Co_Stars: Gene Hackman, Candice Bergen, Simon Oakland, Ronald Howard, L. Q. Jones
Synopsis_and_Notes: A brutal, big-budget European-filmed western. An illiterate bandit leader (Oliver Reed) kidnaps the schoolteacher wife (Candice Bergen) of a wealthy, psychopathic cattle baron (Gene Hackman) so she can teach him to read. Armed with custom long-range rifles, the husband and his aristocratic hunting party track the outlaw gang, turning the chase into an unrelenting bloodbath.

Title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
Alternative_Titles: Sartana's Coming, Get Your Coffins Ready; C'è Sartana, Vendi la Pistola e Comprati la Bara; Vendi Pistole per Comprare Cofani
Co_Stars: Charles Southwood, Franco Fantasia, Peter Carter, Armando Calvo, Erika Blanc, Carlo Giordana, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Hilton steps into the role of Sartana for this official entry in the series. Sartana joins forces with fellow gunfighter Sabata (Charles Southwood) to foil a corrupt banker who is conspiring with a Mexican bandit outfit. Packed with gadgetry, trick weapons, and fast-paced shootouts.

Title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
Alternative_Titles: Sartana the Gravedigger; Sono Sartana, il Vostro Becchino
Co_Stars: Frank Wolff, Klaus Kinski, Gordon Mitchell, Ettore Manni, Sal Borgese, Renato Baldini, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a criminal gang impersonates Sartana during a daring bank robbery, a massive bounty is placed on his head, attracting an army of ruthless bounty hunters (including Klaus Kinski and Gordon Mitchell). Sartana must use his wits, sleight of hand, and unique four-barreled derringer to clear his reputation and expose the corrupt bankers behind the scheme.

Title: I Came, I Saw, I Shot
Alternative_Titles: Vado, Vedo e Sparo
Co_Stars: John Saxon, Frank Wolff, Agata Flori, Leo Anchóriz, Antonio Vico, Rossella Bergamonti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A comedic caper focusing on two unlikely partners, Edwin (Frank Wolff) and Moses (Antonio Sabàto), who steal $300,000 from a frontier bank. They are tracked down by a gambler named Clay (John Saxon) who claims ownership of the loot, forcing the three squabbling men to team up when Mexican outlaws attempt to take the treasure.

Title: I Do Not Forgive... I Kill!
Alternative_Titles: Ballad of a Bounty Hunter; Phaedra West; Fedra West; Io Non Perdono... Uccido!
Co_Stars: James Philbrook, Norma Bengell, Luis Induñi, Angel Ortiz, Alfonso Rojas
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dramatic, violent romance following a determined bounty hunter (Simon Andreu) who falls deeply in love with a woman named Lucy (Norma Bengell). Complications arise when he discovers that her outlaw brother (James Philbrook) is the very fugitive he has been contracted to hunt down and kill.

Title: I Want Him Dead
Alternative_Titles: Lo Quiero Muerto; Lo Voglio Morto
Co_Stars: Lea Massari, José Manuel Martin, Andrea Bosić, Licia Calderon, Cristina Businari, Rick Boyd, Frank Braña
Synopsis_and_Notes: When an outlaw gang assassintes a guide's sister en route to disrupt a Civil War peace conference, frontier guide Clayton (Craig Hill) vows bloody retribution. Operating entirely outside the law, Clayton relentlessly hunts down each member of the gang, foiling a wider conspiracy in the process.

Title: If One Is Born a Swine
Alternative_Titles: One Is Born a Swine; Turn... I'll Kill You; Carogne Si Nasce; Winchester Bill
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Eleonara Bianchi, Conrado Sanmartin, Ric Burton, Luis Induñi, Spean Convery
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bandit leader Pepito (Fernando Sancho) acts as hired muscle for a greedy town boss seeking to seize a productive gold mine. Gunfighting stranger Billy Walsh (Richard Wyler) rides to the rescue of the elderly mine owner and his daughter, leading to a series of violent clashes with Sancho's gang.

Title: If One Is Born a Swine... Kill Him
Alternative_Titles: Cry of Death; Lynching; Sei una Carogna, t'Ammazzo
Co_Stars: Gordon Mitchell, Maria Bardanzellu, Philippe Hersent, Fernando Sancho, Giovanni Pazzafini
Synopsis_and_Notes: A powerful cattle syndicate gains control of the local bank and institutes an aggressive foreclosure campaign against struggling farmers. An undercover federal lawman known as 'Il Mulo' (Glenn Saxon) poses as a notorious hired gun, aligning with a local attorney to protect the settlers.

Title: If You Shoot... You Live!
Alternative_Titles: Si Quieres Vivir... Dispara
Co_Stars: Frank Braña, Alejandro De Enciso, Paula Pattier, José Canalejas, Francisco Nieto
Synopsis_and_Notes: A late-cycle Spanish production remaking the narrative of If You Want to Live, Shoot!. James Philbrook plays a recovering wounded gunfighter who steps in to defend a widowed homesteader from the predations of a wealthy regional land baron (Frank Braña).

Title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
Alternative_Titles: Django, If You Want to Live... Shoot!; Se Vuoi Vivere, Spara!
Co_Stars: Ken Wood (Giovanni Cianfriglia), Riccardo Garrone, Isabella Savona, Tom Felleghy, Aldo Cecconi
Synopsis_and_Notes: A despotic land baron named Marlow (Ivan Rassimov) hires Mexican bandits to terrorize local homesteaders into selling their farms. Meanwhile, a wounded gunfighter named Johnny is nursed back to health by a widow; when the gang destroys her property, Johnny embarks on a lethal crusade to eliminate Marlow.

Title: I'll Sell My Skin Dearly
Alternative_Titles: Vendo Cara la Pelle
Co_Stars: Michele Girardon, Valerio Bartoleschi, Dane Savours, Grant Laramy, Spartaco Conversi
Synopsis_and_Notes: After his entire family is slaughtered by a vicious gang, Shane (Mike Marshall) spends years mastering firearms on an abandoned ranch. Once his skills are honed, he ventures out to methodically track down and execute everyone involved, including a former bandit who has since taken holy vows as a priest.

Title: In a Colt's Shadow
Alternative_Titles: All'Ombra di una Colt
Co_Stars: Conrado Sanmartin, Anne Sherman, Graham Sooty, Helga Line, Andrew Scott, Frank Ressel, José Calvo
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two hired gunfighters successfully defend a Mexican village from outlaws, but their friendship fractures when one partner falls in love with the other's daughter. Moving to Texas to start a peaceful life, the lovers are targeted by a local syndicate, forcing the two former allies to reunite in a massive town gunfight.

Title: In the Name of the Father
Alternative_Titles: I Quattro del Pater Noster
Co_Stars: Cast uncredited / ensemble
Synopsis_and_Notes: An obscure and rarely seen comedy-western directed by cult horror filmmaker Ruggero Deodato early in his career, following a group of four misfits navigating frontier scrapes and misadventures.

Title: In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Colt
Alternative_Titles: Masked Thief; Au Nom du Père, du Fils et du Colt
Co_Stars: Nuccia Cardinali, Gill Roland, Agatha Lys, Lorenzo Piani, Frank Braña, Paco Sanz
Synopsis_and_Notes: Sheriff Johnston (Craig Hill) investigates a series of daring stagecoach robberies carried out by a mysterious gang of outlaws who disguise themselves in outlandish costumes, including saloon girls, to ambush their unsuspecting prey.

Title: It Can Be Done... Amigo
Alternative_Titles: The Big and the Bad; Si Può Fare... Amigo
Co_Stars: Jack Palance, Renato Cestiè, Dany Saval, Francisco Rabal, Giovanni Pazzafini, Luciano Catenacci
Synopsis_and_Notes: A lively, slapstick-infused western comedy pairing Bud Spencer as the roguish Coburn with Jack Palance as Sonny Bronston, a theatrical, blustery gunslinger pursuing Coburn for compromising his sister's honor. Along the way, Coburn inherits custody of an orphaned boy with valuable oil-rich land.

Title: Jaguar
Alternative_Titles: El Llanero
Co_Stars: Silvia Sorente, Todd Martens, Manuel Zarzo, Georges Rollin, Roberto Camardiel, Beny Deus
Synopsis_and_Notes: Cult auteur Jess Franco directs this unique adventure set during civil unrest in South America. José Suarez plays Llanos (also called 'Jaguar'), a mountain rebel leading a revolutionary guerrilla faction fighting against an oppressive military general and a corrupt magistrate.

Title: Jesse and Lester, Two Brothers in a Place Called Trinity
Alternative_Titles: Two Brothers in Trinity; Due Fratelli i un Posto Chiamato Trinità
Co_Stars: Donald O'Brien, Gino Marturano, Anna Zinneman, George Wang, Rick Boyd
Synopsis_and_Notes: Directed by and starring Richard Harrison alongside Donald O'Brien. Two vastly different brothers—one a charming, womanizing scoundrel and the other a devout Mormon preacher—inherit a substantial fortune, but their conflicting plans are put on hold when bandits rob the inheritance.

Title: Jesse James' Kid
Alternative_Titles: Hijo de Jesse James; One Against All; Solo Contro Tutti
Co_Stars: Mercedes Alonso, Adrian Hoven, Luis Induñi, Roberto Camardiel, Joe Kamel, Pier Caminnecci
Synopsis_and_Notes: Twenty years after the legendary outlaw Jesse James is assassinated in his home, his grown son Billy (Robert Hundar) goes undercover at a regional horse ranch. Learning that the rival rancher conspiring to seize the land is the very man who murdered his father, Billy launches a bullet-riddled vendetta.

Title: Joe Dexter
Alternative_Titles: Guns of Nevada; La Sfida degli Implacabili
Co_Stars: Audrey Amber (Adriana Ambesi), Katya Loritz, John MacDouglas, Stan Bart, Miguel De La Riva
Synopsis_and_Notes: Drifter and quick-draw expert Joe Dexter (George Martin) settles in Iron City, where he becomes romantically entangled with two women. When a jealous saloon owner conspires with a mine manager to steal an inherited silver claim, Joe takes up arms in a decisive town showdown.

Title: John the Bastard
Alternative_Titles: John il Bastardo
Co_Stars: Claudio Camaso, Martine Beswick, Claudio Gora, Glauco Onorato, Gordon Mitchell, Nadia Scarpitta
Synopsis_and_Notes: A unique western retelling of the Don Juan and Casanova myths. John Tenerico (John Richardson) is an amorous seducer and lethal gunman who travels across the frontier leaving broken hearts and dead rivals in his wake, until a vengeful religious sect dispatches an assassin (Gordon Mitchell) to end his reign.

Title: Johnny Colt
Alternative_Titles: Starblack
Co_Stars: Elga Andersen, Franco Lantieri, Jane Tilden, Andrea Scotti, Renato Rossini
Synopsis_and_Notes: Robert Woods plays Starblack, a masked Robin Hood-style avenger who adopts a mild-mannered alter ego to undermine the corrupt, extortionist grip that a crooked banker (Franco Lantieri) holds over an oppressed mining community.

Title: Johnny Hamlet
Alternative_Titles: Dirty Story of the West; Quella Sporca Storia del West; Django Porte sa Croix
Co_Stars: Gilbert Roland, Gabriella Grimaldi, Horst Frank, Pedro Sanchez, Stefania Careddu
Synopsis_and_Notes: Castellari directs a Shakespearean tragedy reframed as a spaghetti western. Returning from the Civil War, Johnny discovers his father dead and his mother married to his villainous Uncle Claude (Horst Frank). Suspecting assassination, Johnny conducts a deadly investigation aided by a wandering mentor (Gilbert Roland).

Title: Johnny Yuma
Alternative_Titles: Johnny Yuma
Co_Stars: Lawrence Dobkin, Rosalba Neri, Luigi Vannucchi, Fidel Gonzales, Gustavo D'Arpe, Gianni Solaro
Synopsis_and_Notes: A violent, iconic western starring Mark Damon as Johnny Yuma, a skilled gunfighter who arrives to claim his murdered uncle's ranch. He runs afoul of the scheming widow Samantha (Rosalba Neri) and her hired assassin Carradine (Lawrence Dobkin), but Johnny and Carradine develop a mutual respect that upends the murder plot.

Title: Judge Roy Bean
Alternative_Titles: Trouble in Sacramento; All'Ovest di Sacramento; La Loi à l'Ouest de Pecos
Director: Jean Girault / Robert Hossein (as Richard Owens)
Co_Stars: Silva Monti, Xavier Gelin, Pierre Perret, Anne-Marie Balin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Robert Hossein stars as the eccentric, self-appointed hanging judge Roy Bean, governing his frontier territory with autocratic rule. When a federal investigator arrives to challenge his legal jurisdiction, political maneuvering and comedic frontier violence collide.

Title: Keoma
Alternative_Titles: Keoma il Vendicatore; Django Rides Again; Django's Great Return; The Violent One
Co_Stars: Woody Strode, William Berger, Donald O'Brien, Olga Karlatos, Ken Wood (Giovanni Cianfriglia)
Synopsis_and_Notes: One of the crowning achievements of the twilight era of Spaghetti Westerns. Half-breed gunslinger Keoma (Franco Nero) returns to his plague-ravaged hometown to find it dominated by an ex-Confederate tyrant and his own three treacherous half-brothers. Aided by his father (William Berger) and a freedman friend (Woody Strode), Keoma wages a mythic, slow-motion battle of redemption.

Title: Kid Rodelo
Alternative_Titles: Il Kid Rodelo
Co_Stars: Janet Leigh, Broderick Crawford, Richard Carlson, José Nieto, Miguel Del Castillo, Julio Peña
Synopsis_and_Notes: Based on a Louis L'Amour novel, Don Murray stars as Kid Rodelo, recently freed from prison and attempting to recover a hidden cache of gold. Pursued by an outlaw gang and an enigmatic woman (Janet Leigh), the expedition across the desert devolves into a desperate survival trek against native war parties.

Title: Kid Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: Vengeance; Vendetta
Co_Stars: Lee Van Cleef, Jim Brown, Glynnis O'Connor, John Marley, Matt Clark
Synopsis_and_Notes: A brutal exploitation western filmed in Israel. Pop star Leif Garrett plays a young boy whose parents are slaughtered and sister abducted by a psychotic outlaw band led by Lee Van Cleef. The boy joins forces with an enigmatic black gunfighter (Jim Brown) to track down the gang and execute them.

Title: Kill Django... Kill First
Alternative_Titles: Uccidi Django... Uccidi Primo
Co_Stars: George Wang, Peter White, Aldo Sambrell, Mirko Ellis, Men Fury, Riccardo Garrone, Krista Nell
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bounty hunter Django (Giacomo Rossi Stuart) is tasked with hunting down Ramon (George Wang), a notorious Mexican outlaw leading a gang of bandits in a series of violent raids across the Texas borderlands.

Title: Kill Johnny Ringo
Alternative_Titles: Uccidete Johnny Ringo
Co_Stars: Greta Polyn, Ray Scott, Lee Burton, William Bogart, James Harrison, William Burke
Synopsis_and_Notes: Texas Ranger Johnny Ringo (Brett Halsey) is dispatched to Eagle Pass to investigate a widespread counterfeiting racket. Posing as a traveling gambler, Ringo follows the trail of bogus currency directly to the town's corrupt civic leaders, culminating in an explosive saloon battle.

Title: Kill or Die
Alternative_Titles: Kill or Be Killed; Ringo Against Johnny Colt; Uccidi o Muori
Co_Stars: Elina De Witt, Fabrizio Moroni, Andrea Bosić, Albert Farley, Men Fury, Gordon Mitchell
Synopsis_and_Notes: Capitalizing on the popularity of the Ringo name, Robert Mark plays a mysterious violin-playing wanderer who intervenes in a vicious territorial feud, defending a vulnerable family against a powerful, aggressive frontier clan.

Title: Kill the Poker Player
Alternative_Titles: Hai Sbagliato, Dovete Uccidermi Subito!
Co_Stars: Ivano Staccioli, Susan Scott (Nieves Navarro), Frank Braña, Saturno Cerra, Carlo Gaddi, Ernesto Colli
Synopsis_and_Notes: Professional gambler and quick-draw ace Ace (Robert Woods) runs into deadly trouble when he exposes a corrupt town boss (Frank Braña) as a card cheat. After stealing the boss's saloon-singer lover (Nieves Navarro), Ace finds himself marked for death by a cadre of hired assassins.

Title: Kill Them All and Come Back Alone
Alternative_Titles: Go Kill Everybody and Come Back Alone; Ammazzali Tutti e Torna Solo
Co_Stars: Frank Wolff, Franco Citti, Leo Anchóriz, Men Fury, Ken Wood, Alberto Dell'Acqua
Synopsis_and_Notes: A fast-paced, action-packed military heist film. Captured Confederate soldier Clyde Link (Chuck Connors) leads a specialized team of mercenaries to infiltrate an impregnable Union fortress and steal a fortune in gold. The mission succeeds, but a series of ruthless double-crosses leaves Link clawing his way out of a grave to hunt down his treacherous partners.

Title: Killer Caliber .32
Alternative_Titles: Killer Calibro .32
Co_Stars: Agnes Spaak, Sherill Morgan (Hélène Chanel), Cole Kitosch, Max Dean, John Bartha, Andrea Bosić
Synopsis_and_Notes: When a regular stagecoach run is repeatedly ambushed and plundered by a gang of masked bandits, bank executives hire a dapper, sharply dressed bounty hunter named Silver (Peter Lee Lawrence). Through meticulous investigation, Silver discovers that the leader of the outlaws is none other than the bank director himself.

Title: Killer Goodbye
Alternative_Titles: Winchester Justice; Killer, Adios
Co_Stars: Marisa Solinas, Eduardo Fajardo, Armando Calvo, Rosalba Neri, Miguel Del Castillo, Nello Pazzafini
Synopsis_and_Notes: Jess Frain (Peter Lee Lawrence) returns to his home town of Fulton City to clear his name and re-establish law and order alongside the sheriff. He is confronted by two warring factions fighting for economic control of the town, discovering that a corrupt mastermind (Eduardo Fajardo) is pulling the strings from the shadows.

Title: Killer Kid
Alternative_Titles: Killer Kid
Co_Stars: Liz Barret, Fernando Sancho, Ken Wood (Giovanni Cianfriglia), Nelson Rubien, Adriano Vitale
Synopsis_and_Notes: An American government agent (Anthony Steffen) goes undercover in revolutionary Mexico as an arms smuggler known as Killer Kid. Witnessing the immense suffering of the Mexican peasants at the hands of a tyrannical military regime, his political loyalties shift, leading him to join the rebel forces in a desperate assault.

Title: Kitosch, the Man Who Came from the North
Alternative_Titles: Man from the North; Kitosch, l'Uomo Che dal Nord
Co_Stars: Krista Nell, Piero Lulli, Enrique Ávila, Ricardo Palacios, Gustavo Rojo
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Hilton stars as Major Zachary Baker of the Canadian Mounted Police, tasked with transporting $500,000 in gold bars through hostile wilderness to Fort Eagles. To protect the payload, he conceals the gold inside five coffins escorted by a mourning party of widows, only to find the destination fort destroyed by outlaws.

Title: Kung Fu Brothers in the Wild West
Alternative_Titles: Winchester, Kung Fu and Karate; Kung Fu nel Pazzo West
Co_Stars: William Berger, Po Chih Leo, Donald O'Brien, Sally Leh
Synopsis_and_Notes: An East-meets-West curiosity produced between Italy and Hong Kong. Two Chinese brothers travel to the American West, encountering racism and violence from local outlaws while fulfilling a mission to protect an immigrant settlement against a rogue samurai assassin.

Title: Land Raiders
Alternative_Titles: Bruciatelo Vivo; Last of the Landgrabbers
Co_Stars: George Maharis, Arlene Dahl, Janet Landgard, Jocelyn Lane, Peter Dane, George Coulouris
Synopsis_and_Notes: A bigoted land baron (Telly Savalas) attempts to drive out local native tribes by paying townsfolk bounties for scalps. His estranged brother (George Maharis) returns to the territory just in time to stop his violent campaign, triggering a major family showdown and armed confrontation across the border.

Title: Last Gun
Alternative_Titles: Lonely Gunslinger; Killer's Canyon; Jim il Primo
Co_Stars: Carl Mohner, Celina Cely, Kitty Carver, Livio Lorenzon, Marty Gordon
Synopsis_and_Notes: A notorious gunslinger (Cameron Mitchell) decides to hang up his pistols and retire peacefully to a quiet frontier settlement. When an aggressive outlaw gang terrorizes the townspeople and corrupts the local authorities, he is forced to strap on his six-guns one final time to restore order.

Title: Last of the Mohicans
Alternative_Titles: Fall of the Mohicans; L'Ultimo dei Mohicani
Co_Stars: Paul Müller, Sara Lezana, Dan Martin, José Manuel Martin, Barbara Loy, Luis Induñi, José Marco
Synopsis_and_Notes: A European western adaptation inspired by James Fenimore Cooper's classic novel. Scout Hawkeye and his Mohican companion Luncas (Dan Martin) join forces with a British officer (Jack Taylor) to thwart a corrupt fort commander and hostile warriors conspiring to drive settlers from the frontier.

Title: Last Rebel
Alternative_Titles: L'Ultimo Pistolero
Co_Stars: Jack Elam, Woody Strode, Ty Hardin, Victoria George, Renato Romano, Mike Forest
Synopsis_and_Notes: Former NFL star Joe Namath plays Burnside Hollis, an ex-Confederate soldier who rescues a former slave (Woody Strode) from a lynching at the close of the Civil War. The pair team up with a partner (Jack Elam) running pool-hall scams until greed and betrayal lead to a climactic duel.

Title: Last Ride to Santa Cruz
Alternative_Titles: Der Letzte Ritt nach Santa Cruz
Co_Stars: Mario Adorf, Marianne Koch, Klaus Kinski, Marisa Mell, Edmund Haskins, Thomas Fritson
Synopsis_and_Notes: A corrupt sheriff (Mario Adorf) wrongfully frames and imprisons an innocent frontiersman (Edmund Purdom). Escaping from federal custody years later, the vengeful fugitive returns to the territory to clear his name and take down the crooked lawman's syndicate. Co-stars Klaus Kinski.

Title: Last Tomahawk
Alternative_Titles: La Valle delle Ombre Rosse; Der Letzte Mohikaner
Co_Stars: Karin Dor, Dan Martin, Luis Induñi, Joachim Fuchsberger, Angel Ter, Carl Lange
Synopsis_and_Notes: A companion to the Karl May frontier films, starring Anthony Steffen as Strongheart and Dan Martin as Chinga. The heroes struggle to maintain peace and prevent a catastrophic war between feuding native tribes and manipulative frontier land speculators.

Title: Law of Violence
Alternative_Titles: Legge della Violenza; Todos o Ninguno
Co_Stars: Conrad Steve, Manuel Branchud, Angel Miranda
Synopsis_and_Notes: Retired bounty hunter Lester Moore (George Greenwood) accepts the position of sheriff in a small border town that is plagued by nightly assaults from an elusive band of Mexican outlaws. Moore uses his tactical experience to lay a trap for the gang.

Title: Left Handed Johnny West
Alternative_Titles: Johnny West il Mancino
Co_Stars: Mike Anthony, Roger Delaporte, André Bollet, Mara Cruz, Diana Garson, Roberto Camardiel
Synopsis_and_Notes: Mimmo Palmara stars as legendary southpaw marksman Johnny West, a roaming lawman investigating the murder of an affluent mine owner. Despite local accusations pointing toward two outlaw brothers, West uncovers the real conspiracy orchestrated by regional officials.

Title: Legacy of the Incas
Alternative_Titles: El Último Rey de los Incas; Das Vermachtnis des Inka
Co_Stars: Rik Battaglia, Fernando Rey, William Rothlein, Francisco Rabal, Heinz Ehrhardt, Walter Giller
Synopsis_and_Notes: A unique South American western set in the mountains of Peru. Guy Madison plays Wutuma, the last royal descendant of the Incas, who is tasked by the Peruvian president (Fernando Rey) with preventing a violent insurrection led by a renegade native leader and rogue bandits.

Title: Lemonade Joe
Alternative_Titles: Limonadovy Joe... Konska Opera
Co_Stars: Milos Kopecky, Kveta Fialova, Olga Schoberova, Karel Effa, Waldemar Matuska
Synopsis_and_Notes: A celebrated Czechoslovakian musical western satire. Karel Fiala plays the pristine, teetotaling cowboy Lemonade Joe, whose superhuman marksmanship is fueled entirely by Kolaloka lemonade. Joe arrives in Stetson City to wage war on whiskey-drinking outlaws and corrupt saloon tycoons.

Title: Let Them Rest
Alternative_Titles: Kill and Pray; Requiescant
Co_Stars: Mark Damon, Pier Paolo Pasolini, Barbara Frey, Rossana Martini, Mirella Maravidi, Franco Citti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A surreal and politically charged gothic western. Lou Castel plays Requiescant, a gentle young man raised by a preacher who discovers an innate, lethal gift for shooting. He embarks on a quest to find his foster sister, confronting a decadent and sadistic aristocratic land baron played by Mark Damon.

Title: Let's Go and Kill Sartana
Alternative_Titles: Vamos a Matar Sartana
Co_Stars: George Martin, Isarco Ravajoli, Virginia Rodin, Cris Huerta, Monica Taber
Synopsis_and_Notes: Two former prison inmates, Clay and Greg (George Martin and Gordon Mitchell), part ways upon their release—one seeking an honest life and the other immediately returning to highway robbery. When Greg's gang raids Clay's family ranch, an inevitable duel ensues. The Sartana of the title is entirely absent from the film.

Title: Light the Fuse... Sartana Is Coming
Alternative_Titles: Gunman in Town; Cloud of Dust... Cry of Death; Una Nuvola di Polvere... un Grido di Morte, Arriva Sartana
Co_Stars: Susan Scott (Nieves Navarro), Piero Lulli, Bruno Corazzari, Frank Braña, Massimo Serato, José Jaspe
Synopsis_and_Notes: Gianni Garko returns as Sartana, breaking a fellow gambler out of prison to clear him of a false murder charge. Navigating a landscape of deceit, bounty hunters, and double-crossing town officials, Sartana uncovers a stolen fortune hidden in a web of musical instruments and clockwork devices.

Title: Long Day of the Massacre
Alternative_Titles: Il Lungo Giorno del Massacro
Co_Stars: Glenn Saxon, Manuel Servano, Liz Barret, Daniela Giordano
Synopsis_and_Notes: A gritty, low-budget 1968 entry following an embittered gunslinger (Peter Martell) who finds himself trapped in a volatile territory controlled by competing outlaw factions. Aided by a mysterious drifter (Glenn Saxon), he fights his way through a wave of ambush attempts.

Title: Long Days of Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: I Lunghi Giorni della Vendetta; Faccia d'Angelo
Co_Stars: Francisco Rabal, Gabriella Giorgelli, Conrado Sanmartin, Nieves Navarro, Franco Cobi D'Este
Synopsis_and_Notes: A loose adaptation of The Count of Monte Cristo set in the American West. Ted Barnett (Giuliano Gemma) escapes from prison to prove he was framed for his father's murder, systematically hunting down the corrupt sheriff and the traitorous arms-smuggler (Conrado Sanmartin) responsible.

Title: Long Ride from Hell
Alternative_Titles: I Live for Your Death; Vivo per la Tua Morte
Co_Stars: Wayde Preston, Lee Burton, Dick Palmer, Ted Carter, Franco Fantasia, Aldo Sambrell, Rosalba Neri
Synopsis_and_Notes: Bodybuilding icon Steve Reeves stars in his only western as Mike, a rancher framed for horse theft by a corrupt cattle baron (Wayde Preston). Escaping from a brutal prison camp after his brother dies, Mike returns to Yuma City to exact retribution with the assistance of a saloon woman (Rosalba Neri).

Title: Lost Treasure of the Incas
Alternative_Titles: Lost Treasure of the Aztecs; Sansone e il Tesoro degli Incas
Co_Stars: Toni Sailer, Wolfgang Lukschy, Brigitte Heiberg, Mario Petri, Pierre Cressoy
Synopsis_and_Notes: Peplum muscleman Alan Steel stars as Samson alongside gunfighter Alan Fox. When an innocent man is murdered by a crooked town boss, the heroes assist the victim's daughter, leading them into an adventurous quest that uncovers the hidden ruins and gold of a lost Inca civilization.

Title: Lucky Johnny: Born in America
Alternative_Titles: Dead Aim; Lucky Johnny
Co_Stars: Virgil Frye, James Westerfield, Evaristo Marquez, Sonny Vandeusen
Synopsis_and_Notes: Filmed in Mexico, this gritty production follows Johnny, a notorious marksman raised by an eccentric undertaker. When Johnny falls in love with a woman trapped in an abusive marriage to a violent outlaw chieftain, the conflict explodes into a lethal desert pursuit.

Title: Machine Gun Killers
Alternative_Titles: Gatling Gun; Damned Hot Day of Fire; Quel Caldo Maledetto Giorno di Fuoco
Co_Stars: John Ireland, Evelyn Stewart, Claudie Lange, George Rigaud, Roberto Camardiel, Furio Meniconi
Synopsis_and_Notes: When the inventor of a revolutionary rapid-fire Gatling gun is abducted by a ruthless Mexican mercenary (John Ireland), Union officer Chris Tanner (Robert Woods) is framed for treason. Escaping custody, Tanner launches a desperate manhunt to rescue the inventor and recover the weapon.

Title: Macho Killers
Alternative_Titles: El Macho
Co_Stars: George Hilton, Malisa Longo, Susanna Gimenez, Miguel Bosè
Synopsis_and_Notes: World middleweight boxing champion Carlos Monzon plays El Macho, a gambler who impersonates a deceased outlaw to infiltrate a gang commanded by an eccentric, champagne-sipping bandit (George Hilton). When the corrupt local sheriff double-crosses him, a massive town-square firefight erupts.

Title: Mad Dog Morgan
Alternative_Titles: Mad Dog
Co_Stars: Jack Thompson, David Gulpilil, Frank Thring, Michael Pate, Wallas Eaton
Synopsis_and_Notes: A fierce Australian bushranger classic sharing the raw DNA of the Eurowestern. Dennis Hopper gives an unhinged, hypnotic performance as legendary historical outlaw Dan Morgan, who turns to banditry to survive and wages a bloody guerrilla war against the colonial authorities across the 1850s Australian wilderness.

Title: Magnificent Brutes of the West
Alternative_Titles: Badmen of the West; I Magnifici Brutos del West
Co_Stars: Giacomo Rossi Stuart, Emma Penella, Darry-Cowl, Alfredo Mayo, Julio Peña
Synopsis_and_Notes: A slapstick frontier farce featuring the comedy troupe 'I Quattro Brutos'. When four bumbling handymen inadvertently wipe out a bandit crew in Fresno, they take over the local mortuary business, getting caught between a dedicated undercover marshal (Giacomo Rossi Stuart) and a hostile outlaw gang.

Title: Magnificent Texan
Alternative_Titles: Il Magnifico Texano
Co_Stars: Benny Deus, Barbara Loy, Luis Induñi, John Barracuda, George Greenwood, Gloria Osuna
Synopsis_and_Notes: Glenn Saxon plays Manny, an unassuming saloon keeper who secretly acts as a masked Robin Hood-style hero for oppressed Mexican peasants. While defending the community from a tyrannical land baron and his sadistic son, Manny systematically settles the score for his parents' murder.

Title: Magnificent Three
Alternative_Titles: Three Good Men; I Tre Implacabili
Co_Stars: Robert Hundar, Massimo Carocci, Fernando Sancho, Cristina Gajoni, Paul Piaget, Raf Baldassare
Synopsis_and_Notes: An early Spanish-Italian effort following three loyal frontier comrades (Geoffrey Horne, Robert Hundar, and Paul Piaget) who rally pioneer settlers to defend their territory and ranches from an invasion by an aggressive bandit outfit led by Fernando Sancho.

Title: Magnificent West
Alternative_Titles: Il Magnifico West
Co_Stars: Lorenzo Fineschi, Dario Pino, Italo Gasperini, Enzo Pulcrano, Gordon Mitchell, Sergio Scarchili
Synopsis_and_Notes: Vassili Karis plays an agile, roguish adventurer searching across the frontier for a shipment of stolen gold bullion misappropriated by his former partner. His investigation leads him into constant clashes with outlaws, culminating in a showdown with a ruthless rival played by Gordon Mitchell.

Title: Mallory Must Not Die
Alternative_Titles: My Name Is Mallory... M Means Death; Il Mio Nome È Mallory... 'M' Come Morte
Co_Stars: Gabriella Giorgelli, Teodoro Corra, Aldo Berti
Synopsis_and_Notes: A laconic bounty hunter named Mallory (Robert Woods) tracks an escaped killer into the small mining community of Coppermine. As he falls in love with a local woman, Mallory must untangle a web of town corruption to draw his target into a final street showdown.

Title: Man: His Pride and His Vengeance
Alternative_Titles: Pride and Vengeance; L'Uomo, l'Orgoglio, la Vendetta
Co_Stars: Klaus Kinski, Tina Aumont, Lee Burton, Franco Ressel, Karl Schonboch, Alberto Dell'Acqua
Synopsis_and_Notes: Based on Prosper Mérimée's novel Carmen, this dark, anti-heroic drama stars Franco Nero as José, an honorable Spanish soldier whose obsession with an alluring gypsy woman (Tina Aumont) destroys his military career, plunging him into banditry, jealousy, and multiple murders. Features Klaus Kinski as a ruthless outlaw partner.

Title: Man and a Colt
Alternative_Titles: L'Uomo e una Colt
Co_Stars: Fernando Sancho, Gloria Milland, Mirko Ellis, Marta Reeves, Jacinto Martin
Synopsis_and_Notes: Robert Hundar stars as Dallas, a rogue gunfighter who uncovers a clandestine alliance between an influential town boss and a notorious Mexican bandit leader (Fernando Sancho). Learning that the syndicate plans to raid the Texas Reserve Bank, Dallas prepares an ambush to foil the heist.

Title: Man Called Amen
Alternative_Titles: They Called Him Amen; Così Sia
Co_Stars: Sydne Rome, Alf Thunder (Alfio Caltabiano), Tano Cimarosa, Mila Beran, Renato Cestiè
Synopsis_and_Notes: A martial-arts-infused frontier comedy following a sharp-shooting rogue named Horacio (Luc Merenda) who reunites with his double-crossing former partner (Alfio Caltabiano), now operating a corrupt church front. Together with an eccentric band of misfits, they plan a bank robbery that spirals into broad slapstick.

Title: Man Called Blade
Alternative_Titles: Mannaja
Co_Stars: John Steiner, Donald O'Brien, Sonja Jeannine, Martine Brochard, Rik Battaglia, Philippe Leroy
Synopsis_and_Notes: A dark, atmospheric masterpiece from Sergio Martino. Maurizio Merli stars as Blade, an axe-wielding bounty hunter who arrives in a rain-drenched silver town. When a sadistic mine manager (John Steiner) tortures and attempts to blind Blade, the resilient warrior trains his senses in darkness to carry out a brutal, hatchet-wielding massacre.

Title: Man Called Django
Alternative_Titles: Viva! Django; Lo Chiamavano Django; W Django!
Co_Stars: Stelio Candelli, Clauco Onorato, Donato Castellaneta, Esmeralda Barros, Simone Blondell, Chris Avram
Synopsis_and_Notes: Anthony Steffen stars as Django, an ice-cold gunfighter tracking the four renegades who raped and killed his lover. Rescuing an escaped prisoner who knows the identities of the killers, Django infiltrates an arms-smuggling ring supplying weapons to Mexican revolutionaries to execute his vengeance.

Title: Man Called Gringo
Alternative_Titles: La Ley del Forasterio; Sie nannten ihn Gringo
Co_Stars: Sieghardt Rupp, Alexandra Stewart, Helmut Schmidt, Dan Martin, Silvia Solar, Peter Tordy
Synopsis_and_Notes: A rancher paralyzed in an accident entrusts his estate to a corrupt attorney who secretly plots his ruin. The lawyer hires a wandering outlaw named Gringo to eliminate the rancher, unaware that Gringo is the man's long-lost son. The deception is exposed by a mysterious federal marshal (Götz George).

Title: Man Called Invincible
Alternative_Titles: In the West There Was a Man Named Invincible; Tressette... Giocava Sempre colla Morte
Co_Stars: Cris Huerta, Evelyn Stewart, Sal Borgese, Umberto D'Orsi, Rosalba Neri, Carla Mancini
Synopsis_and_Notes: George Hilton plays Tressette, a flamboyant, gadget-wielding gambler hired to transport gold from Wagon Bend to Dallas. When a corrupt banker swindles the shipment and disguises the gold dust inside export cakes, Tressette and his companions launch an elaborate, action-packed plan to reclaim the fortune.
